Conventional single-modality systems often fail in real hospital conditions due to facial occlusion, background noise in speech signals, or poor sensor contact.This paper is a multimodal emotion monitoring framework that integrates facial expression analysis, speech emotion recognition, and wearable physiological monitoring. The system is implemented on two platforms: a Raspberry Pi 4 for low-power bedside deployment and a Lenovo IdeaPad workstation (AMD Ryzen 5, RTX 3050 Ti, 16 GB RAM) for high-performance processing, both running the same Python-based code.Facial emotions are classified into seven categories using the DeepFace framework. The system achieved processing speeds of 10–15 frames per second on the Raspberry Pi and 25–35 frames per second on the workstation using CUDA acceleration. Speech emotion recognition is performed using MFCC features extracted from microphone input and evaluated with a pretrained model. Physiological parameters including heart rate, oxygen saturation (SpO2), and body temperature are measured using a MAX30102 pulse oximeter and transmitted wirelessly through an ESP8266 module.A Telegram bot is integrated to send periodic reports to physicians and support commands such as say for audio playback and /note for caregiver notifications.Experimental results show stable operation across all modalities and improved reliability compared to single-modality systems.

title: AI Based Health Monitoring System using IoT and Wearable Device
venue: 2026 4th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Communication Systems (ICKECS)
abstract: The escalating prevalence of chronic health conditions and the increasing elderly population necessitate rapid, economical, and highly effective healthcare solutions. Conventional healthcare typically involves scheduled hospital visits for monitoring. However, this periodic assessment can fail to detect abrupt health changes, leading to serious situations, especially for the people with heart diseases, hypertension, and respiratory issues, if medical aid is delayed.To avoid such consequences and overcome them our project presents an AI-powered health monitoring system utilizing IoT and wearable technology. The system employs cost-effective IoT sensors connected to an ESP32 microcontroller to continuously track key health metrics, such as body temperature and heart rate. Initial, rapid decision-making regarding essential health data is managed locally using a simple Finite State Machine (FSM). The data is then wirelessly transmitted via Wi-Fi to a Firebase cloud database for easy, continuous access and storage.For enhanced accuracy, the system incorporates an Isolation Forest algorithm running on a Python backend (FastAPI). This machine learning approach classifies the patient's condition into "normal" or "alert" categories. Unlike traditional monitoring based on fixed thresholds, the AI model adapts over time, improving anomaly detection by learning health data patterns. Should an anomaly be detected, the patient is instantly alerted by a buzzer, and Telegram notifications are simultaneously sent to caregivers and medical staff. A web dashboard is also provided which is linked to ESP32, where the patients can check out on their live readings. The system's design allows integration of additional sensors like SpO₂, blood pressure, and ECG monitors in future while enhancing, for a more complete health picture.

title: AI Based Internet Behaviour Detector
venue: 2026 International Conference on Connected Intelligence for Industrial Applications (CI2A)
abstract: With increasing demands for a dynamic network security that can effectively and intelligently identify suspicious user patterns, there arises a great need for a device that can dynamically and fusively identify seemedly abnormal behavior related to internet usage. The goal of the current “AI Based Internet Behavior Detector” project is to offer an interactive, Python-driven platform with the ability to secure data, optimize defense systems against threats, and dynamically identify abnormal internet use. With a focus on using analyses of behavior and machine learning techniques, this project aims to help networks constantly screen for seemingly abnormal patterns that, in reality, are indicative of a break-in. With an emphasis on deep networks and other models like random forests, CNN, and LSTMs, this project seeks to offer a comprehensive design that integrates data acquisition, data preprocessing, model development, and alert activation. This project aims to provide a comprehensive design, including upgrading security from break-ins that use normal patterns, and will provide a comprehensive platform for effective security, with emphasis on secure networks, secure data, and secure internet use environments. Additionally, the project seeks to offer an all-encompassing, dynamic, and optimized platform for data security, network efficiency, and network security.

title: AI Based Surveillance System
venue: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Electronics, Computing, and Communication (ICETECC)
abstract: Increased demand for enhanced safety and security in the different sectors has brought with it great advancements in AI-powered smart surveillance systems. Such systems take advantage of the latest developments in computer vision, sensor integration, and Automated Machine Learning to monitor and analyze video and image data automatically. Unlike traditional surveillance systems, which highly rely on human intervention and often fail to provide real-time decision-making or predictive analysis, modern AI-powered systems address these limitations. Specifically, tracking individuals across multiple locations and consolidating their data into a unified framework remains a challenge for conventional setups. The system utilizes powerful AI algorithms, such as HAAR-CASCADE, for face detection. The algorithm ensures that there is accurate and reliable identification of individuals in real time. Furthermore, the system carries out behavior analysis to identify any unusual activities, hence improving its application in the public and private sectors. Multithreaded Python programming is used which allows the efficient handling of high volumes of data since several tasks, including video feed analysis and log generation, can run at the same time without delay. An ideal implementation of this system is in educational institutions, where it streamlines processes such as monitoring student behavior. With this system, upon the detection of students from various locations on campus, a single log is formed for every student, creating an overall record of thatstudent's movements, attending classes, and activities all under one roof. Therefore, this capability improves precision but saves valuable time as well as administrative effort involved.

title: AI based Two Way Sign Language System
venue: 2023 Second International Conference on Electronics and Renewable Systems (ICEARS)
abstract: Most hearing persons do not understand sign language. But hearing-impaired people communicate through the sign language only. Hence, there is a challenge in the communication between hearing and the hearing-impaired people. The proposed system is to build a bridge between the hearing and hearing-impaired communities and to start two-way communication. The proposed system suggests a two-way sign language translator that translates speech in real time into sign language and vice versa. Using Python’s OpenCV Library, the proposed system processes the video frame by frame. Additionally, each frame’s background is removed using the Background/Foreground Segmentation Algorithm based on Gaussian Mixtures. The outlines of the processed image are classified into the comparable written language terms using a convolutional neural network (CNN). In order to accurately preserve the sign language’s grammar during conversion from sign language to voice, we use gTTS (Google Text-to-Speech) and fundamental NLP. Enrolment and reading rates among hearing-impaired youngsters are significantly lower than the general population average. This technology will therefore assist regular schools in better integrating the hearing challenged community, making education more accessible and affordable for them.

title: AI Chrome Extension for Automated Meeting Summary
venue: 2025 International Conference on Electronics and Renewable Systems (ICEARS)
abstract: The increasing volume of textual information in the digital era poses considerable hurdles for efficient data retrieval and summarization. Conventional note-taking techniques can be laborious and ineffective, frequently leading to the omission of essential information during meetings. Automatic Text Summarization (ATS) provides a mechanism for producing succinct summaries that encapsulate essential ideas and conclusions from dialogues. This project presents an AI-driven Chrome addon intended to automate the summarizing of conference discussions. The addon includes an intuitive interface developed using HTML and CSS, which records audio and video inputs and transcribes them into text with Rev.ai for precise transcription. The backend is constructed with Python and Flask, offering a resilient foundation for data processing. The system utilizes the T5 model for summarization, providing coherent and contextually pertinent summaries that enable users to concentrate on vital content rather than navigating extensive transcripts. Essential attributes comprise real-time transcribing, guaranteeing the retention of significant facts, and automated summarizing, which condenses crucial elements into succinct outputs. The solution enhances user experience, fosters cooperation, and improves decision-making, while minimizing time allocated to manual notetaking. The initiative utilizes innovative technology to overcome the shortcomings of traditional methods, providing professionals with an enhanced and efficient meeting experience.

title: AI Driven 6G Network Slicing for Distance Collaborative Sports Training: Edge Cloud Resource Allocation Strategy
venue: IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics
abstract: The rapid evolution of communication networks has paved the way for developing 6G technology, which promises ultra-low latency, massive connectivity, and enhanced intelligence. In distance collaborative sports training, where athletes and coaches operate remotely, real-time data transmission, seamless connectivity, and adaptive network management are crucial. It presents an AI-driven 6G network slicing approach integrated with deep learning techniques to enhance real-time performance tracking, and enable virtual coaching in collaborative basketball training. A novel Adaptive Pelican Optimized - Elman Spike Neural Network (APO-ESNN) model is employed to dynamically allocate resources based on real-time demand, ensuring efficient training sessions. The edge cloud in 6G sports training facilitates low-latency processing, AI-driven analytics, and optimal bandwidth allocation, enabling seamless communication, individualized coaching, and effective resource utilization to improved athlete performance. In a 6G environment, multiple network slices optimize sports training. The video streaming slice handles real-time video, the sensor data slice ensures low-latency wearable data transmission, and the AI processing slice analyzes sensor data for individualized coaching. Customization adjusts slices based on training requirements. The experimental framework was developed using Python software (version 3.10), and achieved a resource allocation efficiency of 92% and a training session efficiency of 85%, demonstrating significant improvements in network utilization and session productivity. This AI-driven, data-powered basketball training system highlights the transformative potential of 6G network slicing in revolutionizing collaborative sports training while advancing real-time sports analytics and interactive training experiences.

title: AI Driven Approach for Detecting False Data Injection Attacks Targeting Water-Energy Nexus
venue: 2023 IEEE IAS Global Conference on Renewable Energy and Hydrogen Technologies (GlobConHT)
abstract: As water and energy grids are highly interconnected, water-energy nexus (WEN) is considered an attractive target for malicious attackers. Attacking WEN affects both systems simultaneously; consequently, the attack is able to create fatal damage in the entire network. In this paper, we propose to tackle this problem using different deep learning models with different loss functions. Additionally, a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) WEN in presence of renewable energy sources model is reformulated into a mixed-integer linear programming model for real-time implementation purposes. The optimization model is developed using MATALB, and the deep-learning models are implemented using Python keras framework.

title: AI enhanced Autonomous Traffic Sign Recognition and Action System
venue: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancements in Electrical, Electronics, Communication, Computing and Automation (ICAECA)
abstract: The development of automatic detection and recognition of traffic signs is essential for intelligent transportation solutions (ITS) and the integration with autonomous systems. The proposed system integrates traffic sign data with a Raspberry Pi platform and Deep Learning methods to detect and recognize various traffic signs. It addresses the challenges associated with detecting and recognizing traffic signs, enhancing the safety and efficiency of ITS systems. The system receives real-time input from cameras positioned at traffic signals, which is processed using YOLOv5. Following processing, the output is sent to a Raspberry Pi via WebSocket and asynchronous I/O Python libraries. Using Blynk-based technology, the Raspberry Pi then carries out the appropriate steps, such changing the speed of the vehicle or halting.

title: AI Virtual Mouse
venue: 2025 4th OPJU International Technology Conference (OTCON) on Smart Computing for Innovation and Advancement in Industry 5.0
abstract: The AI Virtual Mouse is a ground-breaking touchless alternative to traditional computer mouse, focusing on hygiene and convenience in an increasingly health-conscious environment. While wireless mouse eliminate cable-related issues, they still require physical touch, which can be a vector for germ transmission, particularly in workplaces with shared workstations. This cutting-edge technology uses computer vision and machine learning to eliminate the need for touch by capturing and interpreting hand and finger motions in real time via an external or built-in camera on a computer. The AI Virtual Mouse effectively recognizes hand features via deep neural networks, allowing it to execute fundamental mouse tasks such as clicking, scrolling, and pointer navigation without any Interaction between people. Using OpenCV in Python, this concept not only improves user experience by eliminating the need for physical peripherals, but it also improves hygiene by considerably lowering the danger of contamination associated with high-touch surfaces.

title: AI-Assisted Cursor Navigation Using Eye Gaze Detection
venue: 2025 3rd International Conference on Business Analytics for Technology and Security (ICBATS)
abstract: This is an AI-based gaze tracking system designed to let users control a computer cursor using only their eyes, making technology more accessible for people with motor impairments. The system uses Media Pipe to detect facial landmarks, Python's Auto GUI library to control cursor movement and employs an Eye Aspect Ratio based blink detection mechanism to enable real-time interaction. Through the monitoring of eye movements using a standard webcam and their translation into screen coordinates, the system allows for smooth and precise control. This eliminates the need for specialized hardware, making it a cost-effective and accessible solution. The system achieved, 90.5% accuracy, 86.8% sensitivity, and 95.5% specificity, all while keeping delays low and ensuring smooth, real-time interaction. While things like head movements and lighting changes can affect how well it works, future improvements in the algorithm's adaptability could make it even more reliable and user-friendly.

title: AI-based Carbon Footprint Tracking and Reduction
venue: 2025 6th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Industrial sectors contribute significantly to global carbon emissions, driving the urgent need for smarter energy management solutions. Real-time monitoring and predictive analytics are essential for promoting environmental sustainability. Traditional carbon credit trading systems are often centralized, lack transparency, and are prone to inefficiencies and manipulation. Furthermore, they provide limited real-time insights into emissions management. Conventional methods rely on manual reporting or centralized authorities, leading to delayed emission detection and inaccurate carbon trading. These approaches struggle to deliver the accuracy and scalability required for modern sustainability efforts. This work proposes an AI-driven integrated platform that combines IoT-based real-time monitoring, machine learning prediction, automated load optimization, and a dynamic carbon credit trading marketplace. The Random Forest Classifier is employed to predict emissions accurately and optimize energy consumption patterns. Simulations were conducted by collecting real-time industrial energy data and training the model to forecast carbon emissions. The system dynamically adjusts loads and facilitates carbon trading based on the predicted emission levels. The system was developed using Python AI modeling, Node.js web platform, and LoRaWAN technology for secure IoT communication. The results of the tests showed that the training accuracy is 100 percent while validation accuracy is 96 percent. Further, emissions were predicted to be 750.0 tons which is less than 1000 tons. Energy load management kept consumption below 500 kWh consumption, demonstrating effective optimization in real-time. Ultimately, our proposed platform provides accurate emissions forecasting, efficient energy management, and transparent carbon trading, giving the industry a scalable solution to meet sustainability and compliance demands.

title: AI-Based Child Care Parental Control System
venue: 2022 4th International Conference on Advancements in Computing (ICAC)
abstract: Due to the prevalence of the COVID-19 epidemic around the globe, children were compelled to engage in remote learning through online platforms, hence mobile phone has become one of their predominant devices. Mobile device with Internet access offers a major outlet for education, entertainment, and social connection, but this combination can lead to several significant bad sequences such as online exploitation, harmful addictions, and other negative impacts of online social networking. To address harmful effects, parental controls are becoming more crucial, yet Sri Lankan parents are less aware of this. Consequently, this study proposes a parental control system to monitor their child’s activities. Android, Microsoft Azure, Java, Python, OpenCV, MySQL, and FastAPI are among the most prominent technologies utilized in the proposed application’s development. The suggested approach focuses primarily on the Sri Lankan context and aims to enhance parental digital literacy while safeguarding children from cyber threats. Yielded results showed the proposed mobile application for the identification of toxic words, drugs & alcohol content, game character images, and Instagram Sinhala comments severity as 94%, 95%, 97%, and 55% respectively in controlled experiments.

title: AI-based Custom Web Application Scanner and Bug Detection in Website using Docker
venue: 2026 6th International Conference on Expert Clouds and Applications (ICOECA)
abstract: Web application security is now a very important issue because of the increasing number of user-driven websites and dynamic sites that are susceptible to cyber attacks. Conventional scanners are dependent on high-level testing of static payload and rule-based detection and they most of the time fail to detect emerging or complicated threats. The project introduces an AI-powered Custom Web Application Scanner as the combination of manual test payloads and a Large Language Model (LLM) and Docker-based studying of the sandbox to improve the vulnerability detection and prevention. This system uses Python Flask as the backend and Flutter as the frontend to use to interact and analyze target URLs in real time. Manual testing makes use of payload-based scripts to detect vulnerabilities which include SQL Injection, Cross-site Scripting, CSRF, and Command Line Injection, whereas the LLM can automatically analyze the responses that will be analyzed through the use of a parser in order to identify any hidden or advanced threats and recommend remediation measures. Also, an environment of Docker container is employed to test suspicious or potentially malicious files in a safe way, and it is isolated and executed without any risk. Experimental analysis indicates that the suggested hybrid model has a better detection rate, a lower number of false positive and actionable information to the developers, and it is a strong and smart approach to a secure web application evaluation.

title: AI-Based Early Crop Disease Prediction and Preventive Solution System Using Environmental Sensor Data
venue: 2026 International Conference on Smart Futuristic Technology
abstract: The early detection and control of plant diseases remain critical challenges in sustainable agriculture, as delayed responses often result in significant yield losses and economic setbacks for farmers. This work presents a Smart Plant Disease Prediction and Control System that integrates IoT sensing, computer vision, and intelligent decision support to deliver both preventive and curative solutions. The system employs an ESP32-CAM for real-time image acquisition and multiple IoT sensors to capture soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and water level parameters. Data is transmitted to a Python Flask backend, where two AI models operate in parallel: (i) a prediction model that computes a Disease Risk Index (DRI) based on environmental trends, and (ii) a CNN-based detection model that analyzes leaf images for visible symptoms. Based on these outcomes, the framework categorizes plant status as Healthy, High Risk, or Disease Detected.A recommendation engine then tailors actionable advice according to crop type, growth stage, and disease condition. For high-risk scenarios, the system advises preventive biocontrols, micronutrient sprays, or mild fungicides, while confirmed cases trigger targeted pesticide or fertilizer recommendations. Automated irrigation and fertigation are supported through a pump–valve mechanism controlled by soil moisture thresholds, with all events logged for traceability. Farmers receive real-time SMS/WhatsApp alerts via Twilio and can remotely monitor crop health through a web dashboard displaying live sensor readings, annotated plant images, and recommendation logs.By combining proactive disease prediction, AI-based detection, and automated control mechanisms, the proposed system aims to minimize crop losses, optimize input usage, and empower farmers with timely interventions. This integrated framework demonstrates a scalable model for precision agriculture, with potential to significantly enhance productivity and resilience in farming practices.

title: AI-Based Personal Finance and Investment Management with Stock Prediction and Portfolio Tracking Using Streamlit Dashboard
venue: 2026 9th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Control Systems (ICICCS)
abstract: This research presents the design and implementation of an integrated personal finance management system combining a secure Node.js–based backend, a React–Tailwind CSS frontend, and a Python analytics module for financial forecasting and sentimentenhanced insights. The backend provides structured APIs for user authentication, expense tracking, savings management, bill management, and data persistence through a MongoDB data model. The frontend delivers an interactive interface supporting real-time balance visualization, budget planning, investment simulation, financial news retrieval, and expenditure analytics. The Python module contributes advanced processing, including statistical forecasting, sentiment analysis, and chart generation to support decision-making. Security considerations such as password hashing, improved authentication flow, API centralization, and safe handling of external data were integrated into the system architecture. The combined platform demonstrates how multi-stack technologies can be orchestrated to deliver a comprehensive, extensible financial management solution capable of supporting personalized insights, predictive analysis, and efficient user interaction.

title: AI-based Smart Detection and Vehicle Control System using ESP32 and IoT
venue: 2025 4th International Conference on Automation, Computing and Renewable Systems (ICACRS)
abstract: The proposed system presents a AI-based object detection and response system designed to enhance safety and automation by utilizing image processing and IoT technologies. This system made of a transmitter (TX) and receiver (RX) section. In the transmitter section, a camera captures real-time images, which can be processed using Python and trained datasets to identify humans, animals, or objects. The processed information is transmitted wirelessly to the receiver section through Wi-Fi communication. At the receiver end, an ESP32 microcontroller integrates data from both transmitter and an ultrasonic sensor for real-time obstacle and distance detection. From the analysis, the system triggers appropriate actions like activating an alarm, displaying information in an LCD. The combination of AI-based image recognition and sensor-based detection makes sure accurate and intelligent decision-making in rapidly changing environments. This project shows an efficient approach for various applications like vehicle-to-pedestrian (V2P) safety, smart surveillance system, and obstacle-awareness automation systems, implanting low-cost IoT hardware and AI-driven image processing for consistent performance.

title: AI-Based Smart Firewall for Intelligent Network Traffic Monitoring and Attack Detection
venue: 2026 2nd International Conference on Computing, Communication and Green Engineering (CCGE)
abstract: This paper presents an AI-based smart firewall designed to monitor network traffic and detect potential cyber attacks. Traditional firewalls mainly rely on predefined rules, which makes them less effective against new and evolving threats. To address this, the proposed system uses machine learning techniques to analyze traffic patterns and identify suspicious activities in real time.The system also includes a login module for secure access and a dashboard that helps visualize network activity and detected attacks. Threats are categorized based on their severity, making it easier for administrators to respond quickly. The implementation is carried out using Python, with Streamlit for visualization and SQLite for storing data.The results show that the proposed approach can effectively distinguish between normal and malicious traffic, while also improving response time and overall network visibility.

title: AI-Based Suspicious Identification System for Agency Security Monitoring using Big Data Fusion
venue: 2022 26th International Computer Science and Engineering Conference (ICSEC)
abstract: Terrorism is now a global issue, particularly the use of objects, car bombs, and even human suicide attacks. However, these issues can be avoided by reporting any anomalies that occur in the area. Unfortunately, it is not possible to use people to inspect the entire area. This study presents an AI-based suspicious identification system for agency security monitoring based on big data fusion, which employs specific data from an agency’s person, thing, and vehicle that appear at various times and locations. The best machine learning algorithm was used to train this data, and the results were displayed in real-time on the web application. In our experiment, we used ANN, SVM, k-NN, decision tree, and Naive Bayes to train the suspicious model with Scikit-learn on Python. The decision tree algorithm has the highest classification accuracy of 98.867% and the fastest prediction speed of 0.005 milliseconds per sample, according to the experiment results.

title: AI-Code Feedback, an AI-Based companion for Enhancing Introductory Programming Education
venue: 2026 IEEE Global Engineering Education Conference (EDUCON)
abstract: Learning programming requires continuous feedback, yet traditional instruction cannot deliver immediate support to every student. This study evaluates AI Code Feedback, a Visual Studio Code extension that provides real-time, AI-generated guidance during coding. A quasi-experimental, single-session study was conducted with 30 first-year Computer Programming students, divided into control (standard VS Code) and experimental (AI-assisted VS Code) groups. Both groups completed identical Python exercises and a pre-/post-test, and technology acceptance was assessed using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Results show significant learning gains in both groups, but no statistically significant differences in Global performance between them. However, the experimental group achieved significant improvements in Strings and Variables & Casting, while the control group improved only in the latter. Gender analyses revealed differentiated conceptual benefits: male students improved mainly in Variables & Casting, whereas female students improved in Strings. TAM results indicated no significant group differences, but the experimental group showed lower means and higher variability, with low and inconsistent Actual Use likely limiting the tool’s impact. These findings suggest that AI-driven feedback can support specific conceptual gains and implicit personalization, but its overall effectiveness depends strongly on students’ adoption, engagement, and trust. Future work should address onboarding, usability, and integration strategies to increase effective use of AI companions in programming education.

title: AI-Driven Academic Assistant: An Intelligent Chatbot System Leveraging Llama-3 and Rag for Enhanced University Support Services
venue: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovative Sustainable Computational Technologies (CISCT)
abstract: In today's higher education environment, the demand for cost-effective student services is rising due to increasing student numbers and the density of academic data. This paper outlines the development and implementation of a chatbot system for a world-class university, offering intelligent, personalized real-time assistance to students. The system processes various document formats-PDFs, images, and Word files-using PyMuPDF (+ Poppler), Tesseract, Pillow, and python-docx. Powered by the Llama-3 (Large Language Model Meta AI) model for natural language understanding and generation, the chatbot provides accurate responses to complex inquiries. The system uses FastAPI for backend operations, Langchain for advanced query identification, Chroma for high-performance vector storage, and ChatGroq for smooth natural language generation. Additionally, tools like pandas, openpyxl, and chromadb enhance overall system performance. This research shows that a chatbot-driven approach can efficiently track student queries, providing personalized, timely responses while reducing administrative workloads and significantly improving student satisfaction. The system aligns with global initiatives, such as UNESCO's (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) AI framework, supporting inclusive and culturally sensitive applications. This work lays the foundation for AI-driven academic support systems, contributing to near-term and long-term advancements in educational AI deployment.

title: AI-Driven Adaptive Turbo Decoding Framework for Dynamic IoT Communication Environments
venue: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Emerging Computing and Intelligent Technologies (ICoECIT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) enables large-scale connectivity across diverse devices, but maintaining reliable communication under dynamic channel conditions remains a significant challenge. Conventional turbo decoders, though effective in 4G and 5G systems, operate with fixed parameters and lack adaptability when faced with fluctuating signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), interference, and fading—typical in IoT networks. This paper presents an AI-driven adaptive turbo decoding framework that enhances decoding efficiency and reliability through intelligent parameter tuning. The proposed model integrates a reinforcement learning (RL) agent with the Log-MAP turbo decoding algorithm to dynamically optimize iteration count and decision thresholds based on real-time channel estimations. Simulations in MATLAB and Python demonstrate that the AI-enhanced decoder achieves up to 25% improvement in bit-error rate (BER) and 30% reduction in decoding latency compared to traditional methods. The framework offers a scalable, software-based solution for energy-efficient, adaptive communication in IoT and future 6G networks, eliminating the need for hardware modification.

title: AI-Driven Delay Forecasting using CatBoost for Congested Railway Sections
venue: 2026 International Conference on Electronics and Renewable Systems (ICEARS)
abstract: Prediction of accurate train delay is quite challenging for a large scale transportation network like Indian Railways. Traditional methods are still used in Indian railways for train’s operational purpose and forecasting delays, which fails to capture the real time factors like route congestion, distance between the stations, weather and historical delay patterns. This research utilizes CatBoost, a gradient boosting algorithm that efficiently handles categorical data, to improve delay prediction using structured railway data. The model was trained on features including weather conditions, time of the day, historical delays and distance between the stations. To further improve performance, Optuna, an open source Python framework used for hyperparameter optimization, was incorporated to fine-tune CatBoost’s parameters. The optimized model achieved a MAE of 27.87 minutes, RMSE of 41.64 minutes and R2 score of 0.960, which means, it is possible to explain 96% of the variation in the dependent variable. CatBoost’s ability to handle categorical variables efficiently, combined with ordered boosting results in robust generalization and reduced bias. The Optuna - tuned Catboost model outperforms other conventional models like XGBoost, LightGBM, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forests, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP), ElasticNet, and Support Vector Regression (SVR), by minimizing prediction error and capturing nonlinear feature interactions. This results in CatBoost with Optuna, the best model to predict real time delay forecasting in Indian Railway network.

title: AI-Driven Dyslexia Assistive Reader: A Comprehensive Tool for Text Extraction, Simplification, and Accessibility
venue: 2026 Fourth International Conference on Augmented Intelligence and Sustainable Systems (ICAISS)
abstract: The given paper provides the description of an AIs-assisted Dyslexia Reader that could serve people with dyslexia by facilitating the process of reading and comprehending the text. The system incorporates Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to draw out writings in the images and documents, natural language processing to simplify writings and text to speech (TTS) to aid the audio needs. It has multi-language support, real-time camera OCR, dyslexiafriendly display options, and amazing accessibility controls such as font customization, background themes and highlighting of complex words in a text. Export abilities allow the user to store processed material to be used in academics and business. The architecture of the tool integrates a Python-Flask backend and modern frontend technologies, which will promote the fluent and user-friendly experience. This was assessed using modern web technologies and evaluation carried done by performance analysis of transcription accuracy and text simplification. The results after experiment proved better readability and understanding. It is an assistive reader that helps dyslexic users read more fluently, better, and comprehend more, as well as to be used in education and accessibility in the workplace.

title: AI-Driven Gesture Recognition System for Inclusive Communication in D&M Communities
venue: 2025 9th International Conference on I-SMAC (IoT in Social, Mobile, Analytics and Cloud) (I-SMAC)
abstract: Full engagement in everyday life depends on effective communication, but deaf and mute groups struggle to bridge the communication gap with the hearing community. Gesture recognition software that can read sign language and facilitate natural interaction is one of the innovative possibilities. Its challenges include processing in real-time in a small space, reacting to distinct gestures in specific locations, and being able to withstand changes in background noise and luminance. The present research presents a novel method for the Multimodal Python-Based Support Gesture Detection Framework's (MP-SGRF) real-time gesture detection. This communication application is a comprehensive, context-aware combination of Python for the hand gesture recognition system and human facial expression and movement of the head analysis. The architecture can ensure accuracy in sequential gesture recognition and contextual understanding by incorporating sophisticated models like Bi-Directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM). By removing noise from background motion and changing lighting, a Smoothing pre-processing layer based on the Fourier Transformation improves reliability in a variety of applications. Text-to-speech (TTS) and real-time feedback allow for two-way communication, while dynamic sign language mapping promotes cultural acceptability. MP-SGRF may find use in public services, education, healthcare, and personal communication.

title: AI-Driven Hand Gesture Recognition for Robotic Arm Control
venue: 2025 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Communication (ICAIRC)
abstract: This project focuses on the development of an AI-powered dynamic hand gesture recognition system designed to control both the speed and directional movement of an industrial robotic arm, aiming to improve human-robot interaction (HRI). Traditional control methods for robotic systems often fall short in terms of intuitiveness and adaptability, particularly in dynamic or unstructured settings. To address these limitations, the proposed system interprets a range of dynamic hand gestures—including forward, backward, left, right, and neutral—as well as speed commands such as slow, intermediate, and fast. Real-time hand tracking is achieved using MediaPipe for accurate landmark detection, combined with OpenCV for video capture and processing. A Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network processes the gesture sequences, trained on a custom dataset collected under varied lighting and background conditions to enhance robustness. Python was used for software development, while motion commands were executed through KRL Language. The system demonstrated real-time performance, with an average signal latency of 0.6 seconds, and achieved a high recognition accuracy of 98.57%. This gesture-based interface significantly enhances operational safety, reduces operator fatigue, and lowers the risk of human error. Future improvements will focus on expanding the gesture library, reducing latency, and scaling for complex industrial use cases.

title: AI-Driven OEE Monitoring System for Industrial IoT: Design and Experimental Validation
venue: 2026 5th International Conference on Computer Networks, Big Data and IoT (ICCBI)
abstract: In this paper, a predictive overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) monitoring system in the context of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) has been implemented. The proposed OEE monitoring system aims to solve the different problems like latency, the lack of real-time visibility, and human error in the OEE measurements. The proposed OEE monitoring system is based on the implementation of a Python-driven hardware-in- the-loop (HIL) simulation environment and the development of a three-tier processing architecture using MQTT communication protocols. The proposed OEE monitoring system is also based on the implementation of a dual-model artificial intelligence (AI) framework using Isolation Forest and LSTM neural networks for anomaly detection and predictive fault forecasting, respec- tively [10], [11]. Furthermore, the authors proposed a predictive Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) workflow that allows the automatic generation of 5-Why reports in 30 seconds after the occurrence of any fault in the IIoT environment. The proposed OEE monitoring system is validated using a hybrid stochastic simulation environment with the following performance metrics: a 95.0% F1-score for anomaly detection, 73.5 minutes of predictive lead time, and 21.5% OEE improvement.

title: AI-Driven Optimization of Ring Spinning: Adaptive Spacer Adjustment for Enhanced Yarn Quality and Production Efficiency
venue: 2024 7th International Conference on Algorithms, Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI)
abstract: This study investigates the optimization of ring frame parameters, particularly focusing on the effects of spacer size on yarn quality-specifically strength, evenness, imperfections, and hairiness. Additionally, a novel AI-Driven Adaptive Spacer Adjustment System is introduced, which dynamically adjusts spacer size during the spinning process based on real-time sensor data. This combined analysis includes trials on 40 Ne and 60 Ne yarn counts with six different spacer sizes (2.75 mm to 4 mm) and an evaluation of machine efficiency improvements for 9 combed wool and 24 carded counts. The AI system uses a combination of optical sensors, reinforcement learning (PPO), support vector regression (SVR), and convolutional neural networks (CNN) to continuously monitor and optimize yarn quality and process efficiency. The results show significant improvements in yarn quality and productivity through both conventional spacer size optimization and the integration of AI-driven automation. The AI system offers real-time adjustments that enhance yarn quality and reduce production inefficiencies. This research provides a transformative approach to spinning process optimization by combining cutting-edge AI technology with traditional manufacturing techniques.

title: AI-Driven Outcome-Based Education for Complex Problem-Solving: Technical Framework and Practical Exploration of Micro-Course Clusters
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 International Conference on AI-Enabled Education
abstract: This paper proposes an AI-integrated Outcome-Based Education (OBE) framework that combines backward design with micro-course clusters to enhance complex problem-solving (CPS) competencies in higher education. The technical architecture integrates three core computer technologies: (1) Python-based system dynamics simulation algorithms for mapping interdisciplinary variables; (2) machine learning optimization using Scikit-learn to predict student CPS development trends; and (3) IoT edge computing via Arduino-Raspberry Pi communication for real-time project monitoring. A 18-week empirical study with 180 undergraduates validated the model: AI-driven real-time feedback loops improved CPS competency gains by 42%, with 91% of capstone projects meeting industry deployment standards. This framework bridges academia-industry gaps in AI education through actionable technical design.

title: AI-Driven Prediction of Flexural Properties in Kevlar/Carbon/Glass Fiber Hybrid Composites Using Random Forest Regression
venue: 2026 IEEE 5th International Conference on AI in Cybersecurity (ICAIC)
abstract: The research introduces a methodology to predict the flexural behavior of a laminate before conducting any experimental tests. To derive such a model, an artificial intelligence (AI)-based learning process was adopted. More specifically, a Random Forest regression model was trained to identify the nonlinear behavior associated between the laminate stacking sequence, the fiber properties, and its flexural response, based on the flexural test dataset. To practically implement this AI–predictive approach, an interactive, real-time interface was set up via a Python package, Streamlit, a tool that can be used to visualize flexural strength and deflection under different stacking sequences. In this way, both laminate material selection and experimental design can be more efficiently informed. In addition to visualizing flexural performance metrics, this approach allows the identification of the important features based on the model's feature-importance functionality. As part of this study, mechanical testing was also conducted on various hybrid laminates ([K/G/C/C/G/K], [C/G/K/K/G/C], and [G/C/K/K/C/G]) and non-hybrid laminates ([K]₆, [G]₆, [C]₆). The flexural strength and flexural modulus of all the laminate configurations were determined to confirm the predicted model and to study the influence of stacking sequence on mechanical performance. The results showed that the flexural strength of the [C/G/K/K/G/C] laminate (3.07 MPa) was the highest among all the laminates, and the contribution of hybridization is confirmed. The AI–experimental framework described in this study paves the way for future efforts to accelerate composite optimization and minimize material waste and provides a reliable AI-assisted design tool for high-performance fiber-reinforced laminates.

title: AI-Driven Valorization of a Large Repository of Raw Industrial Network Recordings Using NL2SQL
venue: 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Measurement in Networking and Communications (MNC)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0, industrial plants generate a massive volume of network data, most of which is discarded after its primary control function has been fulfilled, becoming dark data. This article presents an innovative framework to valorize this data, e.g., for predictive maintenance and security. We propose an automated pipeline that extracts 36 key metrics from raw Packet Capture (PCAP) files using a custom Python-based ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) process and stores them in a relational PostgreSQL database. To bridge the gap between complex network data and human operators, we integrate a Large Language Model (LLM) using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This enables a Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) interface, allowing technicians to query network health and anomalies using plain language. An experimental setup using validation data from PROFINET networks in the automotive industry was implemented, and the correctness of the answers to selected requests was validated by human experts. Results demonstrate that, while the initial data parsing is computationally intensive (1.85 GB/h), AI-assisted querying provides accurate, real-time insights while ensuring local data privacy, with a maximum response time on the order of 40 s, less than 3 MB of traffic exchanged with the cloud-hosted LLM engine, and about 10 kB of traffic exchanged with the locally hosted database for the most demanding question about failed validation tests.

title: AI-Driven Virtual Mock Interview Development
venue: 2024 Joint 13th International Conference on Soft Computing and Intelligent Systems and 25th International Symposium on Advanced Intelligent Systems (SCIS&ISIS)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into educational technologies marks a significant shift in learning methodologies and operational dynamics within educational institutions. At the forefront is an AI-driven virtual mock interview platform designed to address the high Customer Acquisition Costs (CAC) in the edtech sector, especially for interview preparation services. This initiative harnesses a blend of AI technologies, including ADA 2 for creating context-aware embeddings and Machine Learning (ML), to transform the traditional mock interview process into a dynamic, cost-effective system. Central to the platform is its use of advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and GPT-4 Large Language Model (LLM), automating the process of mock interviews and providing personalized feedback, ensuring a preparation journey that meets specific candidate needs and mirrors real interview scenarios. A key evaluation among 100 students from a cohort of 1800 demonstrated a 90% cost reduction for three mock interviews, reducing expenses from ₹3000 to just ₹300 per candidate. This cost efficiency significantly enhances access to quality interview preparation, improving student satisfaction and accessibility. Moreover, the platform provides valuable insights into student performance, setting a new standard in educational technology by offering an effective, personalized interview preparation experience. This project reflects a holistic approach to student development and the critical role of technology in addressing the evolving needs of learners

title: AI-enabled Coal Supply Chain Financial Credit Assessment and Loan Optimization Based on Multi-source Data Fusion
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 2nd International Conference on Digital Economy, Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence
abstract: In response to the problem of incomplete credit assessment caused by multi-source data silos in the current coal supply chain finance field, this study proposes an AI-enabled credit assessment and loan optimization system under multi-source data fusion. By constructing a four-dimensional data fusion layer (production-end sensor data, logistics GPS trajectory, transaction electronic invoice, and external price/policy data), using knowledge graphs to model the supply chain topology network, and using federated learning to achieve cross-enterprise data privacy protection. A hybrid AI evaluation model is designed, integrating LightGBM/XGBoost to process structured data and GNN to extract supply chain guarantee relationship characteristics, and combined with SHAP interpretable analysis to reveal that inventory turnover rate and price fluctuation sensitivity are core risk factors. The innovative introduction of reinforcement learning dynamic credit algorithm allows the credit limit to be adjusted in real time with coal price fluctuations, and the deployment of blockchain smart contracts enables automatic loan release after goods delivery. Empirical evidence shows that the system has increased the credit assessment F1 value to 91.2%, reduced the bad debt rate to 1.18%, and shortened the loan decision-making time to 2.1 hours, providing a new paradigm of data collaborative governance and intelligent decision-making for coal supply chain financial risk management.

title: AI-Enabled Design and Implementation of a Mobile Crane Monitoring Communication Terminal
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 8th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Artificial Intelligence
abstract: This paper presents an AI-enabled monitoring and communication terminal for mobile cranes to enhance remote supervision and fault management. The system integrates a Cortex-M3 microcontroller, Python-based software, GPRS wireless communication, GPS positioning, and CAN bus data acquisition. A standardized SMS protocol enables reliable data exchange with the backend server. An AI-driven model is incorporated to analyze real-time operational data, identify risks, and support early fault warnings. System testing confirms stable performance, accurate data transmission, and effective risk detection. The proposed solution improves operational safety, maintenance efficiency, and intelligent equipment management for crane manufacturers.

title: AI-Enabled Zero-Trust Security for Omnichannel CRM Platforms
venue: 2026 6th International Conference on Image Processing and Capsule Networks (ICIPCN)
abstract: This paper explores the implementation of ZeroTrust Architecture (ZTA) and AI to help augment cyber-handshakes in omnichannel CRM frameworks. As these businesses become more reliant on systems connected to run the customer experience across multiple channels, the attack surface for possible penetration swells. This study introduces a novel security model using continuous authentication, least-privilege access model and AI-based anomaly detection it manages to reduce unauthorized data exfiltration threats. For the experiment it uses a synthetic dataset with 457 data samples which model various user login behaviors, transaction sequences and API access logs. Simulation in Python, predictive modeling using TensorFlow and visualization with Tableau were used to investigate the effectiveness of the proposed controls. Results show that ZTA by itself combined with listen/watch real-time AI monitoring is an excellent deterrent, significantly cutting down false positives and speeding up response to incidents. CRM and similar platforms whose defenses have traditionally been perimeter, and static-based benefit greatly from a more dynamic, identity-aware security, it makes them much more resilient. The results offer actionable advice for IT architects and security compliance officers who want to secure their customer data ecosystems against modern cyber threats, without jeopardizing a frictionless user experience.

title: AI-Enhanced Portfolio Optimization Framework Leveraging Modern Portfolio Theory
venue: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The current investment portfolio management methodology demands persistent market surveillance as well as advanced research abilities along with specialized competencies. Traditional portfolio management approaches depend on manual data collection through inspection while experts can still make human judgements that impact the results. Our work presents an innovative Python platform designed to automate portfolio management knowledge enhancement for beginner and advanced investors. The software consists of four key features that assist with monitoring liquid assets while performing yield-based bond assessments and tracking equity portfolios and optimizing asset distributions through Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT). Our system connects to Yahoo Finance and Alpha Vantage APIs to provide up-to-date financial data used in making data-based investments decisions. Successful portfolio management in uncertain market environments depends on this combination of computational systems and existing financial knowledge with real-time market data.

title: AI-MEFDES: AI-based Multi-class Early Fire Detection and Extinguishing System
venue: 2024 Advances in Science and Engineering Technology International Conferences (ASET)
abstract: This paper presents an implementation of deep learning-based Multi-class Early Fire Detection and Extinguishing System on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin development kit as an enabler of future's smart cities buildings. We use YOLOv5 (You Only Look Once version 5) and Adafruit python libraries to implement detection and extinguishing system. A USB web-based camera is connected to Jetson AGX to take real-time video. Two servo motors are used to control the camera and targeting nozzles' tilt and pan. The motors are connected with Jetson AGX using Adafruit PCA9685 16-Channel Servo Driver interface. The developed system is tested in the lab and the college's annual project competition shows more than 80% accuracy.

title: AI-Powered Digital Twin System for Enhancing Energy Efficiency in Industrial Process Control
venue: 2026 4th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Communication Systems (ICKECS)
abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0, the focus of smart and efficient automation through the use of intelligence and the reduction of energy consumption becomes a prime requirement for modern industrial systems. In data-rich environments, the adaptability, scalability, and efficiency of traditional automation systems are often considered to be of lower value. In this context, this paper proposes the implementation of a Digital Twin-based framework with the inclusion of Federated Learning and artificial intelligence for the monitoring and automation of industrial process operations. The main aim of this research paper is to create a reliable automation system for controlling industrial operations with the simultaneous reduction of wastage of energy and improvement of the responsiveness of the overall system. In this context, the publicly available Energy Efficiency dataset was obtained from the Kaggle platform, and modeling was done using Python with TensorFlow, Pandas, and Matplotlib. The proposed method was able to attain an accuracy rate of 98.5%, which is higher than many existing benchmark methods. Various comparative graphs and graphical representations related to the energy parameters also depict the wide applicability of the proposed system, focusing on the importance of energy conservation. From the results, it is evident that the proposed system, which combines the concepts of Federated Learning and Digital Twins, is capable of providing better real-time insights, maintaining data privacy, and scaling up the automated industrial operations seamlessly. According to the researchers, the proposed method has significant potential to be implemented in the present industrial sector, focusing on the importance of efficient and environmentally friendly operations, overcoming the drawbacks of the conventional centralized monitoring methods. The results also help in the development of more intelligent automation, reducing the environmental hazards caused by industries

title: AI-Powered Image-based Missing Person Identification System
venue: 2025 Third International Conference on Augmented Intelligence and Sustainable Systems (ICAISS)
abstract: The increase in missing persons has turned into a global problem, burdening the authorities and frequently leaving families in anxiety. Posting circulars and submitting police reports, the traditional search techniques, are typically ineffective and time-consuming. We propose an AI-Powered Image-Based Missing Person Identification System that uses deep learning for quick facial recognition in order to assist with this. The fundamental component of the system is a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is trained on a variety of datasets to recognize and record face features in uploaded photographs. The recorded traits are compared to a database of people who have been reported missing or located. The model reduces false positives and improves search accuracy with its high precision and recall. Docker offers scalable deployment, and Python is used for backend development. Structured data is efficiently stored using PostgreSQL. Without requiring human involvement, the system is designed to automate the search process, including feature extraction, picture preprocessing, and real-time matching. When a possible match is found, real-time alerts are given via email and push notifications. Performance metrics such as F1-score, accuracy, and recall were used for model validation, and the findings show a significant improvement over traditional technique. Informed permission is used to gather photographs, and safe storage and encryption protect data privacy, all of which uphold ethical standards. This study provides a scalable, real-time solution that reunites missing people with their families in addition to demonstrating the effective use of AI in tackling humanitarian challenges.

title: AI-Powered Predictive Energy Monitoring System Using Open-Source Tools: A Smart Building Case Study with Node-RED and InfluxDB
venue: 2025 IEEE International Symposium on Future Telecommunication Technologies (SOFTT)
abstract: Short-term energy forecasting plays a critical role in optimizing power usage, improving operational efficiency, and reducing costs in modern smart buildings and industrial facilities. Accurate forecasts allow operators to plan production schedules, balance energy loads, and detect abnormal patterns before they escalate into costly inefficiencies. Despite the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence and Internet of Things technologies, integrated real-time systems that are both cost-effective and based on open-source tools remain limited, particularly in developing regions where proprietary platforms are financially prohibitive. This paper presents the design and implementation of an AI-powered predictive energy monitoring system that integrates Node-RED, InfluxDB, and Python-based machine learning in a modular and deployable architecture. Real-time energy data is collected from industrial-grade sensors and transmitted using MQTT, stored as time-series data in InfluxDB. A Random Forest regression model is employed to forecast short-term consumption based on sliding-window representations of historical patterns, while Linear Regression serves as a baseline for comparison. The system is deployed in a live industrial environment, operating continuously on a 24/7 basis. Experimental results demonstrate that the Random Forest model reduces RMSE and MAE by approximately 39% and 37%, respectively, compared to the baseline. These findings confirm the system’s effectiveness in capturing non-linear energy usage patterns. This work contributes a practical, low-cost, and replicable solution for real-time smart energy management using widely available open-source platforms, while also opening opportunities for future extensions such as anomaly detection and automated optimization.

title: AI-Powered Predictive Models in Human Resource Management for Employee Retention, Engagement, and Strategic Workforce Planning
venue: 2026 2nd International Conference on Sustainable Computing and Integrated Communication in Changing Landscape of AI (ICSCAI)
abstract: The proposed paper is the pioneer of the AI-Orchestrated Tool-Augmented Agents using a Model Context Protocol (MCP) that is aimed at improving decision-making in highly dynamic settings. Deep Learning-Based Missing Value Imputation is combined with Data Normalization in the methodology to guarantee the provision of high-quality inputs, by fixing unfinished or inaccurate data. Transformer-Based Attention Mechanism is also used to select features efficiently to allow the system to concentrate on the most appropriate data to enhance the performance of the model. Besides, a Multimodal Deep Neural Network (DNN) with Graph Neural Network (GNN) Fusion is applied to process and integrate a wide range of data types, including tabular, temporal, graph-based information, to capture more complex relationships and make improved decisions. The framework is implemented in Python on PyTorch, is scalable, and the it has low-latency real-time inference. The experimental findings indicate that the suggested solution is more accurate, efficient, and adaptable to traditional solutions, and it is a promising solution to intelligent and autonomous systems.

title: AI-Powered Sign Language Recognition and Production System for Inclusive Communication
venue: 2026 6th International Conference on Inventive Computation and Information Technologies (ICICIT)
abstract: Human communication is important, but individuals with speech and hearing impairments frequently face major challenges, particularly in situations when sign language translators are not accessible. The proposed project aims to address this gap by offering a complete, real-time Sign Language Recognition and Production System (SLRPS) that facilitates communication between the hearing and hearing-impaired groups. The system will be constructed with the help of computer vision and deep learning, namely MediaPipe Holistic, OpenCV, and an LSTM- based neural network to identify gestures perfectly. A custom dataset of signaling gestures was made, processed and stored in NumPy format, which guaranteed easy management of temporal sequence data. sign gestures. To the production side, the system is used to translate spoken or typed text into sign language using pre-recorded videos or animated gestures allowing it to be reachable in both directions. Python was used to implement the backend which uses Tensorflow, Flask and MongoDB with cloud integration through Google drive and the front end is implemented in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The user friendly interface is capable of real-time gesture input and output, text display and text-to-speech. This system shows that it has great potential in the educational, medical, and utility fields to enhance inclusive communication.

title: AI-Powered Sinhala Sign Language Communication Platform for Inclusive Learning and Enhanced Safety
venue: 2026 IEEE 18th International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Networks (CICN)
abstract: Communication barriers remain a significant challenge for deaf, hearing-impaired, and speech-disabled individuals in Sri Lanka, particularly due to limited awareness of Sinhala Sign Language and the lack of accessible tools for everyday interaction. Existing solutions mainly focus on isolated tasks such as sign learning or unilateral translation, and fail to support real-time communication, emotional expression, and environmental awareness within an integrated system. To bridge this gap, this research proposes an intelligent Sinhala sign language communication platform with emotion recognition and environmental awareness. The system integrates four main components into a single platform. A sign language reader interprets hand gestures, facial expressions, and body postures in real time to convert the signs into Sinhala text. An adaptive learning system provides personalized sign language training through AI-driven feedback and curriculum adaptation. An environmental sound alert module detects critical sounds, such as sirens and vehicle horns and provides visual alerts to improve user safety. Additionally, a two-way communication module enables practical daily interaction between children with speaking disabilities and their parents using visual and sign-based communication. Techniques for recognizing emotions are integrated to enhance contextual comprehension and expressive interaction. The proposed system demonstrates improved communication efficiency, learning engagement, and situational awareness. Overall, the system highlights the potential for creating user-centric communication solutions by combining artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction.

title: AI-Powered Smart Defect Detection System for Printed Circuit Boards
venue: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent & Innovative Practices in Engineering & Management (IIPEM)
abstract: In electronics manufacturing companies PCB defect detection is needed to see the quality of products whether it is good. basically in which this process is done by people and machine in which this takes so much time and also it is expensive. So overcome this problem ,we have implemented Smart Defect Detection System that can detect the PCB issue by using AI. In which we have used two models YOLOv11, MobileNet. YOLOv11 model is used for detecting the surface area problem like missing components, misalignment parts, solder bridges. MobileNet Model is basically used for checking the internal circuit patterns, in which small and hidden defects can be detected. These two models are combined with OpenCV and python to make a low cost and efficient inspection tool. In which it includes Graphical User Interface(GUI) so that non technical user can also able to upload the PCB images and can see the defected issues in the screen. This helps mainly for small electronic manufacturing companies where we can reduce their cost. In increases accuracy, reducing human errors and in which it makes the inspection process faster and reliable. the experiment result shows it is a good balance between performance, cost, flexibility, making it suitable for real time application.

title: AI-Powered Virtual Reality: Transforming Education Beyond Conventional Approaches
venue: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent Control, Computing and Communications (IC3)
abstract: This study assesses a Virtual Reality (VR) application that aims to improve students' comprehension of Python collection data types and structures in electrical and electronic engineering. The application allows students to engage with virtual representations of intricate programming concepts in an immersive setting by incorporating gamification and personalization features. Using wit.ai and Meta Voice SDK, a virtual assistant and example generator dynamically modify learning paths and examples according to user performance to promote interaction and engagement. In a user study with 48 participants split into two groups, the efficacy of the VR application and conventional pamphlets was compared. To gauge their levels of engagement and attention, both groups wore electroencephalography (EEG) headsets. Pre- and post-study scores showed that VR users' comprehension of Python collections had improved statistically significantly. In addition, the VR group's EEG analysis showed higher levels of engagement and attention than the paper-based group. These results highlight how immersive virtual reality (VR) technology can maintain focus and improve learning outcomes in software development courses.

title: AI-Powered Workout Analysis Application for Posture Feedback and Repitition Grading
venue: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The AI-powered exercise tracking system presented in this project represents a new approach to revolutionize fitness routines using cutting-edge technologies. Leveraging advanced computer vision techniques, particularly pose estimation, the system offers real-time tracking and analysis of exercise repetitions during gym workouts. Focused initially on four fundamental exercises like Bicep Curls, Push-Ups, Squats, and Shoulder Press. The proposed system employs Machine Learning (ML) models to detect and classify correct and incorrect exercise forms. Integrating the power of Mediapipe's pose detection framework and speech recognition capabilities, the proposed system provides accurate feedback and guidance to users through a smart web application interface. Through the selection of a tech stack including Python, OpenCV, Streamlit, and Scikit-Learn, the system ensures seamless data processing, model training, and user interaction. By analyzing workout videos uploaded by users, the proposed system identifies and highlights areas of improvement in exercise technique, enhancing the effectiveness and safety of fitness routines. Moreover, the integration of speech recognition enables hands-free control, adding convenience and accessibility for users during their workouts. This research study not only aims to optimize individual fitness journeys but also contributes to advancing the field of fitness tracking through the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and computer vision technologies. By empowering users with personalized feedback and guidance, the proposed system promotes healthier habits, improved performance, and overall well-being.

title: AI-Predictive Analytic Model in Identifying Learning Gaps
venue: 2026 ICEENG International Conference for Innovations in Intelligent Computing and Cybersecurity (IICC)
abstract: AI-powered predictive analytics systems have become critical for measuring and forecasting student learning performance by identifying and resolving inadequacies. Our main objective is to develop and train an AI predictive analytic model able to diagnose and identify severity of the learning gaps of the students enrolled in studying parasitology. Random Forest Classifier was used to develop two models. The first one was trained with the real-world dataset collected from 132 medical students. Due to small sample size of original data, a second model was created using synthetically generated data to ensure class balance. A custom Python script was used to generate 4000 samples (1000 for each severity class) based on the original question structure. 5-fold cross-validation approach was applied Both models showed accepted predictive power. Model 1 is ideal for academic evaluation. It is based on real data and reflects actual student behavior. Model 2 is suitable for practical deployment. Its performance is stronger due to balanced, synthetic data, and it is more stable for real-time applications, such as a prediction interface.

title: AI/ML-Enabled Gluing Using Cobots
venue: 2026 28th International Conference on Digital Signal Processing and its Applications (DSPA)
abstract: Traditional gluing processes in manufacturing rely heavily on human labor or rigid jigs to hold parts in fixed orientations, resulting in high costs, reduced flexibility, and inconsistent reliability over long- term usage. To address this challenge, an AI/ML-enabled gluing system using a collaborative robot (UR3) was developed. The system integrates a RealSense camera with YOLOv8- based object detection to identify multiple distinct features on a part, enabling accurate $\mathbf{3 6 0}$-degree orientation estimation without the use of markers. A custom Python script synchronizes the robot's motion planning in RoboDK with real-time vision data, dynamically transforming reference frames and aligning curves to the actual part position and rotation. Once alignment is achieved, a glue dispenser controlled via robot I/O applies adhesive precisely along predefined contours. This eliminates the need for manual alignment and expensive fixturing or jigs, while providing high accuracy,robustness, and industrial practicality. Developed in response to a problem statement from leading research organizations like DRDO and HAL, the system demonstrates an indigenous, stable, and scalable alternative to previously explored but unsuccessful ROS and point-cloud-based tracking methods.

title: Air Threat Defense System from Unidentified Drones Using Multi-Sensor AI
venue: Proceedings of the 2026 15th International Conference on Informatics, Environment, Energy and Applications
abstract: The rapid proliferation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has posed critical challenges to airspace security, particularly in detecting and identifying small, low-altitude drones under complex environmental and electromagnetic conditions. This research presents an AI-driven multi-sensor air defense framework that integrates radar, acoustic, radio-frequency (RF), and vision sensing into a unified deep-learning-based detection and response system designed for real-world scalability and networked deployment. The proposed framework employs multi-sensor fusion algorithms built upon Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Transformer architectures, and Gaussian-Mixture Probability Hypothesis Density (GM-PHD) multi-target tracking. Data from heterogeneous sensors are synchronized through a low-latency communication layer based on UDP, MQTT, and ROS2 protocols, enabling real-time data fusion, classification, and threat prioritization. To expand detection coverage and reduce transmission power requirements, the system utilizes multiple distributed detection nodes that convert radar signals into digitized data and transmit them across a computer network for centralized fusion and decision-making. A hybrid MATLAB–Python simulation environment was developed to evaluate both sensor-level and network-level performance. MATLAB modules generate radar waveforms and simulate range–Doppler responses over multiple frequency bands (2.4–10 GHz) and transmission power levels, while Python (Colab) performs deep-learning-based feature extraction, acoustic and RF analysis, and data visualization. The experiment includes frequency and power sweep simulations to investigate how variations in transmitted power and operating frequency affect detection range, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and target classification accuracy. title: Air Watcher
venue: 2024 IEEE VII Congreso Internacional en Inteligencia Ambiental, Ingeniería de Software y Salud Electrónica y Móvil (AmITIC)
abstract: Real-time air quality monitoring using Python involves obtaining air quality data from open sources, such as the WAQI (World Air Quality Index) API, which provides information on the concentrations of various pollutants, such as PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, O3 and CO. Once collected, this data is processed using Python to ensure its integrity and convert it into a format suitable for analysis. Subsequently, the Air Quality Index (AQI) is calculated, which synthesizes air quality into a single value, facilitating its interpretation. To visualize the data, libraries such as Plotly Express are used, which allow the generation of interactive bar graphs that represent contaminant concentrations in a clear and understandable way. The user interface is developed using Dash, a Python plugin that allows you to create interactive web applications. This interface allows users to select continents and countries, view air quality data, and update information in real time using a refresh button. If data is available continuously, the application ensures that visualizations stay up to date, always providing the most recent information.

title: Air-Cooled Battery Pack Thermal Management via Control Barrier Proximal Dynamics
venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
abstract: Efficient thermal management in lightweight electric mobility systems is critical for battery safety, performance, and longevity. However, challenges remain due to cost and weight constraints and limited onboard computational resources. In battery packs composed of hundreds of cells, lumped-parameter models fail to capture spatial temperature variations, while high-fidelity models render real-time, optimization-based control computationally intractable. This work addresses these challenges through: 1) a modular, conservation-based electrothermal graph model that balances fidelity and tractability; 2) a computationally scalable control strategy, called control barrier proximal dynamics (CBPD), which closely approximates safe and optimal control barrier function (CBF)-based controllers with major improvements in computational efficiency. We further extend CBPD to ensure safety under input disturbances and modeling uncertainties via an input-to-state safe (ISSf) and robust formulation. As a candidate system, we consider a fan-cooled lithium-ion battery pack in the University of Minnesota’s solar electric vehicle (EV), comprising 1296 cells. We validate the thermal model on this system and apply the CBPD controller on the model under realistic operational scenarios. The results demonstrate strict safety constraint satisfaction, performance comparable to intensive optimization-based methods, computational efficiency on par with classic controllers, and robustness to parameter variations.
