title: Design and Implementation of Video Surveillance Quality Inspection System
venue: 2023 International Conference on Machine Vision, Image Processing and Imaging Technology (MVIPIT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a camera surveillance picture quality inspection system. The system assesses the video stream from surveillance cameras and provides immediate feedback on image quality. Development encompasses Java multi-threading, database utilization and modular design dependent on requirements. The system’s architecture and process analysis are completed, enabling the system function to be realized. The results of the application indicate that the system can promptly and precisely evaluate the real-time image quality of the video stream from surveillance equipment, precisely tally equipment asset usage information, enhance the management efficiency and inspection quality of operations and maintenance staff, and guarantee the surveillance screen’s effectiveness.

title: Design and implementation of Web service integration tool
venue: IEEE International Workshop on Service-Oriented System Engineering (SOSE'05)
abstract: WWW (World Wide Web) has become the richest resource pool of services and information. But most of services (e.g. real time stock quote information and Web mail service) are independent and distributed. If we need a new Web service that sends us an email when some stock quote reaches a specific price, a Web service integration tool is needed to compose the Web stock quote information with the Web mail service. This paper proposes a convenient and powerful integration tool to seamlessly integrate the existing Web services into new services. Our tool, called Web service integration tool (WSIT), provides the functionalities to record and modulize existing Web services, to design, modify and compose recorded Web services, and to play and test the new composed Web services.

title: Design and Implementation of Web Services Oriented GPRS Remote Meter Reading Model
venue: 2009 International Conference on Information Management, Innovation Management and Industrial Engineering
abstract: Based on the research on a power company remote meter reading system and for the purpose of enhancing the management level of the meter reading of power companies, the web services oriented GPRS remote meter reading model is suggested. By means of the Web Services technology, the model is integrated with various related heterogeneous systems and application seamlessly; simultaneity through the JNLP(Java Network Launch Protocol) specifications, the deployment and maintenance of the system can be simplified much; The real-time and reliable front-end based on the GSM/GPRS(Global System for Mobile Communications/General Packet Radio Service) network is implemented by Java multi-threading and socket technology. As an example of reading "the present three-phase voltage and current" of one remote transformer meter, this paper will give the model design and key codes based on the latest Java Web Services specifications JAX-WS(Java API for XML-based Web Services) and the JNLP specification. The model designed meets the actual requirements well, and accords with the standards of State Grid Corporation. The model has a favorable application in the actual remote meter reading system of the power companies.

title: Design and Implementation of Web-Based Control Laboratory for Test Rigs in Geographically Diverse Locations
venue: IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics
abstract: This paper compares current remote laboratories and describes the design and implementation of the Networked Control System Laboratory (NCSLab) in the University of Glamorgan on http://www/ncslab.net, which provides a unified and flexible Web-based interface to access test rigs located in different countries of the world. All the test rigs are connected and managed together by the NCSLab system. They are well cataloged by their characteristics, and their geographical locations are not necessarily known to the users. A three-layer structure, which consists of the main server, subservers, and test rigs, is adopted to organize the distributed facilities. All the control algorithms for the test rigs are generated by using the Matlab Real-time Workshop. Users can design and implement their own control algorithms for the test rigs. The Web interface is designed using Java JSP/Servlet technology which gives the users great flexibility, including remote tuning, remote monitoring (both data and videos), and remote control logics. In order to manage the massive information and support concurrent access, MySQL database is also integrated into the system.

title: Design and Implementation on Intelligent Scheduling System for Computer Laboratory Management
venue: 2025 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Technologies in Education (CSTE)
abstract: In the context of the growing prevalence of educational automation, laboratory teaching management is facing increasingly complex challenges driven by the demands of new technologies. However, traditional manual scheduling methods and existing scheduling systems have revealed several limitations in practical application, including their inability to accommodate adjustments and changes in teaching plans, lack of transparency in scheduling information, and inefficiencies in resource sharing. To address these issues, we have developed a Java-Web-based intelligent scheduling system. This system not only offers a more user-friendly interface and robust data analytics capabilities, but also employs reinforcement learning algorithms to quantitatively evaluate scheduling effectiveness, thereby optimizing laboratory resource utilization and course arrangements. The system can automate most routine scheduling tasks, significantly alleviating the workload of administrators. Compared to existing automated laboratory scheduling software, our system demonstrates significant advantages in both scheduling accuracy and efficiency. This positions it as a more intelligent, precise, and efficient solution for higher education management.

title: Design and Module Simulation of a Smart Parking System Based On QR Code and Drone Monitoring for Open-Space Temporary Parking Lots
venue: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: To solve the problem of low parking efficiency and poor management in open temporary parking lots, a smart parking system was designed based on QR code and drone monitoring technologies. The system consists of four modules: parking spot QR code module, drone photography module, data processing module, and user interface module. Functional simulation of each module in the system was carried out by experiments with software programming. The capture of QR codes was achieved by fixed-point drone photography. Programmed with Python, the main system could successfully decipher QR codes, gather the occupancy status of parking spots and update the status as well. Then the user interface module could help users to make decisions on parking spots by presenting the parking status in different colors via a program written with Autoit3. The results show that this system is userfriendly, capable to be deployed at a low cost in a short time, and remains stable when running over a certain period. In the meantime, the occupancy status of the parking spots can be detected and recorded smoothly and readily, suggesting that this technology will have a wide range of applications in future.

title: Design and realization of a network management information system based on JAVA
venue: 2009 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Information Technology
abstract: Along with the emergence of WWW, JAVA and XML, etc, the network management system based on JAVA has become a hot issue in present research and it put forward realization methods of some corresponding technologies, such as network topology search discovery and topology reconfiguration based on SNMP protocol (routing table), ARP protocol and ICMP protocol, access processing of SNMP, information structure of MIB and acquisition of information based on MIB, search and real-time functions of application server and network service monitoring, etc.

title: Design and Realize Communication System Based on LAN of C/S Architecture
venue: 2009 WRI World Congress on Software Engineering
abstract: Researching for practical network communication technology, this paper designs a network communication system running under the C/S (client/server) mode. Based on the socket communication, the network communication part adopts TCP/IP protocol and UDP protocol. By the system, users in LAN could communicate with each other in real time, conveniently and safely, the function of sending instructions and transferring files between users can be realized.

title: Design and Testing in Laboratory Environment of the Embedded Microsystem ECAM
venue: 2006 IEEE International Conference on Automation, Quality and Testing, Robotics
abstract: The paper presents an embedded control and acquisition microsystem for advanced industrial applications, where small size, small power consumption and reliability play an important role. The embedded system was designed, realised and tested in laboratory environment based on experiments involving remote control. In order to test the platform, a real small transportation and sorting installation, connected with the simulated cyclic production of a manufacturing cell were utilised. The application was implemented using two main programs: A Java program that simulates the flexible manufacturing system and the LabVIEW programs (VIs) destined to the wireless acquisition of signals from sensors and to command the actuator of conveyer. The VIs were loaded from a PC with Windows operating system and LabVIEW Real Time in order to accomplish the acquisition of the output signals from sensors and to transmit commands to the actuator. The two programs communicate using TCP protocol.

title: Design and Testing of two secure Video Conferencing applications based on JMF (Java Media Framework) and VIC (Video Conferencing Tool)
venue: International Conference on Digital Telecommunications (ICDT'06)
abstract: We present two secure real-time video conferencing solutions with JPEG coding using a cipher engine based on the Blowfish algorithm. One of these solutions is developed from Java media framework (JMF). In this case, our solution consists of encrypting frames coded with JPEG that are later encapsulated in packets of the RTP protocol (H. Schulzrinne et al., 1996) (real time transport protocol). Our cipher system is based on the Blowfish algorithm (B. Schneier, 1994) of the Cryptix open source cryptographic software library. Another solution is developed from VIC (video conferencing tool) (S. McCanne and V. Jacobson, 1995). In this case, our solution consists of encrypting the UDP packets that contain the JPEG coded frames incorporated in RTP packets. In this paper we analyse the solutions proposed and test the implementations developed in different data networks (LAN/WLAN, frame relay)

title: Design error - the enemy of safe and robust control systems
venue: 2012 IV International Congress on Ultra Modern Telecommunications and Control Systems
abstract: The design of control systems was investigated in a 2012 study to determine the factors causing design error in control technologies. Designers and end-users from around the world were surveyed to investigate those stages during the design process where errors can occur that later emerge as design-induced errors for network controllers in safety critical industries. The survey results were then checked and validated in face-to-face interviews with Australian designers and network controllers. As might be expected, the greatest risks of error are perceived to occur during the concept development and testing stages of the design process, with lower levels of risk occurring during the writing of specifications, development and engineering, and implementation stages. The results of this study are informing the development of a series of tests that can be applied during the design process of new control systems to mitigate control error.

title: Design for Exhibition System Based on RFID
venue: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Many of visitors would be left stranded in the exhibition or traveling area, which might cause traffic jam and bring big pressure to organizer or operator. If the organizer can realize the number of visitor in every venues on time, then the visitors may be guided, and moreover should be provided with 'Personalized Tour Guide' according to their preferences. This paper advances a new exhibition information system based on RFID, which is provided with language translator, information classifier and multi-media entertainment, and elaborates the design from several aspects including system architecture, functional modules, data model and interface. The design in this paper is thought over loosely- coupling characteristic of system, and is specifically devised for The 2010 World Exposition at Shanghai (WES), and it is intended to extend to other occasions like tourism, banking, club, chain-store operation, and net-bars, etc.

title: Design methodologies for securing cyber-physical systems
venue: Proceedings of the 10th International Conference on Hardware/Software Codesign and System Synthesis
abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are in most cases safety- and mission-critical. Standard design techniques used for securing embedded systems are not suitable for CPS due to the restricted computation and communication budget available in the latter. In addition, the sensitivity of sensed data and the presence of actuation components further increase the security requirements of CPS. To address these issues, it is necessary to provide new design methods in which security is considered from the beginning of the whole design flow and addressed in a holistic way. In this paper, we focus on the design of secure CPS as part of the complete CPS design process, and provide insights into new requirements on platform-aware design of control components, design methodologies and architectures posed by CPS design. We start by discussing methods for the multi-disciplinary modeling, simulation, tools, and software synthesis challenges for CPS. We also present a framework for design of secure control systems for CPS, while taking into account properties of the underlying computation and communication platforms. Finally, we describe the security challenges in the computing hardware that is used in CPS.

title: Design of a comprehensive management and monitoring platform for the operation and security of power information systems
venue: Proceedings of the 2023 International Conference on Communication Network and Machine Learning
abstract: In order to achieve the development goals of world-class enterprises in the new situation, it is necessary to transform the thinking of information system operation and maintenance management, and establish an efficient and real-time information operation and maintenance supervision system. This paper analyzes the information operation and maintenance management needs of power grid enterprises, and combines mainstream information equipment supervision technology architectures at home and abroad to determine the key technologies and system architecture for the development of this system. In the system design and implementation phase of this project, an object-oriented technology architecture was adopted, with Java as the development language and ORACLE as the backend database for system function development. The integration with other systems was achieved by calling XML files through JMS (Java Message Service). The B/S three-layer architecture implementation pattern effectively improved the scalability and maintainability of the system. This paper analyzes the specific functional requirements of each module and designs and implements the four main functions of the information system operation and maintenance comprehensive supervision platform. The successful implementation of the comprehensive supervision platform for information system operation and maintenance provides strong support for the normal operation of the company's business system. By establishing a stable, efficient, and flexible information system operation and maintenance management system, it effectively ensures the safe, continuous, reliable, and effective operation of information infrastructure, and provides a solid foundation for achieving the company's strategic goals.

title: Design of a Digital Platform for the Grand Canal National Cultural Park Based on the B/S Structure
venue: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This article proposes an efficient and secure overall framework construction technology for the platform. Based on the B/S structure, this article innovatively develops a new system, effectively addressing the limitations in data processing and reducing server overload and maintenance costs. In terms of programming technology, the lightweight and customizable development is achieved by adopting the SSM framework (Spring MVC, Spring, MyBatis) based on J2EE. The platform design includes a real-time monitoring module and a data module, integrating advanced technologies such as drones and remote sensing, and ensuring data security and efficient collection through data encryption and 3S technology. The archive management adopts MySQL, MongoDB, and TDengine to meet the diverse data storage needs. This research provides strong technical support for platform construction.

title: Design of a Distributed Collaborative Chinese Medicine Treatment Platform
venue: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As an important traditional culture in China, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) not only represents the characteristics of Chinese medical science, but also highlights the advantages of independent innovation. In recent years, the rapid growth of TCM medical record data has accelerated the digitalization and informatization of medical information. The traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment platform is often trapped in the dilemma of high data reading and storage delay and inability to effectively visualize the data in big data processing, and its computing efficiency and system practicability cannot be significantly improved. A distributed collaborative Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment platform is proposed in this paper, which is controlled by the STM32F407 series microcontroller, supplemented by ADS1292 module to measure ECG signal and TFTLCD LCD display. In the platform, the data is transmitted to the system server through WIFI module, and the MySQL technology combined with java is used to develop the system web side. The doctor can consult with the patient face to face and view the patient’s condition in real time through the web terminal. The collected ECG signal is displayed on the consultation interface through the pulse rate and the recovered pulse rate graph. Through the measurement of the module and the interaction on the web side, this paper can better simulate the "look", "smell", "ask" and "cut" way of diagnosis and treatment. The paper is able to simulate the "look", "smell", "ask" and "cut" methods of diagnosis and treatment, and realise remote Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment.

title: Design of a Full-Cycle Intelligent Risk Control System for Pre-Loan, Mid-Loan, and Post-Loan Lending: AI-Driven Closed-Loop Management of Online Credit Security
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 2nd International Conference on Digital Economy and Computer Science
abstract: Focusing on online lending, this paper develops an AI risk control framework encompassing all stages of the loan process, from pre-loan to mid-loan to post-loan. This framework implements an event-driven data loop, in which business results enter the feature and model training phase every minute to ensure real-time strategy updates. This effort aims to overcome the limitations of traditional logistic regression and survival models. This paper proposes a deep multi-task architecture that combines a time series encoder and a relationship graph encoder to model behavioral sequences and relationship risks separately, outputting PD, LGD, EAD, and risk rate. Temperature scaling and Dirichlet posterior calibration are implemented on the validation set to enhance probability stability. SHAP, Integrated Gradients, and GNNExplainer are used for decision interpretation, building a complete model governance and compliance evidence chain. This framework maintains auditability while significantly improving discrimination and calibration. Microservices-based deployment significantly reduces decision latency, enhancing security and dynamic optimization throughout the entire credit cycle.

title: Design of a Geographic Path Model for Dongguan Export Based on Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning and Supply Chain Simulation
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 5th International Conference on Internet of Things and Machine Learning
abstract: In the context of global supply chain restructuring and the deep implementation of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), this study addresses the geographic path optimization challenges faced by the Dongguan export manufacturing cluster. We propose a dynamic supply chain collaborative decision-making framework that integrates Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) with digital twin technology. Utilizing real-time customs clearance data from the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and global shipping dynamics for 2025, we build a three-layer interactive model comprising manufacturers, logistics providers, and customs regulators, thereby overcoming the limitations of traditional static path planning.The innovations of this research are reflected in three aspects:Design of Heterogeneous Agent Reward Mechanisms: The manufacturer agent aims to minimize carbon tariff costs by embedding a real-time accounting module for the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM).The experiments validate the model using real trade data from 300 Dongguan export enterprises for 2024-2025, showing that under the RCEP rules of origin constraints, the compliance rate of the generated pathways reaches 99.1%, avoiding potential tariff losses exceeding 230 million yuan. In response to the second blockage of the Suez Canal in 2025, the system reconstructs the entire network alternative solution within 43 seconds, improving decision-making efficiency by 270 times compared to manual processes. The interpretability AI module visualizes the agent gaming process, revealing the economic causes behind the emerging “Hong Kong transshipment - Vietnam land transport” route. This research provides algorithmic support for enhancing regional supply chain resilience under the “dual circulation” strategy, and the technical solution has been deployed in the Smart Port Brain System of Dongguan, contributing to the construction of a global logistics hub in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Mac

title: Design of a high-fidelity testing framework for secure electric grid control
venue: Proceedings of the Winter Simulation Conference 2014
abstract: A solution methodology and implementation components are presented that can uncover unwanted, unintentional or unanticipated effects on electric grids from changes to actual electric grid control software. A new design is presented to leapfrog over the limitations of current modeling and testing techniques for cyber technologies in electric grids. We design a fully virtualized approach in which actual, unmodified operational software under test is enabled to interact with simulated surrogates of electric grids. It enables the software to influence the (simulated) grid operation and vice versa in a controlled, high fidelity environment. Challenges in achieving such capability include achieving low-overhead time control mechanisms in hypervisor schedulers, network capture and time-stamping, translation of network packets emanating from grid software into discrete events of virtual grid models, translation back from virtual sensors/actuators into data packets to control software, and transplanting the entire system onto an accurately and efficiently maintained virtual-time plane.

title: Design of a home surveillance system based on the android platform
venue: 2015 12th International Conference on Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (FSKD)
abstract: This paper has designed and implemented a video surveillance system based on the smart Android terminal equipment. This system consists of two parts, including the server and the client. The server is responsible for the video acquisition and the H.264 video encoding. The video transmission uses RTP protocol. The client is responsible for receiving data, and completing the decoding and playback. Because of the limited storage capacity of mobile devices, the server implements the face detection function, which only stores the critical information. This monitoring system is applied to Android phones which are used for the elderly. With the arrival of the social trend of population aging in China, customers can get information about the old people at home by using this monitoring system. It can provide emergency alert about emergency situations. This system has a good mobile performance and transmission stability. It is intelligent, convenient and practical.

title: Design of a Petri Net-Based Workflow Engine
venue: 2008 The 3rd International Conference on Grid and Pervasive Computing - Workshops
abstract: Several years of research are establishing Petri nets as a modeling formalism for scientific workflows; their formal semantics and the existence of several analysis tools, among others, make them suitable for complex concurrent processes' description. However, the non-determinism of the Petri Net model clashes with the imperative Turing- based environment provided by mainstream programming languages such as C/C++, Java and C#. Therefore several design decisions must be taken in order to provide a concrete implementation of a Petri Net-based engine. This paper proposes the architecture of a workflow engine - currently implemented in a workflow management system (WfMS) - with the goal to provide a reliable and efficient platform for the execution of scientific workflows in a grid environment. One of the design principle is the neutrality towards the underlying mechanisms for task execution, in order not to compromise interoperability with multiple infrastructures.

title: Design of a Platform for Evaluating the Security and Stability Operation Status of New Energy Power System
venue: 2024 9th Asia Conference on Power and Electrical Engineering (ACPEE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of visual observation and design of safe and stable operation state of power system containing new energy, Java Script language and other auxiliary languages are used to build a visual observation software platform for safe and stable state evaluation of power system containing new energy. The platform includes home page, power grid status evaluation, power grid status prediction, data query, account management and other basic functions to achieve a more comprehensive, rapid and accurate real-time safe and stable operation status evaluation and situation prediction, providing decision support for the future safe operation of the system.

title: Design of a Rural Idle House Resource Information Management System Based on the Ssh Framework
venue: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Industrial Application of Artificial Intelligence (IAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the poor effect of traditional rural idle house resource information management, this study proposes a rural idle house resource information management system based on the SSH framework. To optimize the system hardware structure, integrate the mainstream SSH Framework Technology in the J2EE development platform, make the system realize more detailed layering under the SSH three-tier architecture mode, and optimize the system software function and operation process on this basis to improve the operation efficiency of the system management system. The experimental results show that the rural idle house resource information management system based on the SSH framework has high practicability in the process of practical application and can better manage massive house resource information.

title: Design of a smart cloud platform system for stereo garage
venue: Jiangsu Annual Conference on Automation (JACA 2023)
abstract: With the growth of social economy and automobile industry, the number of vehicles in China has been rapidly increasing, leading to a more prominent issue of limited parking spaces. Stereo garages have emerged as an effective solution to the problem of "parking difficulties" and are considered the future of parking development. However, the current stereo garages lack intelligence and informatization, making remote management challenging and resulting in low efficiency. To address this, this project proposes a smart cloud platform system for stereo garages to enhance management efficiency and service effectiveness. Seven functional modules are designed accordingly, namely maintenance services, statistical reports, system management, fault management, real-time monitoring, garage management, and garage overview. Key technical solutions including the utilization of MySQL database, Java Web technology for the server-side, and the Bootstrap framework for the client-side, are also examined. The system has undergone testing and has been found to meet the corresponding requirements. This designed and implemented stereo garage management system significantly improves management efficiency, service effectiveness, and the intelligence level of stereo garages.

title: Design of an advanced Acoustic Tide Gauge for Tsunami monitoring
venue: OCEANS 2011 IEEE - Spain
abstract: Indian Tsunami Warning System was established in 2006 by National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai, Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India. It comprises of Data Buoys with Bottom Pressure Recorders in the deep seabed and Acoustic Tide Gauge Network in the coastal areas. This paper describes design and field trials of an Advance Tide Gauge for Tsunami monitoring applications in India. The Advanced Tide Gauge measures tide, stores the data in the internal memory and transmits the real-time data via satellite telemetry to Indian Tsunami Warning Centre, Hyderabad and NIOT. The novel system is designed using networked low power embedded controllers in master and slave configuration. The state of the art system works on the ultrasonic time of flight measurement principle. The system was installed at Ennore Port, east coast of India on September 2007. Its performance was tested on September 12, 2007 with earth quake of magnitude 8.4 off Java coast.

title: Design of an electrical simulator based on FPGA
venue: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Technology, Communication and Information (ICETCI)
abstract: The automatic test system (ATS) is essential equipment for ensuring product quality, and the self-test of the ATS primarily depends on the product electrical simulator. Aiming at the verification requirements of the ATS and the large size of existing electrical simulators, this paper designs a miniaturized electrical simulator capable of simulating common electrical interfaces and electrical characteristics for comprehensive self-testing of the ATS. Using the FPGA core board MK7325FA as the control center, this paper carries out the hardware and firmware design of the electrical simulator, with an emphasis on introducing the design of the 1553B interface circuit and functional logic. Results indicate that the simulator can achieve electrical simulation and meet the selftesting needs of the ATS.

title: Design of an inexpensive Ethernet/Arduino-based DMX-control system via network applied to musical fountain
venue: 2016 International Conference on Signal Processing, Communication, Power and Embedded System (SCOPES)
abstract: Network to enable or disable a controller using processing of signals has been emerging as a viable solution to many innovative applications in the industry such as; remote control technology, location of wireless sensor network, audio and video processing remotely, in this work the method begins on a website where different users connected to the internet can controlling the music in the fountain, the signal is send via internet to Ethernet shield board, this signal is manipulated in the computer using FFT for the discretization of music after a DSP is applied obtaining a signal sent serially for lamps and electro-valves, finally a Python with simplified examples provided for MATLAB as final user interface is used, this source code is GNU (General Public License), the main contribution of this work is the development of an inexpensive but effective LED-RGB controller based in Arduino with DMX-512 communication protocol, using software as open-source.

title: Design of an IoT-based Vehicle State Monitoring System Using Raspberry Pi
venue: 2019 International Conference on Electrical Engineering Research & Practice (ICEERP)
abstract: In this paper, an IoT-based vehicle monitoring system is designed and implemented. The proposed design is comprised of three components: an OBD scan tool, a Raspberry Pi and a Cloud monitoring application. The OBD scan tool collects vehicle information from the OBD-II port of the vehicle, and the Raspberry Pi uploads them onto a cloud server using cellular internet connection. The on-line data as well as the historical data stored on a Cloud server are then accessed by the monitoring application. The application can report data both graphically and descriptively. An algorithm is also proposed to detect faults in engine and cooling systems.

title: Design of an Optical Measuring Stand for the Analysis of iSTC-21v Jet Engine Fuel Nozzle Spray
venue: 2025 IEEE 23rd Jubilee International Symposium on Intelligent Systems and Informatics (SISY)
abstract: This paper presents the design and verification of a measuring device intended for the experimental determination of the spray cone angle of a pressure swirl fuel nozzle used in small turbojet engines, specifically the iSTC-21v. The primary objective was to develop an objective and cost-effective method to measure this angle without relying on optical components such as high-speed cameras or laser systems. The device is designed as a modular platform, allowing future integration of optical techniques. The proposed test bench evaluates the fuel spray pattern using strain gauge-based measurement of the liquid volume collected in a set of concentric collection rings. This method enabled the experimental determination of the spray cone angle, which was then compared with a mathematical model developed based on the nozzle’s geometric and hydraulic parameters. The difference between modeled and experimental values of the spray angle was within ±4%, confirming the reliability of the chosen approach. Although the current system does not support droplet size or distribution analysis, it provides a solid foundation for further development using optical diagnostics. In future stages, the system is intended to be used for testing alternative fuels and analyzing their effects on the processes of atomization, ignition, and combustion in small jet engines. Additionally, these insights may serve as valuable input for the development of control algorithms that account for fuel spray characteristics, helping to improve engine start-up reliability and operational performance.

title: Design of an Unmanned Autonomous Vehicle Control System Based on Adaptive Sliding Mode Control Method
venue: 2026 6th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Industrial Technology Applications (AIITA)
abstract: This paper takes a typical Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) as the research object, establishes its kinematic and dynamic models, and derives its spatial motion equations, which can solve the spatial motion parameters of the UUV. Subsequently, to address issues such as the nonlinear model and parameter uncertainty of the UUV, an adaptive sliding mode control method is utilized. A sliding mode controller and an adaptive law for longitudinal depth-keeping motion and pitch angle are designed. An adaptive algorithm is then incorporated to complete the controller design. Three sets of simulations were conducted on this control system. The simulation results demonstrate the feasibility and stability of the control system, providing feasibility verification and guidance for subsequent modifications of unmanned underwater vehicles.

title: Design of Concurrent Ciphertext Policy-Attribute Based Encryption Library for Multilevel Access of Encrypted Data
venue: 2018 Fifth International Conference on Parallel, Distributed and Grid Computing (PDGC)
abstract: Ciphertext Policy-Attribute Based Encryption (CP-ABE) is a public key encryption system that provides a flexible solution for sharing data files securely and publicly. As compared to conventional encryption CP-ABE generates single encrypted file that can be decrypted by anyone posing right attribute levels. In this paper, we have transformed legacy CP-ABE library to Object Oriented (OO) approach for enhancing the functionality of Ciphertext Policy-Attribute Based Encryption. CP-ABE has been further implemented as Multithreaded - Ciphertext Policy - Attribute Based Encryption (OOM-CP-ABE) for concurrency. Scope of parallelization in encryption and decryption operations has been exploited to obtain more efficient encryption and decryption. A case study for multilevel accessing of shared data files in a software company has been implemented to demonstrate the usefulness of implemented library. Experimental simulations demonstrate improved performance of proposed OOM-CP-ABE scheme to provide real time data encryption and decryption services as compared to legacy CP-ABE and OO-CP-ABE approaches.

title: Design of Control unit for CNC machine tool using Arduino based embedded system
venue: 2015 International Conference on Smart Technologies and Management for Computing, Communication, Controls, Energy and Materials (ICSTM)
abstract: The present work is concerned with the design and development of Control unit comprising of the Digital Differential Analyzer Interpolator as the core element in controlling the motion in X and Y direction of the Computer Numerical Control machine. The Control unit designed contributes a little but significant step towards low cost automation. Software interpolators are designed for performing machining operations on the work by performing interpolated motion of cutting tool. The prototype CNC Machine tool is procured from the manufacturer of CNC Machines for performing the work. The Atmega 2560 microcontroller used in this work is provided with Arduino development board environment for designing the control unit. Three unipolar stepper motors are used for controlling the machine axes. The X and Y axes are interpolated for two dimensional interpolation. The Z axis is used to control the depth of cut but it is not interpolated. Electronic Industries Association Standard code of part programming is used for implementing the G and M codes. The paper also discusses the development of algorithm for interpreters and interpolators as well as the real time graphical simulation and design of driver cards for unipolar stepper motors. The Control unit is tested for linear as well as circular interpolation by performing actual machining on CNC machine.

title: Design of Digital Twin System for Intelligent Industrial Glue Dispensing Robots
venue: 2026 38th Chinese Control and Decision Conference (CCDC)
abstract: This study aims to achieve automation and intelligence in industrial robot dispensing tasks through digital twin technology, reducing R&D costs, improving production efficiency, and providing actionable technical solutions for industrial applications. The objective is to design a comprehensive digital twin system for industrial robot dispensing workstations, capable of performing visual inspection, robot program generation, virtual simulation and debugging, as well as industrial communication and interaction. By utilizing the open-source computer vision library OpenCV to develop image processing algorithms, the system performs preprocessing, feature extraction, and trajectory recognition of target images, generating robot trajectory point files. The Digital Twin Factory software is employed to construct 3D models of dispensing workstations and configure physical attributes and motion parameters for virtual devices. Based on these trajectory point files, Python programs are written to automatically generate industrial robot dispensing programs, which are then validated and optimized through virtual trial runs via the digital twin platform. Additionally, PLC control programs and HMI human-machine interfaces are developed to establish communication protocols between the digital twin system and external devices, ensuring coordinated operation between virtual and physical equipment. Integrating cuttingedge technologies such as computer vision, digital twins, and industrial communication, this study demonstrates strong innovation and practicality. It provides an excellent technical solution for the intelligent manufacturing sector, promotes the widespread application of digital twin technology in industrial production, and facilitates the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industries.

title: Design of Distributed Industrial Monitoring System Based on Virtual Token Ring
venue: 2007 2nd IEEE Conference on Industrial Electronics and Applications
abstract: In the paper an intelligent distributed measurement and monitoring system for point machines in railway using power line carrier communication is designed. After simply describing the architecture of the system, the design of communication protocol based on virtual token ring is introduced. A logical token ring network is presented, and then data frame format, the principle of normal working, adding node to network and error processing are discussed in detail. The performance evaluation of token ring method and cyclic access method in terms of throughput and delay are given finally, which shows that token ring method performs better than cyclic access method. Self-maintenance, high efficiency, high fault tolerance and high real-time make sure the distributed monitoring system based on virtual token ring to be applied in many applications in industrial monitor field, which require distributed, long-distance and real-time data gathering.

title: Design of elevator running parameters remote monitoring system based on Internet of Things
venue: 2015 6th IEEE International Conference on Software Engineering and Service Science (ICSESS)
abstract: This paper constructed the overall design of the elevator running parameters remote monitoring system based on zigbee technology and GPRS network, combining with the concepts and features of IoT. For the remote communication server need to parallelly handle a large number of different level datagrams, we constructed a high concurrency UDP communication model by using the technologies such as JavaNIO, batch data processing, database connection pool and java synchronization. And designed a multi-queue thread pool with dynamic priority, ensure a large number of tasks are handled efficiently according to the different priority, most of threads in thread pool is busy, solve the problem of a large amount of overhead in life cycle of a thread and system resource shortage. Using framework of SpingMVC, MyBatis, Bootstrap, and Highcharts based on HTML 5 for joint development, building a remote monitoring platform. We reproduced the elevator running effect through the way of real-time simulation animation and save the high monitoring cost of video acquisition. And implemented the function: parameter acquisition, fault alarm and statistics, SMS alerts, remote stop and landing control. And the practical application effect of the system in Shenyang Bluelight group shows that the model is stable to work for large-scale underlying communication of multi-priority task and has a very good generality.

title: Design of embedded streaming media player based on J2ME
venue: 2011 International Conference on Multimedia Technology
abstract: This article designs of a cross-platform streaming media player based on J2ME (Java 2 Micro Edition) platform in the embedded system, introduces the jitter buffer and the disorder treatment strategy. To improve the capability of realtime playing, the player uses hardware decoding. With the JNI (Java Native Interface) technology, the implementation, connecting with the local codes, is convenient.

title: Design of Energy Carbon Measurement and Carbon Emission Control Platform for High-Energy-Consuming Enterprises
venue: 2023 5th International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Control Technologies (CEECT)
abstract: To improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emission in the high-energy-consuming enterprises, designed and developed a set of energy carbon measurement and carbon emission control platform for high-energy enterprises using B/S model. The platform utilizes the SpringBoot framework based on Java as the back-end main framework, and use MySQL as the management database system. Real-time communication between the browser and the backend is achieved through WebSocket. For the frontend, the progressive Vue framework is used to facilitate interaction between users and various functional modules. The platform integrates functionalities such as carbon emission monitoring, energy-saving and carbon reduction potential assessment, and multi-objective optimization scheduling. It solves the problems of traditional energy management and control platform can only be analyzed from a single dimension of energy consumption and lacks modeling and analysis of system efficiency, and provides steel enterprises with more accurate and effective control of energy efficiency and carbon emission.

title: Design of Equipment Remote Monitoring System Based on Embedded Web
venue: 2008 International Conference on Embedded Software and Systems Symposia
abstract: In this paper, we combine the mature technology of Web with the embedded and fully utilize the advantages of both. Applied the embedded Web technology in the field of equipment condition monitoring, the equipment remote monitoring system is designed based on embedded Web. Firstly, the function and structure of the system are designed. Based on ARM9 technology, the hardware part of system is designed by using of Samsung's S3C2410, ADC0809 and DM9000 chips. Secondly, based on the commonly Web design technology, the embedded Web server is designed by integrating embedded CGI (common gateway interface), ActiveX and Java Applet technology. Finally, the problem of communication security is considered. The System can complete the remote access, monitoring and maintenance operations of equipment through the network and Web browser. Practical operations show that the system can decrease system running cost and improve maintaining efficiency. It has wide application prospect and great popularization value.

title: Design of Intelligent Access Control System Based on Raspberry PI
venue: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Automatic access control system based on Raspberry Pi and Arduino UNO development board uses the CSI camera of Raspberry Pi to capture the face information, compare it with the face database, judge whether it meets the data in the database, and then send the signal to the Arduino UNO development board through the Bluetooth module to control the servo to simulate the opening and closing of the door. The system modules are clearly divided, the program is readable, the hardware and software are easy to modify, and it has considerable accuracy.

title: Design of Logistics Information Management System Based on Database
venue: 2010 Second International Conference on Computer Modeling and Simulation
abstract: With the development of information technology and network technology, logistics information has grew out from nothing, information is the only way for the development of modern logistics, but also an inevitable requirement of e-commerce. In this paper, a logistics information system with B/S multi-tier architecture and based on JAVA EE application of MVC pattern is achieved. The system meets the MVC design pattern, uses the technology based on struts2, spring and Hibernate three framework technologies to integrate and achieve enterprise-class Web applications: presentation layer using the struts2 framework, business logic layer using the spring framework, and the data persistence layer using Hibernate framework.

title: DESIGN OF OBJECT RECOGNITION AND TRACKING SYSTEM BASED ON MONOCULAR VISION
venue: The 8th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2020)
abstract: This paper studies the machine vision platform equipped with micropthon interpreter and related applications, studies the design of mobile platform for object recognition in complex environment; the experimental method uses Hough circle detection algorithm to realize the recognition of circle; and uses the quaternion detection algorithm to realize the recognition of rectangle. Finally, when the camera recognizes the rectangular object, it drives the car motor. At the same time, if the system recognizes a circular object, it will drive the car motor to produce the effect of backward obstacle avoidance. The experimental results show that The mobile detection platform based on openmv can get the color and shape information of the target object according to the camera, and control the system to search and track the object with specific shape or color, and avoid the nontarget with the characteristics of high efficiency, accuracy and real-time.

title: Design of Online Translation Language System based on Android System
venue: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Cross-Ianguage communication is very important for people from different countries. While existing translation systems have some advantages, they have shortcomings such as low translation accuracy and slow translation efficiency. To provide users with convenient translation services, this study proposes an online translation voice system based on the Android system. The system design and function implementation are introduced. Based on Android platform features and functions, a user-friendly interface is designed allowing multiple functions such as text translation, voice translation (speech-to-speech), and image translation. The research results show that the system's translation success rate is as high as 96.2%. The system is significantly improved in translation success rate, accuracy and speed. Users can quickly obtain accurate, contextually coherent and natural language use by inputting text or voice translation speech. The real-time features of the system allow for its use in various environments such as real-time conversation, travel, and business. This research provides a useful reference for the design of an online translation language system based on the Android system; and moreover, provides students with easy, accurate and fast translation services.

title: Design of personalized traffic safety information push system
venue: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The traffic safety information is essential for intelligent transportation, as for the current collected traffic information, the effective utilization rate is relatively low, it is also difficult to evaluate the information availability and effectiveness, so developing a good traffic information warning platform is very significant for public travelers. Based on this, using the typical expressway as the application scenario, we developed a personalized traffic safety information push system. the system overall framework and key technology were deeply studied and the rationally designed, it implemented personalized traffic information actively pushing, including the bad weather events, facilities risk events, road network index events, blocking events, recovering events. Furthermore, the SpingMVC mybatis and Java NIO Netty open source framework were adopted for system cross-platform and high concurrent communication. Baidu LBS cloud storage / cloud search and Ali cloud server technology were synthetically used to keep system data security and confidentiality. During the test, the system could provide personalized traffic safety information service in real time. It works well and shows a good performance.

title: Design of Platform for Performance Testing Based on JADE
venue: 2014 Sixth International Conference on Measuring Technology and Mechatronics Automation
abstract: For solving the problems presently such as coordination of the virtual users' act and the real-time acquisition of information, based on agent and JADE, this paper brings forward an architecture model of the platform for performance testing. JADE is multi-agent development environment which supports the management and communications control for agents. The principle of JADE is described and the basic method to design a platform for performance testing based on JADE is introduced, and offers a technology approach to realize the platform for performance testing.

title: Design of Remote Monitoring System for Ventilator Based on Golang and MongoDB
venue: 2023 6th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data (ICAIBD)
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between the large number of ventilators, large amount of data and limited medical personnel, this paper proposes a solution based on Golang and MongoDB. In this scheme, the ventilator uploads the device data information in real time through UDP. Based on Golang concurrency and EPOLL-ET mode, the server realizes high performance and scalability. MongoDB is used to store structured data. Compared with traditional solutions, this scheme has a more convenient way of development and stronger horizontal expansion ability, which can expand to more medical device. The test results show that the single Web service supports the maximum QPS of 105485 for short connections and 334687 for long connections. The single device service can support 3000 online devices and consumes fewer system resources.

title: Design of security positioning and remote network server monitoring terminal
venue: 2017 IEEE 17th International Conference on Communication Technology (ICCT)
abstract: This paper design a safe positioning and remote network monitoring terminal system, using MCU microcontroller and UM220-III, and UM220-III is the decoding module of GPS/beidou dual-mode satellite signal. The design uses the STC89C52 chip as the main control MCU chip, and realizes real-time acquisition of the position, speed and time information of the monitoring object by the UM220-III module, and controls the wireless communication module M590E to send the collected information to the remote network server terminal. The design uses Java technology to develop remote network server terminal program, and it realizes the processing, storage, and display combined with the online map on the remote network monitoring platform for the received data. When inputting the specified address in the browser window of the Internet device and correctly logging in the user account and password, the remote network monitoring platform interface can be loaded on the webpage, and the current position and historical movement trajectory of the monitored object are accurately displayed on the platform. Whether the monitored object is in the safe area is marked with a warning light. The test results show that the technical scheme is feasible, the system is stable and can achieve the effect of safe positioning and remote monitoring, the man-machine interface is friendly, and the design has great practical significance.

title: Design of WAMPAC for Java Bali System with Voltage Angle Parameter to Prevent Blackout, Study Case: 500 kV Paiton - Grati Line
venue: 2025 5th International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: The increasing complexity and interconnection of modern power systems have necessitated the development of advanced monitoring and protection technologies to ensure grid reliability and stability. Among these, synchrophasor measurement has emerged as a transformative tool, providing real-time, high-resolution data on voltage, current, and phase angles across the grid. By leveraging time-synchronized measurements from Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs), synchrophasor technology enhances the accuracy and speed of power system protection schemes, enabling faster detection and mitigation of faults, oscillations, and other disturbances. This paper proposes a Wide-Area Monitoring, Protection, and Control (WAMPAC) scheme as an alternative defense strategy for the interconnection between GITET Paiton and GITET Grati. The loss of both Paiton-Grati transmission lines poses a high risk of cascading failures and potential blackout in the Jamali system. The proposed design, developed through simulation, employs the voltage phase angle difference between the two substations as the primary trigger for defense actions. Multiple defense scenarios were evaluated to identify the most effective mitigation strategy. The results demonstrate that WAMPAC is highly effective for implementation, primarily due to its rapid response capability, enabling instantaneous action upon disturbance detection.

title: Design of Wearable Device for Visually Impaired People using Image Processing
venue: 2024 International Conference on Smart Systems for Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computer Engineering (ICSSEECC)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a compact wearable device for visually impaired individuals. It features facial recognition to identify friends and relatives with real-time database updating. Additionally, it includes image-to-speech and optical character recognition (OCR) for converting visual information into audible formats. The device aims to enhance selfsufficiency and spatial cognition through advanced image processing. By integrating cutting-edge functionalities like facial recognition and OCR, it seeks to empower users, promoting greater autonomy and inclusion in daily activities.

title: Design of Wearable Health Monitoring System Integrating Wireless Technology Based on 3D Graphene Foam Sensor
venue: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wearable health monitoring system based on wireless data transmission technology is designed for heart and blood health monitoring. In this system, new three-dimensional (3D) graphene foam sensors are used to capture heart rate signals in real time, and a microprocessor STM32 is used as the main control chip for sending the collected data to the mobile device through low-power Bluetooth. Meanwhile, the blood oxygen and blood pressure data are collected by the mobile device, and then, the acquired physical health data and location information are packaged, stored and sent to the cloud server through 4G communication circuit, so the remote monitoring of the physical health of the subject in real time by the cloud server can be realized.

title: Design of Wireless Electromyography (EMG) Monitoring System for Muscle Activity Detection on Parkinson Disease
venue: 2020 International Conference on Smart Technology and Applications (ICoSTA)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease attacking 1 percent of the elder population in this world, with one of the main symptoms of this disease being resting tremor. Until now, Parkinson’s disease information acquisition can only be done through patients’ visits to clinics or hospitals, whereas the aspects of the disease are also shown during in-between those visits. In this research, we develop an Electromyography (EMG) based remote-monitoring systemin order for patients are able to be checked more frequently and the results are in always-renewed information. This monitoring system utilizes NodeMCU as the compiler component and ESP8266 WiFi module and web server. The data acquired from an arm of a tested person will always be read in real-time and can be displayed on web-based platform. From the data acquired, they are processed in detail for pattern characteristics analysis. We have successfully carried out the experimental test by displaying on the web server-based monitoring system.

title: Design Optimization of Time-and Cost-Constrained Fault-Tolerant Distributed Embedded Systems
venue: Proceedings of the Conference on Design, Automation and Test in Europe - Volume 2
abstract: In this paper we present an approach to the design optimization of fault-tolerant embedded systems for safety-critical applications.Processes are statically scheduled and communications are performed using the time-triggered protocol.We use process re-execution and replication for tolerating transient faults.Our design optimization approach decides the mapping of processes to processors and the assignment of fault-tolerant policies to processes such that transient faults are tolerated and the timing constraints of the application are satisfied.We present several heuristics which are able to find fault-tolerant implementations given a limited amount of resources.The developed algorithms are evaluated using extensive experiments, including a real-life example.

title: Design, Modeling and Fabrication of a Symmetric Multilevel Inverter with Optimized Damping Resistor for the Solar Powered Renewable Energy Applications
venue: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Power, Electrical, Electronics and Industrial Applications (PEEIACON)
abstract: In this paper, a single-phase, 5-level symmetric, multilevel inverter is designed for solar powered renewable energy applications. This inverter topology is designed with only 5-IGBT switches which is comparatively lower switch counts to the other same level inverters. This study conducts a comprehensive examination of the multilevel carrier-based continuous pulse train with ideal modulation, employing the phase-shift position (POP) technique to ensure precise device switching. Moreover, the single-phase solar powered 5-level symmetric Multilevel Inverter (MLI) is designed, modelled and implemented with the appropriate filters where the damping resistor (rd) is optimized, and practically the FFT measured THD level is 6.33%. The LC and LCL filters are designed using the transfer function and checked the stability from the BODE diagram. In addition, the control algorithm for operating the switches of the designed and simulated inverter is implemented using the C programming language. This allows for embedding of the control section code directly into a Hardware-in-the-open loop (HIL) system.

title: Design-Oriented Digital Twin Framework for Optimal VSC Setpoint Synthesis in Hybrid AC/DC CIGRE Low-Voltage Networks
venue: IEEE Access
abstract: This paper presents a design-oriented digital twin framework for the offline optimal synthesis of Voltage Source Converter (VSC) setpoints in hybrid AC/DC distribution networks. Eight bidirectional VSCs are used to combine a DC grid with the original AC feeders of a modified CIGRE European low-voltage benchmark. To simulate the network topology, operational limitations, and time-varying load profiles under hourly operation, the Digital Twin (DT) is implemented in Python using the PyDAE environment. An optimization problem is formulated to determine the active and reactive power setpoints of the VSCs on an hourly basis over a 24-hour horizon, aiming to minimize the power exchange at the main grid connection while strictly enforcing per-phase current limits and bus voltage constraints. Penalty-constrained Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are used as solution methods in the DT environment to address this constrained nonlinear problem. The proposed framework operates as a design-phase virtual twin for offline parameter synthesis and robustness assessment across multiple operating scenarios. The obtained optimal setpoints are then validated under four representative load conditions, including AC-stressed and high DC-penetration scenarios. The simulation results show that the synthesized VSC setpoints successfully prevent voltage and current violations, improve power sharing, and reduce feeder overload without the need for continuous communication. A comparative analysis indicates faster convergence and slightly lower power consumption with HHO than with PSO. The proposed framework provides a reproducible and high-fidelity platform for constraint-aware optimization of hybrid AC/DC distribution grids.

title: Designing a Hardware-Agnostic Interface Between Route and Trajectory Planning in Self-Driving Cars
venue: 2022 IEEE Conference on Control Technology and Applications (CCTA)
abstract: Software reusability is critical to the rapid development and certification of autonomous vehicles (AVs). However, little attention has been given to designing AV path planners for increased software reusability. In this paper we design a trajectory-optimizing nonlinear MPC planner that takes a driveable corridor, desired speed profile and constraints as input to compute the AV's trajectory. These inputs are hardware-independent, confining hardware dependencies to the planner software itself and clearly separating higher-level route planning from hardware-dependent algorithms. We implement the planner in simulation to demonstrate its feasibility in representing common traffic scenarios.

title: Designing Autonoming Safety Layers: A Self-Regulated Learning-Based System for Child Online Safety
venue: Proceedings of the 25th Annual ACM Interaction Design and Children Conference
abstract: This paper presents Autonoming, a child-caregiver-AI safety system currently conceptualized as a browser-plugin prototype, which reimagines child online safety as a self-regulated learning process rather than a surveillance model. Grounded in Self-Regulated Learning (SRL), Autonoming structures safety as an integrated child-caregiver-AI journey across three phases: forethought, where families plan boundaries; performance, where children receive support during risky moments; and self-reflection, where contested prompts and periodic reviews support explanation, reflection, and future strategies. These phases are translated into four interaction components: families co-create (a) a Safety Agreement before online activity; children receive (b) real-time Scaffolding Prompts during risky moments; contested prompts become learning opportunities through (c) a Negotiation Bypass; and periodic (d) Trust-Building Reviews support reflection and future rule revision. The article contributes an SRL-based design model for explainable, contestable, and trust-building child online safety systems, offering a pathway to move from parental control toward collaborative safety learning.

title: Designing Persuasive Health Technologies: A Gamified Mobile Application for Bipolar Disorder Self-Management
venue: Proceedings of the 2026 ACM International Conference on Interactive Media Experiences
abstract: Treatment adherence in Bipolar Affective Disorder (BAD) remains a global healthcare challenge, characterized by high rates of medication non-compliance and the lack of interactive tools for self-management. Traditional intervention approaches often fail to provide sufficient interactivity to sustain long-term engagement, typically relying on static digital logs. To address these limitations, the "EntreFases" application proposes an approach grounded in the integration of Persuasive Technology and Gamification. Developed using the Unity Engine and C#, the system adopts a modular, event-driven architecture to manage mood states, routines, and user interactions in real time. The application incorporates the Octalysis framework alongside a rule-based dynamic mission generation algorithm, triggered by continuous mood tracking through symbolic inputs (emojis). This mechanism enables the personalization of behavioral activation tasks, fostering user autonomy and supporting the maintenance of therapeutic routines. This demonstration highlights how interactive systems can translate complex clinical requirements into adaptive digital experiences, bridging the gap between medical prescriptions and patients’ daily lives while contributing to more effective mental health care strategies.

title: Designing systems for future obsolescence
venue: Digital Avionics Systems Conference, 2003. DASC '03. The 22nd
abstract: The lifetime of government systems is far longer than the lifetime of the components that make up the systems. Obsolescence has become one of the normal design concerns for systems engineers. The primary factor in reducing the cost of redesign is an unambiguous, machine sensible systems description. Implementation independent tests can be generated from these descriptions, and they can be used in the design process as well. This can result in savings of up to 75% in the redesign of systems due to obsolete components (or the redesign of the components themselves). The design process consists of several phases: requirements capture, initial design, implementation, and verification. The verification step is by far the most costly, taking fifty to seventy percent of the system lifecycle resources. In a system design that takes obsolescence into account, the result of the initial design step is an implementation independent, unambiguous set of design requirements. These can be used as input to a tool, such as EDAptive Computing's VectorGen, to produce tests that automatically verify that the system meets its specification. In future redesigns due to obsolescence, the requirements and initial design steps are completely eliminated (because the implementation independent portion of the design is preserved) and the verification step is vastly reduced (because of the existence of implementation independent test vectors that verify that the device meets its specification). It is these features that result in the tremendous cost savings in future redesign efforts. This paper will detail the design process, describe the use of appropriate systems design methodologies and tools to produce the implementation independent design description given above, and document the potential cost savings.

title: Designing to sample the unknown: Lessons from OSIRIS-REx project systems engineering
venue: 2017 IEEE Aerospace Conference
abstract: On September 8, 2016, the third NASA New Frontiers mission launched on an Atlas V 411. The Origins, Spectral Interpretation, Resource Identification, Security-Regolith Explorer (OSIRIS-REx) will rendezvous with asteroid Bennu in 2018, collect a sample in 2020, and return that sample to Earth in September 2023. The development team has overcome a number of challenges in order to design and build a system that will make contact with an unexplored, airless, low-gravity body. This paper will provide an overview of the mission, then focus in on the system-level challenges and some of the key system-level processes. Some of the lessons here are unique to the type of mission, like discussion of operating at a largely-unknown, low-gravity object. Other lessons, particularly from the build phase, have broad implications. The OSIRIS-REx risk management process was particularly effective in achieving an on-time and under-budget development effort. The systematic requirements management and verification and the system validation also helped identify numerous potential problems. The final assessment of the OSIRIS-REx performance will need to wait until the sample is returned in 2023, but this post-launch assessment will capture some of the key systems-engineering lessons from the development team.

title: Designing with the Eyes: Implicit Attention-based Form Ideation in Virtual Reality
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Symposium on Eye Tracking Research and Applications
abstract: Traditional form ideation methods rely heavily on explicit user input, manual curation, and subjective interpretation, often limiting creativity and increasing cognitive load for novice product designers. We introduce "EUPHORIA", a novel approach that leverages implicit visual attention through real-time gaze tracking and feature extraction in a virtual reality (VR) environment to automatically generate mood boards for product form ideation. Using an immersive space containing 150 visual stimuli, participants freely explored images while their gaze behaviours were recorded implicitly. Analysis from this initial self-attention phase (Phase 1) demonstrated a significant correlation (r = 0.816, p<0.01) between gaze fixation durations and subjective user preferences. Results validate the hypothesis that implicit gaze metrics reliably reflect user preferences. Then, participants went on to explore visual stimuli after pre-conditioning their minds with emotional phrases (Phase 2 - stimuli-attention). The preconditioned emotional stimuli in Phase 2 yielded clear emotional category ratings (positive, neutral, negative), with reduced fixation times indicating faster image selection. Ongoing research will extend this framework to the strategic attention phase (Phase 3), offering novice designers an intuitive, efficient, and personalized tool for automated form generation.

title: Detecting and Characterizing Group Interactions Using 3D Spatial Data to Enhance Human-Robot Engagement
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Control and Vision Engineering
abstract: As robotic systems become increasingly integrated into human environments, it is critical to develop advanced methods that enable them to interpret and respond to complex social dynamics. This work combines a YOLOv8-based human pose estimation approach with 3D Mean Shift clustering for the detection and analysis of behavioral characteristics in social groups, using 3D point clouds generated by the Intel® RealSense™D435i as a cost-effective alternative to LiDAR systems. Our proposed method achieves 97% accuracy in classifying social group geometric configurations (L, C, and I patterns) and demonstrates the value of depth information by reaching 50% precision in 3D group detection using adaptive clustering, significantly outperforming standard 2D approaches. Validation was conducted with 12 participants across 8 experimental scenarios, demonstrating robust estimation of body orientation (40° error), a key indicator for interaction analysis, while head direction estimation presented greater variability (70° error), both measured relative to the depth plane and compared against OptiTrack ground truth data. The framework processes 120 samples at 2–6m distances, achieving 70% torso orientation accuracy at 5m and identifying triadic L-shaped groups with F1-score=0.91. These results enable autonomous robots to quantify group centroids, analyze interaction patterns, and navigate dynamically using real-time convex hull approximations. The integration of accessible 3D perception with efficient processing could enhance human-robot interactions, demonstrating its feasibility in applications such as social robotics, healthcare, care environments, and service industries, where social adaptability and collaborative decision-making are essential.

title: Detecting distance between injected microspheres and target tumor via 3D reconstruction of tissue sections
venue: 2012 Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society
abstract: One treatment increasing in use for solid tumors in the liver is radioembolization via the delivery of 90Y microspheres to the vascular bed within or near the location of the tumor. It is desirable as part of the treatment for the microspheres to embed preferentially in or near the tumor. This work details an approach for analyzing the deposition of microspheres with respect to the location of the tumor. The approach used is based upon thin-slice serial sectioning of the tissue sample, followed by high resolution imaging, microsphere detection, and 3-D reconstruction of the tumor surface. Distance from the microspheres to the tumor was calculated using a fast deterministic point inclusion method.

title: Detecting Fake Reviews on Shopee E-Commerce Using Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) Algorithm
venue: 2025 International Conference on ICT for Smart Society (ICISS)
abstract: With the rapid growth of e-commerce in Indonesia, product reviews have become a crucial factor in influencing purchasing decisions. Shopee, as the most visited e-commerce platform in Indonesia with over 2.3 billion visits in 2023, relies heavily on user reviews to build buyer trust. However, the rise of fake reviews written by paid individuals or generated by AI poses a threat to consumers, honest sellers, and the integrity of the marketplace. To address this issue, this study developed a fake review classification model using the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) algorithm on Shopee review data. The research follows the CRISP-DM methodology, covering phases such as business understanding, data understanding, data preparation, modeling, evaluation, and deployment. The model achieved strong performance with an accuracy 96%, precision 98%, recall of 96%, and 1-score 97%. These results demonstrate the potential of deep learning in supporting review credibility, and future work is recommended to explore other datasets, algorithms, and integration with real-time systems for broader application.

title: Detecting GNSS Deception Interference for Train Localization using CTGAN-TabTransformer
venue: 2025 IEEE 23rd International Conference on Industrial Informatics (INDIN)
abstract: Interference has been a significant concern that may degrade the performance of autonomous train localization using Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), especially for safety-critical GNSS applications in railway transportation. Due to complexity and uncertainty of GNSS deception interference, GNSS-based train localization may significantly suffer from the vulnerabilities of an ordinary Train Position Unit (TPU), which would substantially hinder the trustworthy application of GNSS in railway systems. However, it is usually difficult to accurately characterize the effect of deceptive interference in misleading the position computation. Without relying on complex analytical theories, data-driven model-based detection has demonstrated great potential for practical applications. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive initiative focused on developing an active detection strategy specifically designed to combat typical GNSS spoofing threats.
