This paper describes an approach to quantify the effects of engine operating parameter uncertainties on the thermomechanical fatigue (TMF) life of a selected engine part. A closed-loop engine simulation with a TMF life model is used to calculate the life consumption of different mission cycles. A Monte Carlo simulation approach is used to generate the statistical life usage profile for different operating assumptions. The probabilities of failure of different operating conditions are compared to illustrate the importance of the engine component life calculation using sensor information. The results of this study clearly show that a sensor-based life cycle calculation can greatly reduce the risk of component failure as well as extend on-wing component life by avoiding unnecessary maintenance actions.

title: Remote access lab for Mitsubishi RV-2AJ robot
venue: IX Latin American Robotics Symposium and IEEE Colombian Conference on Automatic Control, 2011 IEEE
abstract: This paper presents the architecture of the remote access laboratory for experimentation with the Mitsubishi RV-2AJ manipulator robot. This lab has been developed using Java technology, and a client/server approach based on Servlets has been specifically implemented. The lab allows users to control and monitor the robot via Internet using a client application. Through this lab, the user can manipulate the robot to obtain its current status and visual feedback of real-time image. This laboratory also supports education process in the field of robotics; it provides students and researchers with an instant access to real experimental interface.

title: Remote Control Laboratory Using EJS Applets and TwinCAT Programmable Logic Controllers
venue: IEEE Transactions on Education
abstract: This paper presents a new methodology to develop remote laboratories for systems engineering and automation control courses, based on the combined use of TwinCAT, a laboratory Java server application, and Easy Java Simulations (EJS). The TwinCAT system is used to close the control loop for the selected plants by means of programmable logic controllers (PLCs) deployed in PCs with the TwinCAT run-time tool. EJS is used to develop the laboratory front-end applets that let teachers and students parametrize and observe the behavior of the PLCs from any computer. The laboratory Java server application establishes the connection between the EJS applets and the PLCs, fulfilling the TwinCAT connection requirements while ensuring an individualized access to each PLC. This paper also shows how the practical work in some undergraduate control courses at the Complutense University of Madrid, Spain, already uses the TwinCAT PLC + Java server + EJS applet strategy to provide real-time support to the controllers, remote individualized access to the experiments, and a user-friendly graphic controller interface for the students.

title: Remote experiments in education: A survey over different platforms and application fields
venue: 2008 11th International Conference on Optimization of Electrical and Electronic Equipment
abstract: Distance education as well as remote experimentation, is a modern field that aims to deliver education to students who are not physically present on their class or their testbed instrumentation. Nowadays, more and more students and educators/instructors rather than attending courses in person, communicate with the educational material at times of their own through Internet-based technologies and services that allows them to interact in real time or in an asynchronous mode. Remote access is simplified, since Internet allows computer users to connect to other computers and information is stored and processed easily, wherever they may be across the world. This paper provides a straightforward categorization of remote experimentations in education according to the platform used as the medium for conducting the experiments and the scientific field in which they apply to. This contribution aims to be a starting point to those interested in entering the world of remote experiments, by presenting work from 2005 up to date.

title: Remote laboratory: A novel tool for control engineering laboratories
venue: 2013 17th International Conference on System Theory, Control and Computing (ICSTCC)
abstract: This paper explores how two scientific experiments in control engineering can be performed remotely over the Internet: (1) Ball and Plate system; and (2) Water Tank system. The main objective is offering students insights about identification of real processes and auto-tuning techniques. At Ghent University real-time remote access laboratories, which allow students to implement, compile and run controllers remotely from home, have been developed. Students can watch the experiment in real time and effectively use the laboratories full functionality through Virtual Private Network (VPN) connection across the Internet.

title: Remote Measuring Laboratory VMLAB Analysis: IoT Implementation Insights
venue: 2024 International Conference on IoT, Communication and Automation Technology (ICICAT)
abstract: This inquire about analyzes your incorporation of the Web into its remotely measuring station licenses approach. With the utilize of such approach, it is attainable to associate distinctive objects electrically in novel ways without the need for a preexisting association schematic. You will work online from any location within the world. At first, a presentation was made at the side an clarification of how the innovation was utilized within the remotely measured laboratory situation. In expansion to your wrapped up engineering, you moreover gotten assessments of conceivable Web applications for your Remote Measuring Station. The particular objective of their inquire about is to supply a workable arrangement for getting synchronized estimations over diverse recognizing and controlling gadgets through their arrange without the need for a Gigabit or remote association provided by the producer. These examinations may be valuable on the off chance that another IP procedure is included for cutting edge innovation. The presentation of the Web of Things (IoT) has totally changed a number of businesses, such as fabricating, horticulture, and healthcare. Within the setting of virtual machine (VM) lab appraisals, farther estimation labs speak to one of the foremost potential employments of IoT. The utilize of IoT in inaccessible estimation labs is secured in this theoretical, with a center on the preferences, troubles, and conceivable impacts on VM lab investigations. IoT innovation is utilized by farther estimation labs to supply real-time information gathering, observing, and investigation without the prerequisite for physical nearness. The research facility environment makes use of Web of Things (IoT) devices, such as sensors and actuators, to ceaselessly monitor a variety of components, counting temperature, mugginess, weight, and chemical concentrations. These gadgets give smooth information gathering and examination by means of remote communication with central informati

title: Remote monitoring of cellular network assembly and function
venue: 2001 Conference Proceedings of the 23rd Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society
abstract: A video microscopy based collaboratory has been developed to study cellular network dynamics, in particular, to monitor live-cell spatio-temporal organization in real-time. The aim is to investigate the effects of intercellular communication on tissue genesis, differentiation and cell survival. The platform enables multiple researchers to remotely access a digital microscopy system consisting of very high-resolution CCD-imaging technology coupled with real-time (/spl sim/ 1 Gbps) data transfer throughput. Remote control and image acquisition facilitates collaboration between cellular biologists, tissue engineers and computational scientists studying complex cellular organization dynamics and assembly. The remote control microscope is connected to a local 'server' such that a 'client' using any web browser that supports Java can access it. The 'server' software is written in Java 2 (jdk 1.3). Any Internet user can control the microscope and interact with other users who are on-line or are directly connected. This interactive environment does not impose any hardware or software limitations on the 'clients'. A remote user can control the movement of the stage in X-Y axes, control focus (Z axis), change magnification, change excitation and light emission filters and their corresponding shutters, acquire topographic and fluorescent images from the microscope and process theses images. The tele-microscopy based environment serves as a focal point for investigators with different expertise to collaborate synergistically on projects that require multi-disciplinary approaches.

title: Remote Practical Work Environment based on Containers to replace Virtual Machines
venue: 2022 IEEE Global Engineering Education Conference (EDUCON)
abstract: In this paper, we are interested in solutions to improve remote practical work in the field of computing, more specifically in programming, networks and telecommunications. In the literature, practical work solutions, based on the cloud or on synchronous / asynchronous monitoring and collaboration tools or on shared writing spaces, are proposed to enable practical work to be carried out remotely. However, the cloud based solution, which uses virtual machines, consumes a lot of resources, and therefore brings cumbersome. Each virtual machine contains an image of the operating system, libraries, and applications and can therefore grow very large. The solution based on collaboration tools does not integrate IT development environments, and therefore the programmer resorts to screen shares or basic editors which waste a lot of time when it comes to find certain modules, classes or native functions of the language.In this paper, we propose to replace virtual machines with containers to optimize resources, and provide a collaborative and easy-to-access lab interface. Each user connects to their own workspace provided by the container, which is accessible by the teacher and other learners in the same group. The practical work will be carried out from a web interface connected to the virtual environment via an API. Real-time communication between learners and teachers will be ensured by WebRTC technology.

title: Remotely keyed encryption with Java cards: a secure and efficient method to encrypt multimedia streams
venue: 2000 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo. ICME2000. Proceedings. Latest Advances in the Fast Changing World of Multimedia (Cat. No.00TH8532)
abstract: Multimedia data streams often require encryption; examples include digital pay-TV and workstation video conferencing. The secret key should be carried in a personal device such as a smart card or an i-button. However, the processor on such a device is too slow to encrypt/decrypt the multimedia stream in real time. We show that remotely keyed encryption can be used to solve the problem: for each block of multimedia data, the host sends a data-dependent challenge to the card, the card computes a session key based on the challenge and the secret key and sends it back to the host. Encryption/decryption of the main data stream is then entirely done on the (fast) host. The secret key never leaves the card. We also present experimental performance results for our scheme using an i-button programmed in Java and a PC as the host.

title: RENCO: a reconfigurable network computer
venue: Proceedings. IEEE Symposium on FPGAs for Custom Computing Machines (Cat. No.98TB100251)
abstract: RENCO is a reconfigurable network computer based on a Motorola 68360 processor for the conventional part, and four Altera Flex 10K130 or 10K250 FPGAs for the reconfigurable part. Therefore, the user has at his/her disposal up to one million programmable logic gates for executing his/her applications in a custom-made processor. RENCO runs a real-time operating system and a Java virtual machine.

title: Repeatability, reproducibility and rigor in systems research
venue: 2011 Proceedings of the Ninth ACM International Conference on Embedded Software (EMSOFT)
abstract: Computer systems research spans sub-disciplines that include embedded and real-time systems, compilers, networking, and operating systems. Our contention is that a number of structural factors inhibit quality research. We highlight some of the factors we have encountered in our work and observed in published papers and propose solutions that could both increase the productivity of researchers and the quality of their output.

title: Replication-Based Incremental Compaction
venue: 2008 11th IEEE International Symposium on Object and Component-Oriented Real-Time Distributed Computing (ISORC)
abstract: We propose an incremental compaction algorithm. Our compactor selects a continuous area of the heap and evacuates it by incrementally copying all objects in the area to the rest of the heap. After all objects have been copied, our compactor incrementally updates pointers pointing into the evacuated area. During these processes, each original object and its copy are kept consistent. We implemented the compactor together with a snapshot garbage collector in the KVM. Our measurements show that (1) the largest free chunk is almost always more than 20% as large as the entire heap when the heap is twice as large as the maximum amount of live objects, (2) the runtime overhead is less than 20%, and (3) the maximum pause time caused by the compactor is comparable to that caused by the snapshot collector.

title: Representativeness comparisons of nurse and computer charting of heart rate across nursing-intensity protocols
venue: 2016 38th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
abstract: Clinical teams in acute inpatient settings can greatly benefit from automated charting technologies that continuously monitor patient vital status. NewYork-Presbyterian has designed and developed a real-time patient monitoring system that integrates vital signs sensors, networking, and electronic health records, to allow for automatic charting of patient status. We evaluate the representativeness (a combination of agreement, safety and timing) of a core vital sign across nursing intensity care protocols for preliminary feasibility assessment. Our findings suggest an automated way of summarizing heart rate provides representation of true heart rate status and can facilitate alternatives approaches to burdensome manual nurse charting of physiological parameters.

title: Reproducibility of the DaCe Framework on NPBench Benchmarks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
abstract: DaCe is a framework for Python that claims to provide massive speedups with C-like speeds compared to already existing high-performance Python frameworks (e.g. Numba or Pythran). In this work, we take a closer look at reproducing the NPBench work. We use performance results to confirm that NPBench achieves higher performance than NumPy in a variety of benchmarks and provide reasons as to why DaCe is not truly as portable as it claims to be, but with a small adjustment it can run anywhere.

title: Requirements for Next Generation Middleware Implementations
venue: 2006 International Multi-Conference on Computing in the Global Information Technology - (ICCGI'06)
abstract: Many current and emerging distributed applications require new classes of services from the next generation middleware architectures. The traditional middleware frameworks have become inadequate for next-generation service provisioning due to its poor scalability, customizability, manageability, and reliability. Challenges from existing and new types of applications, including support for multimedia, real-time requirements and mobility seems to indicate the need for defining a new architecture for open distributed systems. The new architecture should be designed from the beginning with flexibility and adaptability in mind. This can be achieved by defining an open engineering middleware platform that is run time configurable and allows inspection and adaptation of the underlying components. This paper will examine the middleware requirements for future distributed systems including grid, RFID, and wireless sensor systems and identifies key research areas. In each area, crucial middleware research issues to support future applications that will enable seamless service provisioning in heterogeneous, dynamically varying computing and communication environments are discussed. The paper also reports on some existing research prototypes with a focus towards their suitability as next generation middleware. Furthermore, the paper proposes a research agenda for next generation middleware to cater for emerging grid, RFID and wireless sensor systems

title: Requirements-Aided Automatic Test Case Generation for Industrial Cyber-physical Systems
venue: 2015 20th International Conference on Engineering of Complex Computer Systems (ICECCS)
abstract: Industrial cyber-physical systems require complex distributed software to orchestrate many heterogeneous mechatronic components and control multiple physical processes. Industrial automation software is typically developed in a model-driven fashion where abstractions of physical processes called plant models are co-developed and iteratively refined along with the control code. Testing such multi-dimensional systems is extremely difficult because often models might not be accurate, do not correspond accurately with subsequent refinements, and the software must eventually be tested on the real plant, especially in safety-critical systems like nuclear plants. This paper proposes a framework wherein high-level functional requirements are used to automatically generate test cases for designs at all abstraction levels in the model-driven engineering process. Requirements are initially specified in natural language and then analyzed and specified using a formalized ontology. The requirements ontology is then refined along with controller and plant models during design and development stages such that test cases can be generated automatically at any stage. A representative industrial water process system case study illustrates the strengths of the proposed formalism. The requirements meta-model proposed by the CESAR European project is used for requirements engineering while IEC 61131-3 and model-driven concepts are used in the design and development phases. A tool resulting from the proposed framework called REBATE (Requirements Based Automatic Testing Engine) is used to generate and execute test cases for increasingly concrete controller and plant models.

title: Rerun: Exploiting Episodes for Lightweight Memory Race Recording
venue: 2008 International Symposium on Computer Architecture
abstract: Multiprocessor deterministic replay has many potential uses in the era of multicore computing, including enhanced debugging, fault tolerance, and intrusion detection. While sources of nondeterminism in a uniprocessor can be recorded efficiently in software, it seems likely that hardware support will be needed in a multiprocessor environment where the outcome of memory races must also be recorded. We develop a memory race recording mechanism, called Rerun, that uses small hardware state (~166 bytes/core), writes a small race log (~4 bytes/kilo- instruction), and operates well as the number of cores per system scales (e.g., to 16 cores). Rerun exploits the dual of conventional wisdom in race recording: Rather than record information about individual memory accesses that conflict, we record how long a thread executes without conflicting with other threads. In particular, Rerun passively creates atomic episodes. Each episode is a dynamic instruction sequence that a thread happens to execute without interacting with other threads. Rerun uses Lamport Clocks to order episodes and enable replay of an equivalent execution.

title: Research and Application of Distributed OSGi for Cloud Computing
venue: 2010 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: With Java runtime-based application has been widely used in our enterprise application and mobile computing.We must maintain many machines in different types, like web server cluster,distributed database,virtual machines,hosting machines and so on.Cloud computing technology has been designed to manage those resources in efficiently way. Client agent can be installed in those host machines or virtual environment to monitor machine status.But with the size expand of the cloud domain,those client agents should be updated or reinstalled. OSGi is an industry standard for a lean Java-based component system with focusing on service-oriented architecture.In this issue,we present OSGi for the cloud computing environment allowing seamless deployment and update function in dynamic way.After use OSGi as the architecture foundation of client agent we use an underlying peer-to-peer infrastructure to provide,share and load OSGi bundles at runtime.Cloud computing bundles on-line warehouse has been established to support bundle download and on-line update.OSGi based on client agent can communication with cloud computing management system to monitor and manage cloud resource in real time.

title: Research and Design of an On-Line Monitoring System for Key Pollution Sources
venue: 2009 International Workshop on Intelligent Systems and Applications
abstract: On the basis of the research of the traditional B/S application structure, this paper introduces a design of an on-line Monitoring System for key pollution Sources with the asynchronous transmission mechanism of Ajax B/S structure. The use of the system is able to improve interactivity and performance of real-time.

title: Research and Design of Intelligent Building Integrating Software Platform Based on Web
venue: 2007 IEEE International Conference on Control and Automation
abstract: Along with the development of intelligent building, information exchanging and sharing plays a very important role in an intelligent building management system. Intelligent building integrating can complete the interoperation and the information exchanging and sharing among the subsystems. Obviously it is important to study the software platform of integrating tool to accelerate the development of the intelligent building technology. Aimed at the requirements of the intelligent building integrating software platform, this paper elaborates the function and characteristics of a platform software, dissertates the frame and function modules of configuration software, data communication and real-time database in the intelligent building integrating software platform based on Web, provides a suit of solution for the intelligent building integrating software platform, illustrates that the software platform is a very practical and effective by an application example.

title: Research and design of runtime software monitoring and control model
venue: 2010 2nd International Conference on Software Technology and Engineering
abstract: Accurate measurement is a foundation upon which accurate controlling for things rests. Based on the real-time monitoring of the statuses and behaviors of running software, we check whether they work normally or not, and then guide the abnormal operating conditions or behaviors onto the way in control to make sure the software service ability unchangeable. In certain circumstances, degraded running the software that does not affect the key features and not reduce the security performances is a very important way to improve the reliability and security of the software. In this paper, we design a monitoring and controlling model for running software based on software components technology and J2EE technology. We could monitor the statuses of running software accurately and control the behaviors of them effectively by using this model. It improves the reliability and controllability of software, and provides a relatively new thought for improving the quality of software.

title: Research and Design of Square Kilometer Array Astronomical Data Management Model Based on Fabric
venue: 2020 International Conferences on Internet of Things (iThings) and IEEE Green Computing and Communications (GreenCom) and IEEE Cyber, Physical and Social Computing (CPSCom) and IEEE Smart Data (SmartData) and IEEE Congress on Cybermatics (Cybermatics)
abstract: At present, how to safely share data among different participants has become a huge challenge. The reliable traceability of SKA data is a powerful technical tool for controlling its security and sharing. In order to solve the problem of high management cost and low data credibility of traditional centralized big data management system, SKA data management and credible traceability model design based on Hyperledger Fabric were studied. In this paper, the overall framework and architecture of SKA data management are studied and designed, and the key technologies such as big data storage scheme, big data transmission, big data processing, blockchain metadata storage, alliance chain member allocation, traceability query, contribution mechanism and data sharing are discussed. Distributed architecture, Hyperledger Fabric alliance chain technology, database technology, Golang network programming, Rust asynchronous programming, Java Web and Vue.js are comprehensively adopted. The functions of SKA data transmission, processing, storage, traceability query and data sharing are designed. The functions of transmission, processing, storage, management, sharing and credible traceability of SKA data management system are realized, which provides a reference for the design and implementation of SKA data management system based on blockchain.

title: Research and impact on the target injection power smoothing algorithm in aircraft system-level HIRF testing
venue: CSAA/IET International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS 2024)
abstract: The avionics system and brake system of an aircraft are critical, and their system-level HIRF test plays a key role in aircraft airworthiness certification, During the system-level Reverberation Chamber (RS) HIRF test process, the injected power value required at each frequency point during testing varies greatly, which leads to unstable output of the power amplifier and makes the actual received field strength in the reverberation chamber too high or too low, thus adversely affecting the test results. After studying and discussing the DO-160 standard and its supplementary guidance standard DO-357, it is found that the injected power smoothing algorithm can be introduced during the test to reduce the error between the actual received field strength in the reverberation chamber and the required field strength for testing. The test results show that after introducing the smoothing algorithm, the forward power curve is smoother, and the field strength obtained in the reverberation chamber is more stable, greatly reducing the situation of over-testing or under-testing, and improving the test stability.

title: Research and Implementation of a Multi-Modal AI-Driven Psychological Assessment and Analysis System Based on Unity
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 2nd International Conference on Image Processing, Intelligent Control and Computer Engineering
abstract: Mental health assessment and intervention is a complex systems engineering task involving individuals, environment, and interaction. This paper presents a multi-modal intelligent psychological assessment and analysis platform based on the Unity engine, integrating digital House-Tree-Person drawing, sand-play therapy, three-dimensional model customization, and classic psychological scales. The system digitally collects users’ drawing, operation, and questionnaire data, leveraging virtual reality and AI for multi-dimensional modeling and dynamic tracking of psychological characteristics. It combines automated scoring with personalized interpretation, enabling real-time, accurate behavioral data recording and detailed psychological trait analysis. Multiple intelligent models are trained and compared, integrating deep learning with expert rules for precise psychological state identification and personalized intervention. The platform strictly follows assessment standards, is highly modular and scalable, and supports seamless integration of new tools, building a closed-loop environment for assessment, monitoring, and prediction. The platform integrates multi-modal data collection for comprehensive modeling, features real-time behavioral analysis to enhance scientific rigor, and introduces psychological digital twin concepts with 3D spatial topology analysis to reveal deeper psychological characteristics.

title: Research and Implementation of Embedded Virtualization Technology Based on i.MX 8MP
venue: 2025 4th International Symposium on Computer Applications and Information Technology (ISCAIT)
abstract: This paper transplants the hypervisor middleware based on the embedded virtualization technology of the NXP I.MX8MP hardware platform. By modifying the underlying device tree and partition configuration files, four Linux partitions are able to run independently on the same platform. On this basis, an efficient data exchange scheme between partitions is designed and implemented based on the shared memory communication mechanism. Direct access to the shared memory data buffer by the application layer avoids multiple copies of data in the kernel space and user space, reducing communication overhead. Test results show that when transmitting 10 KB of data, the transmission delay is mainly concentrated around $50 \mu \mathrm{~s}$, which effectively improves communication efficiency.

title: Research and implementation of the medical logistics vehicle monitoring and management
venue: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to solve the safety monitoring of drug in the medical logistics transportation, monitoring the vehicle position, speed and other status information, and optimization of vehicle scheduling problem, and preparing for the follow-up vehicle routing optimization, the GPS based logistics vehicle management system is researched and implemented with the Internet of things technology. This paper briefly describes the overall design framework and hierarchical model of the system, and finally the specific functions and the key technology of how to realize the function of the system are studied and the system test results are given.

title: Research and Improvement of Chinese Sign Language Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5s
venue: 2022 2nd International Conference on Networking, Communications and Information Technology (NetCIT)
abstract: In order to facilitate the daily communication of hearing-impaired people, a model based on target detection for real-time recognition of sign language is studied to allow ordinary people who do not know sign language to communicate fluently with hearing-impaired people. YOLOv5 target detection network model has a series of advantages such as fast and efficient detection and easy deployment. This paper improves yolov5s network model applied to sign language recognition detection by adding an attention mechanism module to spatially and channel to extract effective information. And improve the loss function to improve the regression progress. The model is trained with a homemade sign language dataset, and the trained model is used to detect and recognize sign language and convert between sign language, speech and text. In tests in real-world environments, the improved yolov5s-based sign language network detection model can quickly and effectively recognize more than forty basic everyday sign languages with a detection accuracy of 96.50% and an average detection accuracy mAP of 98.92%. The results show that the improved yolov5s-based sign language detection model can accurately and effectively recognize sign language gestures in different environments, and its easy deployment in mobile devices can help hearing impaired people in their daily communication.

title: Research of Collaborative CAD System Based on Multi-Agent
venue: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A multi-agent based architecture is bring on to improve the collaborative feature of traditional CAD system for those designers need collaboration each other but locate on different place. Three levels is are included in this proposed system framework, namely real-time monitoring agent, conflict detection agent, conflict solution agent, user communication agent and knowledge management agent. Detail flow architecture of the user agent is given in this paper. An experiment system presents the efficient cooperation among two designers on Internet.

title: Research of distributed virtual-reality scene based on Java3D technology
venue: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: It is a research hotspot to construct a distributed, multi-users shared 3D virtual environment on the internet. In this way, multiple users in different geographical regions will share a real-time interactive virtual environment through internet in simultaneous. Based on VRML and Java3D technology, this paper proposes an interactive means which constructs distributed 3D virtual environment, as well as a synchronization solution between the scene environment and user state. The means also gives a good guide to resolve existing problems in current distributed 3D virtual technology.

title: Research of evaluation model of Development Assurance Standards
venue: 2016 IEEE Chinese Guidance, Navigation and Control Conference (CGNCC)
abstract: Development Assurance Standards (DAS), generally developed from Process Management technology are defined according to requirements that evaluate products in specific domains. Similar with Process Management, problems are encored when using those standards in practice. Current researches on Software Process Improvement (SPI) focused on technology, methods and experience of process from a higher level of abstraction, but ignore the impact of different application areas. A lack of effective analysis means to ensure the selection of the process and to ensure the development of the standard limited the use of DAS. This paper analyses DASs used in airborne software, electrical hardware and complex system of Civil Aircraft that generally follow a similar backgrounds, environments in development process. Process Standards Maturity Model is defined and used on different DASs to evaluate projects selection of those standards. Additionally, shortages of current Development Assurance are discussed.

title: Research of Security Situational Awareness and Visualization Approach in Cloud Computing
venue: 2018 International Conference on Networking and Network Applications (NaNA)
abstract: Cloud computing is an innovative mechanism to optimize computing and storage resource utilization. Due to its cost-saving, high-efficiency advantage, the technology receives wide adoption from IT industries. However, the frequent emergences of security events become the heaviest obstacle for its advancement. The multi-layer and distributive characteristics of cloud computing make IT admins compulsively collect all necessary situational information at cloud runtime if they want to grasp the panoramic secure state, hereby practice configuration management and emergency response methods when necessary. On the other hand, technologies such as elastic resource pooling, dynamic load balancing and virtual machine real-time migration complicate the difficulty of data gathering, where secure information may come from virtual machine hypervisor, network accounting or host monitor proxies. How to classify, arrange, standardize and visualize these data turns into the most crucial issue for cloud computing security situation awareness and presentation. This dissertation borrows traditional fashion of data visualization to integrate into cloud computing features, proposes a new method for aggregating and displaying secure information which IT admins concern, and expects that by method realization cloud security monitor/management capabilities could be notably enhanced.

title: Research of software tools for DO-254 projects
venue: 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Service System (CSSS)
abstract: Airborne Electronic Hardware (AEH) development relies deeply on the quality of tools that helps the hardware artifact implementation from requirement to entity. Electronic Data Automation (EDA) tools are made to test the logic, synthesize the circuits, place and route the electronic elements and their connections prior to final implementation. A critical issue for EDA tools is its adequate safety to use in avionic. The paper focuses on approaches, from EDA industry, to using the EDA tools in the DO-254 project recently, then explains the principle of assessment and qualification, finally introduces methods to assess some EDA tools. The discussed contents will provide a guideline for the tools certification process.

title: Research of the electrothermic action on shaped charge jet in the passive electromagnetic armor
venue: 2014 17th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Launch Technology
abstract: To enhance protective effect of passive electromagnetic armor (PEA), the electrothermic action mechanism on the shaped charge jet (SCJ) in the PEA was researched. By building the kinematic model of uniformly elongating SCJ, and combined with the equivalent circuit model and action time model, coupled analysis model of electrothermic action on uniformly elongating SCJ in the PEA was established. Compared the static simulation results with the testing results, correctness of the coupled analysis model was proved. Consequently, feasibility of using temperature field to predict copper rod phase transition and electrical explosion was certified. Finally, electrothermic action on the SCJ in PEA was analyzed and temperature distribution of the SCJ at different velocities was obtained. It can be seen from the results, as a result of electrothermic action, drastic temperature change and phase transition even electrical explosion will occur when the SCJ penetrate the PEA. The liquefaction occurs in the middle of the SCJ whose velocity is about 5.8km/s, while the gasification occurs in the SCJ tail whose velocity is less than 4.5km/s. The analysis results indicate the significance of electrothermic action and the effect of temperature, which provides a research base for the optimization of PEA.

title: Research of the on-line hydropower units fault diagnosis based on fuzzy theory and multi-Agent
venue: 2010 International Conference on Computer, Mechatronics, Control and Electronic Engineering
abstract: To improve existing defects of on-line monitoring of hydropower generating units, the paper designs a MAS-based fault diagnosis system model. In allusion to the classic model of MAS-based fault diagnosis system, it improves information interactive features between mission-controlled subsystems and diagnosis task decomposition subsystem to increase the rate of control signal transmission and makes status-monitored subsystem to get abnormal signals directly from factory to increase sensitivity of system. In fault diagnosis subsystem of real-time fault diagnosis system, an MAS-based interactive parallel working structure is designed to meet requirements of high reliability and good real-time. Java-based software so called as JAFMAS is used to build platform to construct a multi-Agent coordination mechanism. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed system.

title: Research on a Robot Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm Based on Hierarchical Fusion of Reinforcement Learning and Sliding Window
venue: 2026 6th International Symposium on Computer Technology and Information Science (ISCTIS)
abstract: This paper integrates the global perspective of reinforcement learning with the local sensitivity of the dynamic window approach, proposing a hierarchical fusion obstacle avoidance algorithm framework. Through Python simulation experiments, it is observed that when environmental complexity and dynamics increase, the obstacle avoidance success rate of the hierarchical fusion algorithm only decreases by approximately 5%, significantly less than the approximately 40% decrease seen with the DWA algorithm. This demonstrates that the hierarchical fusion algorithm exhibits stronger adaptability and superior robustness in complex environments.

title: Research on AIGC-based Visual Translation and Multimodal Interaction Design for Cultural Heritage
venue: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Virtual Reality and Interaction Design
abstract: This paper proposes and validates a lightweight framework aimed at utilizing Generative Artificial Intelligence (AIGC) to address the issues of homogenized visual styles and superficial interactive experiences in the digital display of cultural heritage. The core of the framework consists of a visual feature deconstruction model based on painting expertise, a low-threshold stylized translation workflow based on Stable Diffusion and LoRA, and a multimodal interaction prototype system integrated with AIGC real-time generation capability. Using Han Dynasty stone reliefs as an empirical case, this study collects quantitative and qualitative data through a controlled experiment (N=60). The results show that the visual content generated by this method significantly outperforms traditional 3D modeling methods in cultural recognizability (improvement of 42.3%, p<0.01); the developed interaction system also performs better in user experience metrics such as immersion, cultural understanding, and engagement intention. This study provides a feasible low-technical-threshold pathway for researchers with art backgrounds to participate in digital cultural heritage creation. The related process has been successfully applied in digital art course teaching.

title: Research on an Intelligent Brand Identity Collaborative Design Platform Based on “Edge Computing Terminals + Cloud-Based Collaborative Training”
venue: Proceedings of the 2nd International Symposium on Integrated Circuit Design and Integrated Systems
abstract: A technical framework integrating layer-wise relevance propagation with generative adversarial networks is developed to address interpretability in AI-driven brand identity design. This framework adopts an innovative “edge computing terminal + cloud-based collaborative training” architecture, where the edge terminal provides low-latency, real-time data processing and local model updates, while the cloud platform performs large-scale collaborative training and optimization. The system synthesizes brand logos while generating relevance maps that highlight the contribution of input features to each design outcome. The two-channel evaluation module quantitatively evaluates the interpretability and esthetic quality, ensuring that the platform balances computational efficiency with creative accuracy. Real-time feedback and iterative optimization are seamlessly integrated to produce high-quality results. For experimental evaluation, the LogoLab-12K dataset contains 12,000 labeled logo images from 23 industries, ensuring a wide range of styles and complexity. Performance analysis shows that the proposed method has better visual fidelity and interpretability than the traditional GAN-based model. The practical effectiveness of the framework in supporting cultural sensitivity and transparent design is demonstrated thru case studies on cross-cultural adaptation and corporate brand redesign. By embedding explainable AI mechanisms into generative models, high-quality, responsible, and user-aligned brand identities can be created in computational design workflows.

title: Research on an Intelligent Faculty System for Chinese Party Schools Based On-Premise AI
venue: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Digital Management and Information Technology
abstract: To address the common challenges in Party school faculty management, such as information silos, inefficient retrieval, highly subjective decision-making, and data security risks, this study designed and implemented a secure and controllable intelligent faculty management system based on localized artificial intelligence. The system is built upon the core principles of being data-driven, intelligence-empowered, and security-guaranteed. Employing a closed-loop architecture, it establishes a standardized central faculty database and a localized AI service layer, ensuring that data remains within the designated domain while achieving intelligent semantic retrieval based on natural language understanding and assisting in generating training plans under multiple objective constraints.Practical pilot applications show that the system can increase the recall rate for complex faculty queries to 0.94 and reduce the response time from hours to seconds. Meanwhile, the time required for drafting training plans is shortened from several hours to minutes, with the quality of the generated plans surpassing that of manually created ones based on experience. The core innovations of this research are mainly reflected in three aspects. First, a hybrid retrieval-enhanced architecture tailored for high-security scenarios is proposed, which integrates dense vector retrieval, attribute filtering, and learning-to-rank based on LambdaMART to accurately interpret complex and ambiguous queries. Second, a cascaded planning method based on a dynamic weighted greedy algorithm and case-based reasoning is designed, enabling explainable intelligent plan generation while meeting security and real-time constraints. Third, a systematic evaluation framework and methodology tailored for the Party school faculty management task are constructed, providing an assessment basis for subsequent research.This study not only verifies the feasibility of implementing intelligent applications within a secure archite

title: Research on Application of Intelligent Management System for Morchella Planting Based on Internet of Things Technology
venue: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This article is based on the Arduino controller and Linkboy integrated development system, APP Inventor and the Internet of Things platform of Bafa Cloud, and uses the Internet of Things system for intelligent management of morels cultivation as research. The morels planting management Internet of Things application system is based on the needs of the morels planting environment, using the microcontroller series single-chip Arduino2560 as the core system to collect the temperature, humidity, soil humidity, light, wind and other data of the morel growth environment and use The WIFI module ESP32 performs network transmission, combined with the Bafa Cloud Internet of Things platform, mobile phone App, mobile WIFI and solar energy conversion system, to realize the all-weather temperature and humidity, light, wind, soil humidity, etc. of Morels in the wild planting management Indicator monitoring, through local or remote control of the humidity and soil water content in the area, to achieve real-time monitoring and control of morel growth indicators.

title: Research on Automatic Architecture of Energy Consumption Data Acquisition and Uploading Based on TCP/IP Protocol
venue: 2021 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Management, Communicates, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IMCEC)
abstract: In view of the high energy consumption status of buildings, in order to solve the problem of energy consumption data uploading at all levels of monitoring platforms, an architecture for acquiring and uploading energy consumption data based on the TCP/IP protocol is proposed, which makes it possible to transmit energy consumption data automatically. First, the various parts of the architecture are introduced. Among them, the architecture middleware is in the middle layer, it connects the building end and the platform end. According to different building conditions, three data acquisition methods based on OPC, distributed database and crawler are designed, a variety of technical support is provided to ensure the stable transmission of data; then the specific implementation of the architecture middleware program is described, and finally the specific examples and performance of the architecture middleware program are analyzed. The middleware program has been tested for nearly a year in the actual project, which verified the versatility, flexibility and stability of the architecture, and provides a reference for other researchers.

title: Research on Automatic Testing Technology Oriented Intelligent Mobile Terminal Software
venue: 2010 International Conference on Communications and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of ubiquitous computing technology, software is widely used in the intelligent mobile terminals. How to improve the intelligent mobile terminal software quality is one of the hot topics in embedded software testing field. Combined with the developed intelligent mobile terminal software automatic testing environment, the intelligent mobile terminal software testing script technology (TST-IMTS) was proposed firstly. And then, the main characteristics of the TST-IMTS and its modeling method applied to intelligent mobile terminal devices were studied. Furthermore, the automatic testing process based on the TST-IMTS was presented. Finally, TST-IMTS was applied in real intelligent mobile terminal software testing practice, and the verification result showed that the method proposed in this paper was efficient and of great value in engineering application.

title: Research on bending and deviating effects of passive electromagnetic armor on shaped-charge jet
venue: 2014 17th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Launch Technology
abstract: The lateral deviation and bend of shaped-charge jet (SCJ) are generated when the SCJ penetrates the passive electromagnetic armor (EMA). The lateral deviation is caused by the transverse electromagnetic force and the bend is caused by kinking instability and the transverse electromagnetic force, bending and lateral deviating effects coexist and affect the penetration of SCJ together. In this paper, two 3-D simulation models are developed to study bending and deviating effects produced by passive EMA on SCJ. After all, the static analog experiments proceed by copper wire which diameter is 2mm, the bending degree increases with the rising of voltage, when charging pulse voltage exceeds to several kilo-voltage, the breakup of copper wire appears. Besides, the protected experiments of the passive electromagnetic armor against SCJ proceed by armor piercing projectiles, the deviation of SCJ can be seen from the splash on the back plates. The results of simulations and experiments demonstrate that deviating and bending of SCJ can destroy the axial continuity of SCJ remarkably, which decreases the penetration of SCJ and improves the defense performance of passive electromagnetic armor ultimately.

title: Research on Complex Behavior Analysis Scheme for Network Users
venue: 2021 9th International Symposium on Next Generation Electronics (ISNE)
abstract: Aiming at the accuracy of network resource recommendation, the complex behavior of network users is studied. Through front-end embedded JS code and Java Web Framework custom filter, multi-data sources acquisition is realized, and the data acquisition is preprocessed. The complex behavior is normalized by entropy weight method. Flume+Kafka+Hbase are used to provide reliable high-speed storage and query, and the complex behavior of network users is obtained, which is precisely recommended for network resources. The proposed method is reliable and fast serviced. This complex behavior analysis method is applied to the network resources recommendation system. The system supports multi-channel rapid and stable acquisition, million-level data reliable storage, and millisecond query speed, which greatly improves the real-time and accuracy of complex behavior network resource recommendation under the condition that the business logic remains unchanged.

title: Research on Constructing a Quantitative Trading Signal Processing Model Based on LightGBM
venue: Proceedings of the 3rd International Conference on Machine Intelligence and Digital Applications
abstract: Intelligent algorithms have increasingly demonstrated their value in enhancing the precision of quantitative trading signal recognition under high-frequency and volatile financial environments. This study presents a full-chain signal processing framework based on LightGBM, integrating multi-dimensional feature engineering, entropy-based regularization, and a hierarchical error compensation module. Using 24,000 daily trading records from the Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share markets (2019–2024), the model extracts 60-dimensional dynamic features, performs adaptive training, and corrects predictive bias through PID-inspired compensation strategies. Compared with traditional XGBoost models, the proposed model reduces average prediction error to 0.012 and increases feature retention rate to 91.3%. Additionally, it achieves a gradient fluctuation suppression of 12.5% during backtesting. Experimental results confirm the model's robustness across validation stages and its adaptability to non-stationary market trends. The lightweight architecture and moderate time complexity (O(n log m)) support real-time deployment. This work contributes a computationally efficient, interpretable, and practically deployable signal recognition system for modern quantitative trading platforms.

title: Research on Data Transfer Scheme of Virtual-Real Interactive in Five - Dimensional Digital Twin System
venue: 2022 IEEE 8th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Digital twin is an advanced enabling technology that implements the fifth industrial revolution such as China's Intelligent Manufacturing 2025 and Industry 4.0. In the process of digital twin landing application, a five-dimensional model of digital twin is gradually evolved. There is no unified technical platform to realize cross-protocol and cross-platform data interaction between physical entity, virtual entity, twin data and service, which hinders the rapid landing of digital twin in the industry. In this paper, the technology of virtual-real data transfer-of industrial equipment is studied, and the data transfer scheme of virtual-real interactive is proposed. Under the experimental environment, the cross-platform and cross-protocol data transfer between physical machine tool entity, unity virtual machine tool entity, Adams virtual machine tool entity, system flow engine and twin database is realized. It lays a foundation for further research on the digital twin data transfer platform with unified interface, and expects to provide reference for peers in related fields.

title: Research on Design of a Vocal and Graphic Display System on Temperature Detection
venue: 2008 International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Temperature is one of the most prevalent and important parameters in industry production process. Moreover, it is very important to realize intelligentized management of temperature detection for development of industry. In order to realize this target it researches and designs a voice and graph display system on temperature detection. It sends data to computers, saves data to database, reads current temperature by voice system and displays real-time temperature curve. It realizes information automatization, promotes enhancement of life and production efficiency and is worthy of practical extension and application.

title: Research on dynamic history curve based on embedded Web server
venue: 2010 2nd International Conference on Advanced Computer Control
abstract: Clients can exchange data with embedded device where Web server is transplanted. In order to observe the state of the device and display it in the form of dynamic history curve, this paper has adopted two methods to get the real-time data of the embedded device and display the curve. One uses JavaScript cooperating with VML (Vector Markup Language), the other uses Applet. The two methods both have good displaying effect. The first method is complicated. It demands that clients install IE browser. The code of the second method is simple but needs the installation of JRE on the client side. These two methods have a quite bright prospect and can be applied in various fields.

title: Research on elliptic curve cryptography
venue: 8th International Conference on Computer Supported Cooperative Work in Design
abstract: There are many drawbacks in current encryption algorithms in respect of security, real-time performance and so on, and researchers are presenting various algorithms. Among them, the elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) is evolving as an important cryptography, and shows a promise to be an alternative of RSA. Small size, high security and other features characterize ECC. Based on the theory of ECC, This work analyzes its advantages over other cryptographies and focuses on its principle. A practical application implemented by Java is also presented. At last, some future works in ECC are indicated.

title: Research on End-to-End Multilingual Speech-to-Tibetan Text Translation System
venue: 2025 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (PRML)
abstract: With the rapid development of multilingual speech translation technology, cross-linguistic communication has gradually become an important demand in the era of globalization, especially for the translation of minority languages, where technological breakthroughs are particularly crucial [4]. This paper combines the Conformer speech encoder and the DA-Transformer language decoder to achieve translation from Mandarin and English speech to Tibetan text. The model adopts a non-autoregressive architecture, which directly converts speech signals into target text without relying on traditional cascade models, thus avoiding error accumulation and processing delays that may occur in cascade systems [1]. Due to the relative scarcity of Tibetan corpora, especially the lack of high-quality aligned speech-to-text translation data, this paper collects and processes datasets for Mandarin, English, and Tibetan [8]. Experimental results show that the proposed system outperforms the baseline model in translation quality and decoding speed.

title: Research on Formal Modeling and Safety Analysis Method of Head-up Display System for Civil Aircraft Based on AltaRica
venue: 2019 3rd International Conference on Circuits, System and Simulation (ICCSS)
abstract: The application of head-up display system (HUDS) in civil aviation effectively enhances pilots' situational awareness and flight safety. It has become necessary avionics equipment for new civil aircraft. In this article, formal modeling and safety analysis method based on AltaRica language is proposed for solving the problem that the data of system design and safety analysis cannot be expressed uniformly existing in traditional safety analysis methods. Aiming at HUDS, formal AltaRica models are built, and the failure condition model is added to the system model, which effectively combines the system design with safety analysis. Meanwhile, a graphical modeling tool-Simfia is used to make the AltaRica model of HUDS visually, to achieve assessing formal safety of HUDS. The results show that it can combine modeling with system design based on AltaRica language, to achieve consistent representation of system design and safety assessment, and effectively support the iteration process of safety analysis and system design.

title: Research on Generalization Methods for Route Acquisition Data Based on Gaussian Mixture Models
venue: Proceedings of the 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Driving and Smart Transportation
abstract: With the development of intelligent driving technology, the safety verification of intelligent driving vehicles faces challenges. Traditional test and verification methods based on mileage have been unable to meet the requirements of verification of highly concurrent data of intelligent driving functions, and scenario-based verification theory has been gradually studied in the field of automatic driving. How to ensure the coverage and validity of scene data has become a hot research issue. In this paper, a generalization algorithm of road sampling data based on mixed Gaussian model is proposed. Based on the collected multi-type spatio-temporal trajectory data, the key parameters are fitted with mixed Gaussian distribution, and parameter correlation is analyzed to achieve standardization and normalization of action description. The mixed Gaussian model algorithm proposed in this paper has a fitting parameter accuracy of more than 95% and a generalization speed of 1,000 / min. After screening, it can form effective scenes corresponding to high confidence, and the confidence of dangerous scenes can reach 99%. In terms of technology, an automatic generation technology of full coverage simulation test cases is proposed to solve the pain point problem of insufficient coverage of simulation scenes. In terms of tool integration, the whole process solution from data to test cases to simulation is formed based on Open series standards.

title: Research on Green Public Building Design Based on Computer 3D Image Vision Technology
venue: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Sensors, Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICSECE)
abstract: This paper proposes a planning scheme for urban public buildings oriented towards urban greening based on 3D machine vision. According to the construction process of the building, X3D and Java programming techniques are used to model each part of the virtual building. Through the interactive function to achieve the real-time creation of each component of the virtual building, modify, delete. 3DMax software is used for virtual modeling of real buildings. The simulated building model is introduced into the Converse3D background editor to create virtual reality. Finally, this green public building design system is applied to the management of public buildings. Practice has proved that this way of display is more intuitive and convenient for architectural display and management.

title: Research on helmet detection algorithm based on android system
venue: 2023 8th International Conference on Information Systems Engineering (ICISE)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of real-time detection of site helmet wearing, an artificial intelligence application based on android embedded system is designed to promote the accurate management of smart site safety. The dataset is obtained by Internet crawlers and construction site videos. Samples are divided into training set, validation set and test set in the ratio of 8:1:2. The yolov5s is used as the objective detection algorithm, and the network to be modified. After training the model is quantified, and then the model calls the interface and the lightly quantified model to improve the inference speed of the model. The accuracy of the trained model inference is 92%, the mAp is 80.4%, and the detection speed is 38s. After quantization and deployment to android system, the accuracy is 89.2 and the mAp is 87.6%. The detection speed is 19.2ms, which maximizes the detection speed under the premise of ensuring accuracy. The design helps to detect the safety helmet worn by site personnel automatically and promote the safety management of personnel at smart sites.

title: Research on IMA Blueprint Test Case Generation Method
venue: 2019 International Conference on Sensing, Diagnostics, Prognostics, and Control (SDPC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the model-based test case generation method for the integrated modular avionics blueprint system. The blueprint system is complex and highly coupled, and any change in configuration information may cause errors in the aircraft avionics system. The configuration needs to meet various logical constraints in the system integration which including time scheduling, space storage, space-time coupling, etc., and conduct targeted tests. The architecture analysis and design language combined with the flow can build a blueprint system model and contain the information needed for testing. Develop appropriate test selection criteria and test case generation algorithms based on test requirements to generate test cases based on test models.

title: Research on Image Signal Enhancement and Denoising Algorithms for Intelligent Communication Systems
venue: 2024 International Conference on Information Technology, Comunication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The quality of image signals directly affects the performance of intelligent communication systems. This paper proposes a set of image enhancement and denoising algorithms to address image quality degradation in intelligent communication systems. For image enhancement, we designed an adaptive histogram equalization algorithm based on blocks and a contrast adaptive optimization method, and implemented a detail enhancement algorithm combining multi-scale edge detection and enhancement. In terms of image denoising, we proposed adaptive median filtering, improved soft-threshold wavelet domain denoising, and non-local means algorithms to effectively suppress various types of noise. The system is developed using a hybrid $\mathrm{C}++$ and Python framework with parallel processing achieved through multithreading technology. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithms significantly improve image quality, processing efficiency, and system stability, providing reliable image signal processing support for intelligent communication systems.

title: Research on Implementation Approaches for Delay Queue
venue: 2024 Prognostics and System Health Management Conference (PHM)
abstract: This paper aims to explore and compare different implementation approaches for delay queue, which enjoy widespread applications in various scenarios that require the processing of delayed tasks, such as timed task scheduling and order timeout handling. As a special data structure, delay queue is widely used in various scenarios that require the processing of delayed tasks. This paper takes the order payment functionality of e-commerce platforms as a case study, exploring various implementation strategies for delay queues, including Delay Queue, Quartz, and Redis Sorted Set. Through comparative experiments, the paper analyzes the performance, reliability, and scalability of these methods and proposes corresponding improvement suggestions based on practical application scenarios. The research findings indicate that the selection of delay queue implementation methods should be comprehensively considered based on specific requirements, system architecture, and performance requirements. This study provides valuable references and insights for the implementation and application of delay queue.

title: Research on Implementation of Data Acquisition Method for Information System Performance Analysis
venue: 2020 International Workshop on Electronic Communication and Artificial Intelligence (IWECAI)
abstract: With the wide promotion and application of the construction and operation of the information system of state grid corporation, the automation and intelligence of information system is helpful to improve the management level, performance and security. However, accurate, reliable and real-time acquisition of basic data and information of the system is the foundation for the performance analysis and security. This paper studies the acquisition and collection methods of data and parameters required for the performance analysis of the power grid information system with Java probe tool of Java Agent and the Java Byte-code injection technology, in order to obtain the original performance data of the mobile terminal, browser terminal and server terminal and provide the basis for analyzing the performance analysis and security precaution of information system.

title: Research on Industrial Control System Abnormal Detection Technology Based on Power Grid Condition Fusion
venue: Proceedings of the 2026 2nd International Conference on Communication Technology and Data Security
abstract: Industrial Control Systems (ICS), which acted as the primary support hub of critical power infrastructure, encounter significant issues during actual operation, including frequent operational condition switching, non-stationary data distribution, and high false alarm rates. To address these, this paper proposes an adaptive anomaly detection method based on operational condition fusion and dynamic evidence decision-making. Distinct from the direct combination of traditional clustering, single-class model and evidence fusion, this method innovatively constructs condition-sensitive feature descriptors for power grid control logic, and designs a condition deviation discount mechanism embedded in Dempster-Shafer evidence theory. This integration enables dynamic adaptive matching between the detection model and the real-time operational state. During the offline phase, it extracts inherent clustering characteristics from multi-condition data, trains dedicated sub-models for refined working conditions, and constructs a detection library highly cooperative to multiple scenarios. In the online phase, the optimal sub-models are dynamically activated through membership weight calculation, and detection confidence is adjusted via deviation discount to accurately distinguish unknown working conditions from real faults. Experiments are conducted on the actual operation data of Zhangzhou Power Supply Company's 220kV substation. By combined with existing methods based on extensive measurements, the proposed exhibits excellent performance in overall metrics. Moreover, validation on various operational condition show that the detection rates all attain more than 95%. Ablation experiments prove the efficiency of our novel fusion mechanism. Consequently, our method achieves superior generalization and engineering practicability in complex and variable operating scenarios.

title: Research on intelligent management of power transmission and transformation engineering teams based on multi-dimensional coupling model through classification and grading
venue: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Digital Society, Information Science and Risk Management
abstract: As the core hub of the national energy strategy and a key component of the “new infrastructure”, the safety of power transmission and transformation projects critically depends on the performance of frontline operation teams. However, current team management faces challenges such as fragmented regional standards, oversimplified evaluation dimensions, and limited real-time dynamic control. This paper aims to develop an intelligent hierarchical grading system for safety management teams that accurately captures their operational health and potential. To achieve this, we construct a “Structure–Capability–Behavior” (SCB) multidimensional coupling model and establish an evaluation system covering four primary indicators and twelve secondary indicators through literature review and Delphi expert consultation. A hybrid weighting scheme combining Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and entropy weighting is used to quantify team performance, while Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) is employed to model complex interactions among indicators, and Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) analysis is applied to interpret the contributions of each factor. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed system can effectively identify teams with hidden weaknesses or underutilized potential, enabling a transition from superficial performance assessment to comprehensive health diagnosis. The system supports precise “digital portraits” of team capabilities, dynamic risk warnings, and provides data-driven guidance for human resource allocation, targeted skill development, and differentiated management strategies. This approach offers both theoretical innovation and practical tools to shift power grid project management from passive response to proactive safety governance.

title: Research on Intelligent Power Management and Control Technology of Electric Vehicle Based on Edge Computing
venue: 2021 6th Asia Conference on Power and Electrical Engineering (ACPEE)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, Internet of things devices are widely used in the field of power management and control. The diversity of IOT equipment types, characteristics and functions not only integrates detailed big data, but also challenges the real-time, compatibility and big data processing ability of system management and control. Among them, electric vehicle is a kind of electrical equipment with random power consumption and strong impact in the current power grid. This paper studies an embedded edge computing technology in the power Internet of things system, proposes an implementation scheme of edge computing based on vehicle terminal, and designs a vehicle terminal hardware platform with ArmCortex-A7 and EMMC as the computing core, which is based on Embedded Linux system and socket virtual machine. The technology develops an edge computing platform to meet the simultaneous operation of multiple data applications, processes the massive intelligent power consumption data of electric vehicles nearby, avoids the communication channel blockage caused by massive data transmission, and meets the special requirements of power Internet of things for rapid response and accurate execution. Experiments show that the proposed technology can not only provide safe and fast control mode, but also make the system have stronger power consumption information big data acquisition ability, and has advantages in low bandwidth and low delay applications.

title: Research on Intelligent Pricing Algorithm and Strategy of Food Safety Liability Insurance
venue: Proceedings of the 2026 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Communication Technology and Computer Applications
abstract: With the continuous increase in food safety risks, the precise pricing of liability insurance based on big data and artificial intelligence has become a hot topic. This study, based on the existing “Food Safety Shield” blockchain traceability platform and its RISM-ICEI-Action algorithm, introduces cutting-edge technologies such as causal inference, deep reinforcement learning, and hybrid neural networks, and proposes a new intelligent pricing algorithm and strategy. The proposed solution enhances causality and interpretability through causal modeling, realizes real-time dynamic adjustment through deep reinforcement learning, and enhances the system's feasibility. Empirical results show that the new algorithm outperforms the traditional solution in terms of risk assessment accuracy (AUC), claim ratio, user satisfaction, and claim handling time. The algorithm framework achieves a paradigm shift from “correlation modeling” to “causal decision-making”. This method demonstrates the feasibility and superiority of the intelligent pricing framework based on blockchain + big data + AI in the field of food safety liability insurance, providing technical references for subsequent research and practice.

title: Research on key technology of machining simulation based on Web
venue: 2010 IEEE International Conference on Industrial Technology
abstract: According to the single release form of product information on the network in machine manufacturing enterprises and the high price of the conventional NC simulation software, a machining simulation system based on Web is developed in this paper. Making use of the superiority of Java and JavaScript on Web and the interaction of VRML technology, 3D browsing, virtual assembly and machining simulation are realized on the network. Based on the authenticity and real-time of virtual reality, a network distributed virtual simulation system is designed. This method of NC machining simulation is not dependent on the expensive CAD/CAM software, and for the size of the system files is small, it can be transferred on the network conveniently. Using the browser with the plug as the client, the system has free installation, authenticity, interaction, low cost, portability, low requirements for the client, etc.

title: Research on Mobile Location Service Design Based on Android
venue: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Android platform is a new generation of smart mobile phone platform launched by Google. Android provides the support of mobile map and location service, which is probably a concern of vast numbers of developers. So far, the development of mobile map and location applications is complex and difficult, and is often required to pay high copyright fees to map makers. Android is free and open, providing an easy-to-use development kit containing flexible map display and control functions. This paper introduces the architecture and component models of Android, and analyzes the anatomy of an Android application including the functions of Activity, Intent Receiver, Service, Content Provider, and etc. Based on Android, the design method of a location-based mobile service is then presented. The design example shows that it's so easy to implement self-location, to draw the driving trace, to perform query and to flexibly control the real-time map on Android.

title: Research on Precise Information Push Technology Based on Power Market Behavioral Data
venue: 2023 5th International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Control Technologies (CEECT)
abstract: In the context of the new power system, personalized services for users are constantly mentioned in the power market. As an important component of the power market, information disclosure needs to keep up with the pace of market development. It provides accurate and personalized information disclosure services to market entities. Therefore, the article analyzes the characteristics of information precision push technology to the power market; Based on user historical attributes and behavioral characteristics data, the article designs an accurate push model based on user profiles, which considers individual differences in market entities and information needs. Finally, an example analysis conducted on the precise push model would verify the advantages of the designed push model from three aspects: accuracy, recall and coverage. Through precise information push technology in the electricity market, it not only helps to improve the efficiency of market operation, reduce the cost of information transmission, promote fair competition in the market, but more importantly, it can provide accurate and personalized information disclosure services for market entities.
