title: Research on Risk Analysis and Control Driven by Civil Aviation Accident Investigation Reports
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 5th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Risk Management
abstract: Safety is the cornerstone of the development of the civil aviation industry. This field is characterized by its high degree of system integration and significant technical complexity. In recent years, alongside the rapid development of the industry, new variables such as dynamic changes in the operational environment, the widespread application of new aircraft models, and the frequent occurrence of extreme weather events have been superimposed. Consequently, the safety risk profile of civil aviation has shown a complex evolutionary trend of multi-factor coupling. A series of accidents causing significant casualties have occurred worldwide, posing severe challenges to existing risk management and control systems.To deeply understand and accurately analyze systemic risks in civil aviation, this study proposes and implements a complete data-driven analysis framework based on accident investigation reports. Using the final accident investigation reports in the civil transport aviation sector issued by the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) over the last five years as the data source, this research comprehensively applies Natural Language Processing (NLP) and data mining techniques.First, the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) algorithm is used to extract key risk keywords. Next, the LDA topic model is introduced to identify nine core macroscopic risk themes, and the rationality of this number of topics is verified through perplexity and coherence analysis. Then, a structured risk factor dictionary, which combines the HFACS framework with “man-machine-environment-management” elements, is constructed to map keywords to the risk themes. Finally, each accident is aligned with the standards of CAAC (Civil Aviation Administration of China) advisory circular event examples, and the Apriori algorithm is applied to mine strong association rules between “risk factor combinations” and “specific event types.”The research results quantify and reveal mul

title: Research on Scheduling of Vehicle Cloud Storage Resource
venue: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper proposes a virtual machine-based vehicle cloud resource scheduling scheme. First, the resource requesting vehicle sends a transmission request and status information to other vehicles within its communication range. Then, other vehicles within the communication range informs the requester what resource it can provide according to the received request information. Finally the requester publish and perform the scheduling results. The resource scheduling process uses real-time dynamic programming algorithms to effectively reduce the computational complexity. Simulation results show that the proposed scheduling scheme can help to match high trust and low migration rate vehicles.

title: Research on Sensor-Integrated Smart Gloves for Sign Language Recognition
venue: 2025 30th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications (APCC)
abstract: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing; however, Japanese Sign Language (JSL) research remains limited due to the absence of standardized datasets and accessible recognition systems. This study presents a wearable sign language recognition system integrating a custom-designed smart glove with a two-stage XGBoost framework, referred to as Double-XGBoost (DXGB). The glove incorporates five flex sensors and a 6-axis inertial measurement unit to capture eleven channels of fine-grained motion data in real time. A structured data collection framework was established, involving 26 participants—20 experienced signers and 6 beginners—who contributed gesture data for 30 Hiragana-based signs under consistent recording conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DXGB model achieves a validation accuracy of 91% and a testing accuracy of 82.5%, outperforming Deep Neural Network (DNN) and Random Forest (RF) baselines. Furthermore, the hierarchical model effectively reduced confusion among visually similar gestures by 7.5%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed wearable-based system for Japanese Sign Language recognition and its potential as a practical assistive communication tool.

title: Research on Storage Methods of IoT Micro-service Platform Based on TDengine
venue: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Science (EIECS)
abstract: In recent years, the application of the Internet of Things in various fields has greatly promoted the informatization and intelligence of people's lives and work, leading to a continuous expansion of the scope of Internet of Things business, with more device collection points and data acquisition. Through comparing the applicable scenarios of NoSQL database storage, relational database storage, and time-series database storage, a storage method for Internet of Things micro-service platform architecture based on TDengine time-series database is proposed. By using time-series database technology to clean and write data collected by Internet of Things platform devices, it is possible to achieve rapid writing, reading, and summary analysis of large-capacity data. Time-series databases are a type of database specifically designed to handle time-series data, with characteristics such as high performance, scalability, highly optimized, data retention policies, real-time analysis, and distribution. This approach is consistent with the data types and features of the data collected by the Internet of Things platform and has been proven to be feasible and reliable through practical applications.

title: Research on Text Translation Framework Design for French Unstructured Signal Data
venue: Proceedings of the 3rd International Conference on Machine Intelligence and Digital Applications
abstract: The processing of unstructured French signal data poses significant challenges in automatic translation due to high noise levels, syntactic redundancy, and ambiguous entity boundaries. To address these issues, this study proposes a multi-task translation framework integrating semantic modeling, alignment supervision, and named entity recognition. The architecture is built upon French Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (FRA-BERT) embeddings and a four-layer Transformer decoder, enhanced with a multi-scale attention mechanism and a dynamic task-weighted training strategy. Key components include a convolutionally augmented feature extractor, a gated alignment module, and a multi-loss optimization scheme covering translation accuracy, semantic coherence, and entity boundary precision. Experimental validation on a real-world French transcription dataset (112,764 samples) demonstrates a 5.6-point improvement in Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score, a 7.9% reduction in Translation Error Rate (TER), and a 9.6% increase in F1 for named entity recognition compared to baseline models. These results confirm the proposed model's superior capability in handling semantic inconsistencies and long-range dependencies in noisy signal environments. The framework provides a robust solution for enhancing translation fidelity and alignment stability, with promising applicability in multilingual live-captioning and real-time audio-visual interpretation scenarios.

title: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Mechanical Engineering Design Optimization
venue: Proceedings of the 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Information Processing
abstract: AI has demonstrated unprecedented potential for advancement in mechanical engineering design optimization, particularly in key areas such as generative design, additive manufacturing, simulation acceleration, digital twins, and automated design. Algorithms automatically generate and optimize diverse design patterns, transcending the limitations of traditional topology optimization. Structural design has achieved a leap beyond human intuition. For additive manufacturing, AI leverages real-time data to intelligently optimize process parameters and defect detection, significantly enhancing production efficiency and quality. Digital twins facilitate instant communication between virtual models and actual systems, facilitating the implementation of intelligent manufacturing and predictive maintenance. While AI technology holds great potential, practical applications still face challenges such as insufficient data, model interpretability, high computational costs, a shortage of interdisciplinary talent, and ethical considerations. This article explores these challenges and proposes strategies such as data sharing, explainable AI, human-machine integration, green AI, educational reform, and ethical management. With the advancement of AI technology, mechanical design will gradually transition to a data- and model-driven phase, facilitating the growth of intelligent, flexible, and sustainable manufacturing systems and injecting new impetus into the industrial revolution.

title: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Evolutionary Game Technology in the Prevention of Big Data Killing System
venue: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the government regulation as the lead to establish the e-commerce platform "big data killing" pricing behavior and user consumption channel selection evolutionary game model. Then this paper based on the "java" backend design language and front-end design language "WXML" design and development of a set of price comparison small program. The system can display and compare the prices of the same goods or services on different e-commerce platforms in real time. This makes it easy for consumers to buy at the most favorable price. The evolutionary stability strategies of consumers and merchants are analyzed systematically, and the results are simulated by MATLAB software. The simulation results show that the ratio of price-sensitive old users and sticky new users as well as the fine of regulatory authorities are the key factors affecting the stable state of the evolutionary game system. Transfer costs and psychological losses can influence users' willingness to choose a "retention" strategy.

title: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Bank Financial Risk Monitoring
venue: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the daily transaction volume of major domestic banks is nearly 10 million, and the average daily transaction volume exceeds 100 billion yuan. A large amount of structured and unstructured transaction data is generated, which is difficult to effectively manage. At the same time, criminal methods are constantly being renovated, resulting in increasing number of crimes and more obviously negative impact on the banking industry. How to deal with massive amounts of data and respond to risks in a timely manner poses a great challenge to the implementation of the risk supervision system. According to the plan, the article describes the system's business design to the system's model network security and other requirements in detail. We put forward a system design based on bank risk warning and supervision, using semantic trees to describe in detail the functional design of the system, ETL technology for real-time management of data information, and UML modeling for supervision and warning management. The paper also describes the specific implementation of the bank risk warning and supervision system and some Java core codes. Finally, the system was tested and applied.

title: Research on the Application of Reinforcement Learning in Intelligent Translation and Spoken Language Training Systems
venue: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Power, Electronics and Green Energy (ICPEGE)
abstract: To address the challenges of insufficient translation accuracy, delayed spoken language assessment, and poor algorithm adaptability in traditional intelligent translation and spoken language training systems, this paper proposes a dynamic reward-aware reinforcement learning algorithm (DRP-RL) and applies it to intelligent translation and spoken language training systems. The DRP-RL algorithm innovatively constructs a dynamic reward function that dynamically adjusts reward weights based on multi-dimensional metrics such as translation accuracy, fluency, and spoken pronunciation standardization, combined with real-time task feedback. It also integrates a deep learning model to enhance language feature extraction capabilities and optimizes agent decision-making using a policy update approach combining temporal difference and Monte Carlo. To validate the algorithm's performance, an experimental environment was established and simulation experiments were conducted on the WMT2023 translation dataset and the L2-Arctic spoken language dataset. The algorithm was compared with DQN, A2C, mainstream Transformer models, and the Google spoken language assessment model. Results show that in intelligent translation tasks, the DRP-RL algorithm achieved a translation accuracy of 92.3% for the English-Chinese language pair, a 6.7 percentage point improvement over DQN, and a BLEU score of 41.2, surpassing A2C's 35.8. In spoken language training tasks, its pronunciation assessment error rate was only 3.2%, and its error localization accuracy was 89.5%, representing a 1.9 percentage point reduction and a 5.8 percentage point improvement, respectively, over the Google spoken language assessment model. Furthermore, the algorithm converged 33.3% faster than DQN, and its computational efficiency approached that of the Transformer model. This research confirms that the DRP-RL algorithm can effectively improve the performance of intelligent translation and spoken language training systems, pro

title: Research on the Construction of Large-scale Technical Talent Capability Portraits and Key Position Matching Algorithms
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 6th International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology
abstract: In response to problems such as “mismatch between supply and demand”, “low matching efficiency”, and “insufficient capacity for large-scale data processing” in the current technical talent market, this paper proposes a large-scale technical talent capability profile construction method and an improved job matching algorithm that integrates multi-dimensional features. First, based on the iceberg model and the career development patterns of technical talents, construct a three-tier competency index system that includes explicit capabilities (professional skills, qualification certifications), implicit capabilities (learning ability, collaboration ability), and scenario adaptation capabilities (project experience, industry adaptation degree) The objective and subjective fusion assignment of index weights is achieved through entropy weight-analytic hierarchy process (EW-AHP); Secondly, in view of the high-dimensional and sparse nature of large-scale talent data, a feature dimension reduction method based on improved weighted kernel principal component analysis (W-KPCA) is designed, combined with the attention mechanism in deep learning, to construct the talent capability profile vector; Finally, a deep matching algorithm based on dual attention mechanism (DA-DMA) is proposed to achieve precise matching of key positions and talents through the bidirectional interaction of job demand attention and talent ability attention. The simulation experiment was based on over 100,000 technical talent data and over 5,000 key job requirements in the IT industry as samples and compared with the traditional cosine similarity matching algorithm, the matching algorithm based on collaborative filtering, and the single-dimensional portrait matching algorithm. The results show that the method proposed in this paper improves matching accuracy to 92.3%, recall to 89.7%, F1 value to 91.0%, and reduces response time to 2.1 seconds when dealing with 100,000 level of talent data, significantly ou

title: Research on the Construction of Open Electricity Information Service Platform Based on the Internet
venue: 2022 International Conference on Smart City and Green Energy (ICSCGE)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern society and the continuous progress of science and technology, electric power safety management is becoming more and more important in people's daily life. Internet technology provides us with an open resource and service platform to query various electric power information anytime, anywhere, efficiently, effectively and accurately. The open electricity information service platform proposed and designed in this paper is built with safe and intelligent electricity consumption as the core, using mobile Internet network, and realizes cloud management of electricity consumption information through real-time monitoring of various electricity consumption information and big data analysis of historical data of various electricity consumption parameters. By developing and utilizing computer and cell phone intelligent type service system, it links power supply production system, marketing service system and client service information sharing under the premise of ensuring the safety of power grid and marketing management system, creating an open public service platform with multi-layer integration of Internet, realizing refinement in management and realizing risk minimization, and finally providing intelligent, high-quality and efficient services to customers.

title: Research on the Design and Effect of Computer Hardware Courses in the Smart Learning Environment
venue: 2019 Eighth International Conference on Educational Innovation through Technology (EITT)
abstract: With the continuous optimization and development of teaching methods in the information age, smart education has gradually entered people's field of vision. This paper is based on the advantageous characteristics of the smart educational environment, or designing the teaching mode of intelligent learning. Twenty freshmen in education technology profession were used as teaching research objects, and the information-based intelligent device (tablet) was used as the learning tool. The ARA software developed by the team based on the learning tool was used to assist the teaching, and then the teacher used the electronic interactive whiteboard for feedback to the students (incomprehensible and error-prone knowledge). After class, the computer hardware is virtually assembled, which further strengthens and consolidates the basic concepts and features of each part of the hardware. The research results showed that the independent inquiry learning, cooperation exchange, and interactive feedback in the context of smart learning were conducive to the optimization of the learning process. Most students could master the key knowledge of common computer hardware in time. Students could be successfully installed on the virtual machine motherboard, and they also interacted effectively with students and teachers. Under this teaching mode, students' learning enthusiasm, participation and interest level have improved significantly.

title: Research on the Digital Interaction of Cultural Heritage Game Driven by UE5 and IoT Technologies: A Case Study of Pitch-pot
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 6th International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology
abstract: This study clarifies the important position of traditional games in cultural inheritance as well as the challenges they face by sorting out the domestic and foreign research, protection and industrial application status of traditional games. Moreover, with the help of the user experience scale, it summarizes the current interaction defects and demand expectations of traditional games, and defines the goals of subsequent research. Taking the game of Pitch-pot as a specific object, this research uses UE5 to build an immersive game environment, simulate the process and interaction logic of Pitch-pot, and realizes the real-time recording and feedback of somatosensory interaction data with the aid of IoT technology. It elaborates on the implementation details such as the system design architecture, technology selection, design of the physical interaction carrier, game rules and visual design. Through the integration of multiple aspects of technology, it provides players with an immersive and highly interactive game experience. The research results show that digital interactive games combined with physical interaction are of great significance in the development and dissemination of traditional games, and IoT technology can enhance users' interaction experience through somatosensory simulation, embodied interaction and other means. This innovative approach provides a new path for the digital protection of traditional games, and realizes the interpretation of their cultural characteristics by digital technology through the combination with tangible interaction, thus achieving the effective storage and dissemination of resources. Finally, this study puts forward suggestions and prospects for the application of modern game engines and Internet of Things technology in traditional games, providing a new perspective and method for the inheritance of Cultural heritage games, and also providing a reference for the subsequent research and practice with the intervention of multi-se

title: Research on the Mechanisms of Interpretability and Optimization of Multi-modal Knowledge Graph-Powered Education Recommendation Systems
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 3rd International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization
abstract: This paper integrates hybrid deep learning and federated learning to propose an interpretable multi-modal knowledge graph (KG) education recommendation system. Using a single representation of textual, behavioral, and temporal data and an LSTM-Transformer architecture, our method achieves 85.6% prediction accuracy while providing 98.7% privacy protection through differential federated learning. The experimental results show real-time processing of 10,000+ kg nodes with <200ms latency and a 68% improvement in instructor judgment efficiency.

title: Research on the necking effect of pulse current on Shaped-charge Jet in passive electromagnetic armor
venue: 2014 17th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Launch Technology
abstract: When Shaped-charge Jet (SCJ) penetrates front armor and approach to back armor, powerful pulse current flows it immediately and produces θ magnetic field simultaneously. Due to the effect of electromagnetic force F = J × B, the necking of SCJ occurs and leads to the breakup of SCJ into individual fragments and the penetration capability of SCJ is decreased significantly. In this paper, in order to improve defense capability of the passive electromagnetic armor against SCJ, the necking mechanism of the high-temperature SCJ is studied through Maxwell's equations and elastic-plastic constitutive equations. A 3-D simulation model, supposed to be sine-disturbance and axial-symmetry, is developed to analyze the necking law of SCJ through electromagnetic-structure co-simulation. Take the skin-effect of pulse current into account, the distribution of current density, magnetic field, magnetic force and stress field are obtained through electromagnetic-structure co-simulation by finite element software, and the SCJ deformation is also calculated. The results indicate that, a powerful pulse current can accelerate the break-up of SCJ. At last, defense experiments of the passive electromagnetic armor against SCJ with high explosive anti-tank cartridge proceeded. The results demonstrate that, the penetration capability of SCJ with pulse current is lower than that without pulse current, and the penetration capability of SCJ declines remarkably with the increasing of charging voltage.

title: Research on the simulation system of nc milling
venue: International Technology and Innovation Conference 2009 (ITIC 2009)
abstract: Based on the features of NC milling process, the 3D geometric model of virtual machine tool and the fixture are established by the virtual reality technology and OpenGL graphics library with the method of Construction of Solid Geometry(CSG) and Boundary Representation(B-Rep), and some realistic effects treatments(including material, light, texture mapping, etc.) are applied. The established virtual machine tool can be zoomed, rotated and translated in the view area. And a workpiece decomposition expression model based on the Z-MAP structure is put forward, and Boolean subtraction is performed by using this model and a tool solid model to simulate the real time process of cutting and test the simulation result. Simulation example proves that this system runs reliably and improves NC machining efficiency.

title: Research on the Standard for INC with a STEP-NC Extension
venue: 2007 Thirty-Ninth Southeastern Symposium on System Theory
abstract: This paper introduces and analyses the building of the INC standard with a STEP-NC extension based on the INC system theory. First it s does an introduction of the two sides of INC standard. And then the paper focuses on some important points which are relative to build up the INC standard. They are the building of INC interpreter, extended motion or control expression based on features, how to support bidirectional information flow and application of COM and RTDLL in INC to enhance the real-time performance. Finally it also gives a feasible method to get an INC file which contains the geometric information and machining information.

title: Research on Topological Modeling and Fault Tracing Methods Based on Logic Relationships in Large Commercial Aircraft ICDs
venue: 2026 8th International Conference on Software Engineering and Computer Science (CSECS)
abstract: The accurate expression and rapid verification of parameter logic are paramount for the safety iteration and operational maintenance of complex aviation systems. However, traditional manual reviews struggle to valid dependency consistency during frequent design changes, and static document-based troubleshooting fails to effectively locate root causes within high-coupling signal networks. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an aircraft parameter visualization modeling and reasoning method based on graphical semantic analysis, and designs a corresponding engineering verification platform. First, by mapping heterogeneous parameter assets and functional logic into a computable graph semantic model, the platform transforms implicit documentation into explicit relationship networks, leveraging a "persistence-rendering" closed-loop mechanism to ensure model evolution consistency. Subsequently, an interpretable traceability algorithm is designed to identify fault propagation paths dynamically via topological analysis. This approach transforms the discrete parameter review process into a global, relation-aware analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with traditional methods, this system significantly shortens root cause positioning time and minimizes dependence on subjective expert experience, validating its efficiency in engineering applications.

title: Research on Video Surveillance Robot Based on SSH Reverse Tunnel Technology
venue: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Based on SSH reverse tunnel technology, this paper designs a remote video surveillance robot vehicle, which can better solve the difficulty of controlling and transmitting data when the mobile terminal and the surveillance robot are in two different internal networks respectively without public network IP. The focus of this paper is to introduce the data communication module of the video surveillance robot. By introducing a cloud server as relay, it can realize the motion control and real-time video transmission of the surveillance robot across the local area network. Compared with traditional video surveillance equipment, this video surveillance robot vehicle has broad application prospects in the fields of home security, disaster rescue and smart home, etc.

title: Research on Web Instant Messaging using REST Web Service
venue: 2010 IEEE 2nd Symposium on Web Society
abstract: With the development of Web Service, Web Instant Messaging is becoming more and more common in our life. On the other hand, REST Web Service sets off a revolution. It changes the traditional structure of web Service, which makes the service uniformed as resources to use. This paper firstly analyzes and compares the existing web instant messaging technology. Then introduces REST web service and gives an example of a REST-based instant messaging application.

title: Research on Xen Virtualization and Scheduling Algorithm Based on Mixed-Criticality Systems
venue: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Automation, Electronics and Electrical Engineering (AUTEEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the real-time guarantee problem and CPU resource allocation problem of Xen scheduling in mixed criticality systems, and proposes a virtual machine scheduling idea for Xen mixed-criticality systems. By adjusting VCPU resources under different load conditions, the CPU resources occupied by non-real-time virtual machines are reasonably allocated while ensuring real-time performance. In view of the passive treatment of low-criticality tasks in mixed criticality systems, a preemptive mixed criticality task global scheduling method SWPA is proposed. The algorithm is based on a dynamic weight adjustment factor, combined with the criticality and time sensitivity of the task, dynamically evaluates the importance of the task, and assigns priority to the task. The correctness of the method is proved by theoretical deduction. Simulation experiments show that this method is superior to the existing classic scheduling algorithms EDF-DVD and Credit in terms of the schedulability of low-criticality tasks.

title: Research on Zhuang's Speech-to-Text and Translation Cloud Platform
venue: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The Zhuang people distribute in Guangxi province maintaining their language without characters. To convert the speech of the Zhuang into Chinese characters and translate it into other languages, we built a database to construct an end-to-end automatic speech recognition using a neural network SaformerNet. The network used a transformer-based deep learning model for the translation. An edge computing-based private cloud system using FPGA acceleration was proposed for the rapid response of the network. The results demonstrated that the proposed solution was suitable for small-scale conversion of natural languages in a real-time application.

title: Resilience Network Controller Design for Multi-Domain SDN: A BDI-based Framework
venue: 2022 IEEE 95th Vehicular Technology Conference: (VTC2022-Spring)
abstract: Network attacks are becoming more intense and characterized by complexity and persistence. Mechanisms that ensure network resilience to faults and threats should be well provided. Different approaches have been proposed to network resilience; however, most of them rely on static policies, which is unsuitable for current complex network environments and real-time requirements. To address these issues, we present a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) based multi-agent resilience network controller coupled with blockchain. We first clarify the theory and platform of the BDI, then discuss how the BDI evaluates the network resilience. In addition, we present the architecture, workflow, and applications of the resilience network controller. Simulation results show that the resilience network controller can effectively detect and mitigate distributed denial of service attacks.

title: Resilient Path Tracking of Autonomous Driving under Few-shot Action Space Attacks
venue: ACM Trans. Cyber-Phys. Syst.
abstract: Modern autonomous vehicles face growing cybersecurity risks, especially from action space attacks that directly target vehicle actuators. This article systematically evaluates the resilience of three representative Autonomous Driving (AD) architectures, including modular, end-to-end, and feature-fused agents, against few-shot action space attacks crafted via deep reinforcement learning under a black-box setting. The adversary perturbs the vehicle’s lateral control only during safety-critical moments, using either a camera or an inertial measurement unit. Our results reveal distinct vulnerabilities and behavioral patterns across AD architectures, which underscore the necessity for adaptive and robust defense strategies. However, existing adversarial training defense methods show limitations of overfitting and reliance on attack knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose a learning-based Path Correction System (PCS) that integrates traditional feedback control with an adversarially trained correction loop. The correction loop is selectively activated by a kinematic model-based attack detector to counteract abnormal control deviations. Evaluation experiments show that PCS reduces path-tracking deviation by 78% when the system is under attack.

title: Resolving ATLAS obsolescence problems - lessons learned and new opportunities
venue: Proceedings AUTOTESTCON 2004.
abstract: ATS obsolescence has a critical impact on operational readiness. Resolving ATS obsolescence problems is often a very costly endeavor. Various technical solutions have been suggested for this purpose. This paper presents the "lessons learned" from past obsolescence mitigation programs. The main conclusion of the analysis is that ATLAS re-hosting, possibly complemented by subset conversion, is an effective approach for solving TPS obsolescence. The paper offers a set of recommendations for using new software technologies and industry standards to resolve current ATS obsolescence problems and prevent future obsolescence. The authors recommend TPS conversion via test requirements, using general-purpose programming languages, along with commercial tools that have open interfaces based on industry standards.

title: Resonance: Meditative Neural Rhythms as Collective Spatial Experience
venue: Proc. ACM Comput. Graph. Interact. Tech.
abstract: Resonance is an interactive installation that externalizes meditation as collective spatial experience by translating a meditator’s neural rhythms into water, vibration, and light. Real-time EEG data modulates vibration within a suspended water vessel, generating wave patterns whose refracted caustics are projected across the surrounding architecture. Rather than visualizing cognition as abstract data, the system situates neural activity within physical matter and immersive space, forming an embodied relationship between mind, matter, and architecture.Grounded in theories of extended cognition, Resonance proposes that bio-responsive environments can actively participate in shaping attention and awareness. By shifting neurofeedback from individual interaction to immersive spatial media, this work transforms meditation from a solitary practice into a phenomenon that surrounds and immerses the audience. The project synthesizes meditation traditions, fluid mechanics, and computational design, contributing a spectator-centered model of bio-responsive design where cognition is encountered not as private feedback but as shared experience. Through this synthesis, Resonance expands interactive media toward embodied presence and shared contemplative experience, allowing inner states to be sensed collectively.

title: Resource Allocation Algorithms for Multicast Streaming in Elastic Cloud-Based Media Collaboration Services
venue: 2016 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing (CLOUD)
abstract: Traditional infrastructure models are being replaced by Cloud-enabled models with support for several different applications/services. One of these services is professional real-time Audio/Video collaboration. Although high-end business collaboration solutions are nowadays offered with high reliability, they rely on dedicated specialized (and costly) hardware and network infrastructure setups, and usually prove difficult to scale up. On the other hand, existing cloud-based A/V collaboration solutions do allow for easier elasticity and scalability, but do so on a best-effort basis with no guarantees for reliability or quality. In this context, this paper proposes cloud-enabled A/V collaboration resource allocation algorithms focused on solving the business requirements and SLAs dealing with elasticity and scalability. The proposed algorithms attempt to minimise Cloud resource usage, in order to keep the cost within budget, while striving for the reliability and quality of dedicated hardware solutions. The evaluation is conducted using a version of the CloudSim simulator that has been extended to support collaborative meeting patterns, usage seasonality, resource expenditure prediction, network congestion and streaming multicast. Compared to the second best solution applied to the same evaluated scenario, our results show a reduction of bandwidth usage and virtual machine costs by 49% and 63%, respectively, and an effectiveness of 99% in meeting A/V collaboration setup deadlines.

title: Resource Allocation in Software-Defined Vehicles: ILP Model Formulation and Solver Evaluation
venue: 2022 IEEE 25th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
abstract: Modern vehicles are changing rapidly. Years ago, cars were still differentiated from each other by mechanical features such as horsepower. Nowadays, there are nearly 100 electronic control units (ECUs) and millions of lines of codes embedded in a vehicle. In the automotive industry, software is starting to have more value than hardware. Thus, the concept of software-defined vehicles (SDVs) is rising. Traditional electrical and electronic (E/E) architectures show their limitations with predefined implementations, layout and distribution, as well as insufficient computational power for future extensions. Instead, powerful automotive central computing platforms with flexible software solutions are being developed. With the development of hypervisor technology, applications with different safety criticality can be deployed on different virtual machines (VMs) of the same physical hardware. The resource allocation problem, which refers to mapping software to hardware, is becoming more complicated with the increasing number of automotive applications. Existing approaches for resource allocation problems mainly focus on distributed E/E architectures. In this paper, we aim to address the gap of solving resource allocation problems in the central computing platform of SDVs, where the dynamical VM creation and constrained application deployment shall be considered simultaneously. We propose an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) based approach by formulating the problem as an optimization problem with the minimum number of VMs as the goal and utilizing well-known solvers to find the solution automatically. Moreover, we evaluate the performance of state-of-the-art solvers for the proposed approach.

title: Resource allocation strategies used in cloud computing: A critical analysis
venue: 2016 2nd International Conference on Communication Control and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The revolution in utility computing paradigm is brought by Cloud computing which replaces the traditional software installation. The cloud computing service models are basically classified into three parts i.e. software as a service (Saas), Platform as a service (Paas) and Infrastructure as a service (Iaas). There are four deployment models followed by Cloud computing i.e. Public Cloud, Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud and Community Cloud. The proposed system comes under the Iaas which provides memory and processor as a resource. Every user wanted to get the services of cloud as they submit the job immediately. In this situation the allocation of resource at real time is a challenging issue. Cloud services are efficiently and optimally allocated to satisfy the requirements of customer. The focus of this paper is detailed and comparative study on different resource allocation strategies by preserving the service level agreement (SLA). The paper brief the algorithms used by the cloud service provider to allocate resources when the multiple jobs arrive with different burst time and different resource requirement.

title: Resource and Instance Hour Minimization for Deadline Constrained DAG Applications Using Computer Clouds
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
abstract: In this paper, we address the resource and virtual machine instance hour minimization problem for directed-acyclic-graph based deadline constrained applications deployed on computer clouds. The allocated resources and instance hours on computer clouds must: (1) guarantee the satisfaction of a deadline constrained application's end-to-end deadline; (2) ensure that the number of virtual machine (VM) instances allocated to the application is minimized; (3) under the allocated number of VM instances, determine application execution schedule that minimizes the application's makespan; and (4) under the decided application execution schedule, determine a VM operation schedule, i.e., when a VM should be turned on or off, that minimizes total VM instance hours needed to execute the application. We first give lower and upper bounds for the number of VM instances needed to guarantee the satisfaction of a deadline constrained application's end-to-end deadline. Based on the bounds, we develop a heuristic algorithm called minimal slack time and minimal distance (MSMD) algorithm that finds the minimum number of VM instances needed to guarantee the application's deadline and schedules tasks on the allocated VM instances so that the application's makespan is minimized. Once the application execution schedule and the number of VM instances needed are determined, the proposed VM instance hour minimization (IHM) algorithm is applied to further reduce the instance hours needed by VMs to complete the application's execution. Our experimental results show that the MSMD algorithm can guarantee applications' end-to-end deadlines with less resources than the HEFT [32], MOHEFT [16], DBUS [9], QoS-base [40] and Auto-Scaling [25] heuristic scheduling algorithms in the literature. Furthermore, under allocated resources, the MSMD algorithm can, on average, reduce an application's makespan by 3.4 percent of its deadline. In addition, with the IHM algorithm we can effectively reduce the application

title: Resource management and control in virtualized SDN networks
venue: 2018 Real-Time and Embedded Systems and Technologies (RTEST)
abstract: Software defined networking and network virtual-ization are widely considered promising techniques for reducing the complexity of network management in many contexts that require high Quality of Service (QoS) and the support for heterogeneous architectures. In this paper we address a network architecture, here called a virtualized SDN network, that combines the benefits of SDN and virtualization. To cope with the demand for efficiently sharing a platform among several services, here a resource management mechanism to reserve and control network resources among various services in the virtualized SDN networks is proposed. The mechanism is implemented on an SDN controller and a set of experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

title: Resource pre-allocation algorithms for low-energy task scheduling of cloud computing
venue: Journal of Systems Engineering and Electronics
abstract: In order to lower the power consumption and improve the coefficient of resource utilization of current cloud computing systems, this paper proposes two resource pre-allocation algorithms based on the "shut down the redundant, turn on the demanded" strategy here. Firstly, a green cloud computing model is presented, abstracting the task scheduling problem to the virtual machine deployment issue with the virtualization technology. Secondly, the future workloads of system need to be predicted: a cubic exponential smoothing algorithm based on the conservative control (CESCC) strategy is proposed, combining with the current state and resource distribution of system, in order to calculate the demand of resources for the next period of task requests. Then, a multi-objective constrained optimization model of power consumption and a low-energy resource allocation algorithm based on probabilistic matching (RA-PM) are proposed. In order to reduce the power consumption further, the resource allocation algorithm based on the improved simulated annealing (RA-ISA) is designed with the improved simulated annealing algorithm. Experimental results show that the prediction and conservative control strategy make resource pre-allocation catch up with demands, and improve the efficiency of real-time response and the stability of the system. Both RA-PM and RA-ISA can activate fewer hosts, achieve better load balance among the set of high applicable hosts, maximize the utilization of resources, and greatly reduce the power consumption of cloud computing systems.

title: Resource Scheduling in Cloud-Assisted Communication Systems Using Enhanced Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
venue: 2026 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Networks (ICISCN)
abstract: The resource scheduling is utilized to manage user requests for resources by prioritizing it within a specific time frame. In today environments, healthcare systems rely on smart devices connected through the internet, which handle large volumes of data generated by medical sensors while maintaining key performance metrics. Traditional resource scheduling algorithm increased task waiting time, fail to adapt quickly to changes like Virtual Machine (VM) failures or node variations and inaccurate scheduling decisions. Due to difficulty in capturing real-time resource states such as VM load, bandwidth, queue length and inefficient scheduling, which led to improper scheduling and high latency in communication systems. To solve these existing challenges, this research proposed Enhanced Reinforcement Learning algorithm (ERL), which includes Genetic Algorithm (GA), State Action Reward State Action (SARSA) and Q-Learning for resource scheduling. These algorithms aim to determine optimal solutions for load management in cloud based healthcare systems. The proposed approach is energy-efficient, minimizes makespan and latency.

title: Respecting Temporal Constraints in Virtualised Services
venue: 2009 33rd Annual IEEE International Computer Software and Applications Conference
abstract: This paper reports some experiences in providing service guarantees to real-time (RT) applications running in virtual machine (VM), showing how proper scheduling is a necessary condition for a predictable execution. In particular, resource reservation techniques allow to cope with some of the overhead and unpredictabilities experienced when executing multiple VMs on the same host.

title: Responsible Reporting for Frontier AI Development
venue: Proceedings of the 2024 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society
abstract: Mitigating the risks from frontier AI systems requires up-to-date and reliable information about those systems. Organizations that develop and deploy frontier systems have significant access to such information. By reporting safety-critical information to actors in government, industry, and civil society, these organizations could improve visibility into new and emerging risks posed by frontier systems. Equipped with this information, developers could make better informed decisions on risk management, while policymakers could design more targeted and robust regulatory infrastructure. We outline the key features of responsible reporting and propose mechanisms for implementing them in practice.

title: Responsive systems: An introduction
venue: IBM Systems Journal
abstract: This paper introduces responsive systems: systems that are real-time, event-based, or time-dependent. There are a number of trends that are accelerating the adoption of responsive systems: timeliness requirements for business information systems are becoming more prevalent, embedded systems are increasingly integrated into soft real-time command-and-control systems, improved message-oriented middleware is facilitating growth in event-processing applications, and advances in service-oriented and component-based techniques are lowering the costs of developing and deploying responsive applications. The use of responsive systems is illustrated here in two application areas: the defense industry and online gaming. The papers in this special issue of the IBM Systems Journal are then introduced. The paper concludes with a discussion of the key remaining challenges in this area and ideas for further work.

title: Restoring the Executability of Jupyter Notebooks by Automatic Upgrade of Deprecated APIs
venue: 2021 36th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE)
abstract: Data scientists typically practice exploratory programming using computational notebooks, to comprehend new data and extract insights. To do this they iteratively refine their code, actively trying to re-use and re-purpose solutions created by other data scientists, in real time. However, recent studies have shown that a vast majority of publicly available notebooks cannot be executed out of the box. One of the prominent reasons is the deprecation of data science APIs used in such notebooks, due to the rapid evolution of data science libraries. In this work we propose RELANCER, an automatic technique that restores the executability of broken Jupyter Notebooks, in near real time, by upgrading deprecated APIs. RELANCER employs an iterative runtime-error-driven approach to identify and fix one API issue at a time. This is supported by a machine-learned model which uses the runtime error message to predict the kind of API repair needed - an update in the API or package name, a parameter, or a parameter value. Then RELANCER creates a search space of candidate repairs by combining knowledge from API migration examples on GitHub as well as the API documentation and employs a second machine-learned model to rank this space of candidate mappings. An evaluation of RELANCER on a curated dataset of 255 un-executable Jupyter Notebooks from Kaggle shows that RELANCER can successfully restore the executability of 56% of the subjects, while baselines relying on just GitHub examples and just API documentation can only fix 38% and 36% of the subjects respectively. Further, pursuant to its real-time use case, RELANCER can restore execution to 49% of subjects, within a 5 minute time limit, while a baseline lacking its machine learning models can only fix 24%.

title: Results and Lessons Learned from the Psyche Mission Launch and Solar Array Deployment
venue: 2025 IEEE Aerospace Conference
abstract: “Psyche: Journey to a Metal World” launched on October 13, 2023 from Cape Canaveral atop a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket. The mission is using an electric propulsion system to rendezvous with and orbit the large metal asteroid (16) Psyche. Psyche is a hybrid development with deep-space avionics provided by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and a solar electric propulsion chassis provided by Maxar, carrying a magnetometer, multispectral imager, and gamma ray & neutron spectrometer payloads and the Deep Space Optical Communications technology demonstration. The Psyche mission Launch Phase encompassed the final spacecraft configuration in countdown through the first ground commanding after solar array deployment. This period was the mission's only critical event, where the spacecraft autonomously detected separation from the launch vehicle, deployed both array wings, located the Sun, and achieved a power-positive, thermally-safe, and communicative state. This paper discusses results from the Launch Phase, focusing on flight results compared to ground testing, methodologies used to confirm full and complete solar array deployment, and challenges faced by the launch team. The paper also includes lessons learned and impacts of the 1-year launch delay.

title: Rethinking Masked Image Modeling for Ultrasound Image Denoising
venue: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management
abstract: Ultrasound imaging serves as an important clinical diagnostic modality due to its non-invasive, radiation-free, and real-time capabilities. However, ultrasound images suffer from speckle noise that significantly compromises diagnostic accuracy and clinical interpretation. Traditional denoising methods are limited by speckle noise's signal-dependent nature, often removing important diagnostic features. While deep learning performs better, it requires large labelled datasets that are difficult to obtain due to privacy concerns and annotation costs. Self-supervised learning through masked image modeling (MIM) shows potential in addressing data scarcity, but conventional MIM, developed for high-level vision tasks, is unsuitable for low-level tasks like image denoising due to its framework architecture and learning strategy. To this end, we propose Image Denoising Masked Image Modeling (ID-MIM), the first MIM framework for ultrasound image denoising. ID-MIM incorporates a novel high-frequency oriented dual-branch masking and a specialized learning objective for noise reduction. Our encoder-only architecture features a multi-scale hierarchical transformer with dynamic skip connections, where the encoder directly performs denoising rather than relying on separate decoder reconstruction as in conventional MIM approaches. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our ID-MIM framework across diverse noise scenarios, establishing new state-of-the-art results.

title: Retracted: A Novel Design of Autonomous Cars using IoT and Visual Features
venue: 2018 2nd International Conference on I-SMAC (IoT in Social, Mobile, Analytics and Cloud) (I-SMAC)I-SMAC (IoT in Social, Mobile, Analytics and Cloud) (I-SMAC), 2018 2nd International Conference on
abstract: Autonomous car is a ground vehicle that is capable of driving without user interference. Traffic congestion and number of collisions are major issues in road traffic control due to rapid increase day-by-day. Autonomous cars provide a solution to this problem in an efficient and economical way. The proposed system utilizes mathematical models like neural networks and image processing techniques to sense the environment. This is implemented as three major components: curved road detection (steering), road sign and signal detection and obstacle detection (collision avoidance). Back Propagation is used for steering control with detection of curved roads; Haar features are used for road signal, sign detection and a distance sensor for collision avoidance. Data collected from the sensors is sent to a server for processing. Based on the result, a command is sent to the car. A GPS module attached to the car identifies the location of the car and with the help of a 3rd party location service, route to destination is identified and directions are sent to the car. Wireless networks are used to transmit data between sensors and the server. Python scripts are used to control and integrate all the units together. The designed system can attain high accuracy with real – time constraints.

title: Retracted: Design and Implementation of Terminal System for Internet of Vehicles Based on Android
venue: 2018 3rd International Conference on Smart City and Systems Engineering (ICSCSE)
abstract: Nowadays, people have more and more demands and uses for vehicles. According to the current using situation of Internet-of-Vehicles (IoV), the paper designed and implemented an IoV system based on Android and Neusoft Automotive Electronics Developer Platform. The system provided real time reminder of the cars ‘status, reliable traffic information and other key functions can provide reliable service for the user. Users can use the Web or Android terminal of the system and check the position and status of their own vehicles and obtain the best route for car search. Real-time vehicle data and other services.
